verses.en: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
verses.fr: Généalogie de Jésus-Christ, fils de David, fils d''Abraham.
verses.am: የዳዊት ልጅ የአብርሃም ልጅ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ትውልድ መጽሐፍ።

verses.en: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
verses.fr: Abraham engendra Isaac; Isaac engendra Jacob; Jacob engendra Juda et ses frères;
verses.am: አብርሃም ይስሐቅን ወለደ፤ ይስሐቅም ያዕቆብን ወለደ፤ ያዕቆብም ይሁዳንና ወንድሞቹን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
verses.fr: Juda engendra de Thamar Pharès et Zara; Pharès engendra Esrom; Esrom engendra Aram;
verses.am: ይሁዳም ከትዕማር ፋሬስንና ዛራን ወለደ፤ ፋሬስም ኤስሮምን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
verses.fr: Aram engendra Aminadab; Aminadab engendra Naasson; Naasson engendra Salmon;
verses.am: ኤስሮምም አራምን ወለደ፤ አራምም አሚናዳብን ወለደ፤ አሚናዳብም ነአሶንን ወለደ፤ ነአሶንም ሰልሞንን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
verses.fr: Salmon engendra Boaz de Rahab; Boaz engendra Obed de Ruth; Obed engendra Isaï;
verses.am: ሰልሞንም ከራኬብ ቦኤዝን ወለደ፤ ቦኤዝም ከሩት ኢዮቤድን ወለደ፤ ኢዮቤድም እሴይን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
verses.fr: Isaï engendra David. Le roi David engendra Salomon de la femme d''Urie;
verses.am: እሴይም ንጉሥ ዳዊትን ወለደ።

verses.en: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
verses.fr: Salomon engendra Roboam; Roboam engendra Abia; Abia engendra Asa;
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ሮብዓምን ወለደ፤ ሮብዓምም አቢያን ወለደ፤ አቢያም አሣፍን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
verses.fr: Asa engendra Josaphat; Josaphat engendra Joram; Joram engendra Ozias;
verses.am: አሣፍም ኢዮሣፍጥን ወለደ፤ ኢዮሣፍጥም ኢዮራምን ወለደ፤ ኢዮራምም ዖዝያንን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
verses.fr: Ozias engendra Joatham; Joatham engendra Achaz; Achaz engendra Ezéchias;
verses.am: ዖዝያንም ኢዮአታምን ወለደ፤ ኢዮአታምም አካዝን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
verses.fr: Ezéchias engendra Manassé; Manassé engendra Amon; Amon engendra Josias;
verses.am: አካዝም ሕዝቅያስን ወለደ፤ ሕዝቅያስም ምናሴን ወለደ፤ ምናሴም አሞፅን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
verses.fr: Josias engendra Jéchonias et ses frères, au temps de la déportation à Babylone.
verses.am: አሞፅም ኢዮስያስን ወለደ፤ ኢዮስያስም በባቢሎን ምርኮ ጊዜ ኢኮንያንንና ወንድሞቹን ወለደ።

verses.en: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
verses.fr: Après la déportation à Babylone, Jéchonias engendra Salathiel; Salathiel engendra Zorobabel;
verses.am: ከባቢሎንም ምርኮ በኋላ ኢኮንያን ሰላትያልን ወለደ፤ ሰላትያልም ዘሩባቤልን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
verses.fr: Zorobabel engendra Abiud; Abiud engendra Eliakim; Eliakim engendra Azor;
verses.am: ዘሩባቤልም አብዩድን ወለደ፤ አብዩድም ኤልያቄምን ወለደ፤ ኤልያቄምም አዛርን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
verses.fr: Azor engendra Sadok; Sadok engendra Achim; Achim engendra Eliud;
verses.am: አዛርም ሳዶቅን ወለደ፤ ሳዶቅም አኪምን ወለደ፤ አኪምም ኤልዩድን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
verses.fr: Eliud engendra Eléazar; Eléazar engendra Matthan; Matthan engendra Jacob;
verses.am: ኤልዩድም አልዓዛርን ወለደ፤ አልዓዛርም ማታንን ወለደ፤ ማታንም ያዕቆብን ወለደ፤

verses.en: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
verses.fr: Jacob engendra Joseph, l''époux de Marie, de laquelle est né Jésus, qui est appelé Christ.
verses.am: ያዕቆብም ክርስቶስ የተባለውን ኢየሱስን የወለደች የማርያምን እጮኛ ዮሴፍን ወለደ።

verses.en: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
verses.fr: Il y a donc en tout quatorze générations depuis Abraham jusqu''à David, quatorze générations depuis David jusqu''à la déportation à Babylone, et quatorze générations depuis la déportation à Babylone jusqu''au Christ.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ትውልድ ሁሉ ከአብርሃም እስከ ዳዊት አሥራ አራት ትውልድ፥ ከዳዊትም እስከ ባቢሎን ምርኮ አሥራ አራት ትውልድ፥ ከባቢሎንም ምርኮ እስከ ክርስቶስ አሥራ አራት ትውልድ ነው።

verses.en: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Voici de quelle manière arriva la naissance de Jésus-Christ. Marie, sa mère, ayant été fiancée à Joseph, se trouva enceinte, par la vertu du Saint-Esprit, avant qu''ils eussent habité ensemble.
verses.am: የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ልደት እንዲህ ነበረ። እናቱ ማርያም ለዮሴፍ በታጨች ጊዜ ሳይገናኙ ከመንፈስ ቅዱስ ፀንሳ ተገኘች።

verses.en: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.
verses.fr: Joseph, son époux, qui était un homme de bien et qui ne voulait pas la diffamer, se proposa de rompre secrètement avec elle.
verses.am: እጮኛዋ ዮሴፍም ጻድቅ ሆኖ ሊገልጣት ስላልወደደ በስውር ሊተዋት አሰበ።

verses.en: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
verses.fr: Comme il y pensait, voici, un ange du Seigneur lui apparut en songe, et dit: Joseph, fils de David, ne crains pas de prendre avec toi Marie, ta femme, car l''enfant qu''elle a conçu vient du Saint-Esprit;
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ይህን ሲያስብ፥ እነሆ የጌታ መልአክ በሕልም ታየው፥ እንዲህም አለ። የዳዊት ልጅ ዮሴፍ ሆይ፥ ከእርስዋ የተፀነሰው ከመንፈስ ቅዱስ ነውና እጮኛህን ማርያምን ለመውሰድ አትፍራ።

verses.en: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name Jesus: for he shall save his people from their sins.
verses.fr: elle enfantera un fils, et tu lui donneras le nom de Jésus; c''est lui qui sauvera son peuple de ses péchés.
verses.am: ልጅም ትወልዳለች፤ እርሱ ሕዝቡን ከኃጢአታቸው ያድናቸዋልና ስሙን ኢየሱስ ትለዋለህ።

verses.en: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
verses.fr: Tout cela arriva afin que s''accomplît ce que le Seigneur avait annoncé par le prophète:
verses.am: በነቢይ ከጌታ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
verses.fr: Voici, la vierge sera enceinte, elle enfantera un fils, et on lui donnera le nom d''Emmanuel, ce qui signifie Dieu avec nous.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ድንግል ትፀንሳለች ልጅም ትወልዳለች፥ ስሙንም አማኑኤል ይሉታል የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሁሉ ሆኖአል፥ ትርጓሜውም። እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር የሚል ነው።

verses.en: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
verses.fr: Joseph s''étant réveillé fit ce que l''ange du Seigneur lui avait ordonné, et il prit sa femme avec lui.
verses.am: ዮሴፍም ከእንቅልፉ ነቅቶ የጌታ መልአክ እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ እጮኛውንም ወሰደ፤

verses.en: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name Jesus.
verses.fr: Mais il ne la connut point jusqu''à ce qu''elle eût enfanté un fils, auquel il donna le nom de Jésus.
verses.am: የበኩር ልጅዋንም እስክትወልድ ድረስ አላወቃትም፤ ስሙንም ኢየሱስ አለው።

verses.en: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
verses.fr: Jésus étant né à Bethléhem en Judée, au temps du roi Hérode, voici des mages d''Orient arrivèrent à Jérusalem,

verses.en: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
verses.fr: et dirent: Où est le roi des Juifs qui vient de naître? car nous avons vu son étoile en Orient, et nous sommes venus pour l''adorer.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በይሁዳ ቤተ ልሔም በንጉሡ በሄሮድስ ዘመን በተወለደ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰብአ ሰገል። የተወለደው የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ወዴት ነው? ኮከቡን በምሥራቅ አይተን ልንሰግድለት መጥተናልና እያሉ ከምሥራቅ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።

verses.en: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.fr: Le roi Hérode, ayant appris cela, fut troublé, et tout Jérusalem avec lui.
verses.am: ንጉሡ ሄሮድስም ሰምቶ ደነገጠ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር፤

verses.en: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
verses.fr: Il assembla tous les principaux sacrificateurs et les scribes du peuple, et il s''informa auprès d''eux où devait naître le Christ.
verses.am: የካህናትንም አለቆች የሕዝቡንም ጻፎች ሁሉ ሰብስቦ ክርስቶስ ወዴት እንዲወለድ ጠየቃቸው።

verses.en: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: A Bethléhem en Judée; car voici ce qui a été écrit par le prophète:

verses.en: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
verses.fr: Et toi, Bethléhem, terre de Juda, Tu n''es certes pas la moindre entre les principales villes de Juda, Car de toi sortira un chef Qui paîtra Israël, mon peuple.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አንቺ ቤተ ልሔም፥ የይሁዳ ምድር፥ ከይሁዳ ገዢዎች ከቶ አታንሽም፤ ሕዝቤን እስራኤልን የሚጠብቅ መስፍን ከአንቺ ይወጣልና ተብሎ በነቢይ እንዲህ ተጽፎአልና በይሁዳ ቤተ ልሔም ነው አሉት።

verses.en: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
verses.fr: Alors Hérode fit appeler en secret les mages, et s''enquit soigneusement auprès d''eux depuis combien de temps l''étoile brillait.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገልን በስውር ጠርቶ ኮከቡ የታየበትን ዘመን ከእነርሱ በጥንቃቄ ተረዳ፥

verses.en: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
verses.fr: Puis il les envoya à Bethléhem, en disant: Allez, et prenez des informations exactes sur le petit enfant; quand vous l''aurez trouvé, faites-le-moi savoir, afin que j''aille aussi moi-même l''adorer.
verses.am: ወደ ቤተ ልሔምም እነርሱን ሰድዶ። ሂዱ፥ ስለ ሕፃኑ በጥንቃቄ መርምሩ፤ ባገኛችሁትም ጊዜ እኔ ደግሞ መጥቼ እንድሰግድለት ንገሩኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
verses.fr: Après avoir entendu le roi, ils partirent. Et voici, l''étoile qu''ils avaient vue en Orient marchait devant eux jusqu''à ce qu''étant arrivée au-dessus du lieu où était le petit enfant, elle s''arrêta.
verses.am: እነርሱም ንጉሡን ሰምተው ሄዱ፤ እነሆም፥ በምሥራቅ ያዩት ኮከብ ሕፃኑ ባለበት ላይ መጥቶ እስኪቆም ድረስ ይመራቸው ነበር።

verses.en: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
verses.fr: Quand ils aperçurent l''étoile, ils furent saisis d''une très grande joie.
verses.am: ኮከቡንም ባዩ ጊዜ በታላቅ ደስታ እጅግ ደስ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense and myrrh.
verses.fr: Ils entrèrent dans la maison, virent le petit enfant avec Marie, sa mère, se prosternèrent et l''adorèrent; ils ouvrirent ensuite leurs trésors, et lui offrirent en présent de l''or, de l''encens et de la myrrhe.
verses.am: ወደ ቤትም ገብተው ሕፃኑን ከእናቱ ከማርያም ጋር አዩት፥ ወድቀውም ሰገዱለት፥ ሣጥኖቻቸውንም ከፍተው እጅ መንሻ ወርቅና ዕጣን ከርቤም አቀረቡለት።

verses.en: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
verses.fr: Puis, divinement avertis en songe de ne pas retourner vers Hérode, ils regagnèrent leur pays par un autre chemin.
verses.am: ወደ ሄሮድስም እንዳይመለሱ በሕልም ተረድተው በሌላ መንገድ ወደ አገራቸው ሄዱ።

verses.en: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent partis, voici, un ange du Seigneur apparut en songe à Joseph, et dit: Lève-toi, prends le petit enfant et sa mère, fuis en Egypte, et restes-y jusqu''à ce que je te parle; car Hérode cherchera le petit enfant pour le faire périr.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከሄዱ በኋላ እነሆ፥ የጌታ መልአክ በሕልም ለዮሴፍ ታይቶ። ሄሮድስ ሕፃኑን ሊገድለው ይፈልገዋልና ተነሣ፥ ሕፃኑንና እናቱንም ይዘህ ወደ ግብፅ ሽሽ፥ እስክነግርህም ድረስ በዚያ ተቀመጥ አለው።

verses.en: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
verses.fr: Joseph se leva, prit de nuit le petit enfant et sa mère, et se retira en Egypte.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተሣለቁበት ባየ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቆጣና ልኮ ከሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተረዳው ዘመን በቤተ ልሔምና በአውራጃዋ የነበሩትን፥ ሁለት ዓመት የሆናቸውን ከዚያም የሚያንሱትን ሕፃናት ሁሉ አስገደለ።

verses.en: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
verses.fr: Il y resta jusqu''à la mort d''Hérode, afin que s''accomplît ce que le Seigneur avait annoncé par le prophète: J''ai appelé mon fils hors d''Egypte.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ሄሮድስ ሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተሣለቁበት ባየ ጊዜ እጅግ ተቆጣና ልኮ ከሰብአ ሰገል እንደ ተረዳው ዘመን በቤተ ልሔምና በአውራጃዋ የነበሩትን፥ ሁለት ዓመት የሆናቸውን ከዚያም የሚያንሱትን ሕፃናት ሁሉ አስገደለ።

verses.en: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently inquired of the wise men.
verses.fr: Alors Hérode, voyant qu''il avait été joué par les mages, se mit dans une grande colère, et il envoya tuer tous les enfants de deux ans et au-dessous qui étaient à Bethléhem et dans tout son territoire, selon la date dont il s''était soigneusement enquis auprès des mages.
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ከሞተ በኋላ፥ እነሆ፥ የጌታ መልአክ በግብፅ ለዮሴፍ በሕልም ታይቶ።

verses.en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
verses.fr: Alors s''accomplit ce qui avait été annoncé par Jérémie, le prophète:
verses.am: ሄሮድስም ከሞተ በኋላ፥ እነሆ፥ የጌታ መልአክ በግብፅ ለዮሴፍ በሕልም ታይቶ።

verses.en: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
verses.fr: On a entendu des cris à Rama, Des pleurs et de grandes lamentations: Rachel pleure ses enfants, Et n''a pas voulu être consolée, Parce qu''ils ne sont plus.
verses.am: የሕፃኑን ነፍስ የፈለጉት ሞተዋልና ተነሣ፥ ሕፃኑን እናቱንም ይዘህ ወደ እስራኤል አገር ሂድ አለ።

verses.en: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
verses.fr: Quand Hérode fut mort, voici, un ange du Seigneur apparut en songe à Joseph, en Egypte,
verses.am: እርሱም ተነሥቶ ሕፃኑንና እናቱን ያዘና ወደ እስራኤል አገር ገባ።

verses.en: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
verses.fr: et dit: Lève-toi, prends le petit enfant et sa mère, et va dans le pays d''Israël, car ceux qui en voulaient à la vie du petit enfant sont morts.
verses.am: በአባቱም በሄሮድስ ፈንታ አርኬላዎስ በይሁዳ እንደ ነገሠ በሰማ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚያ መሄድን ፈራ፤ በሕልምም ተረድቶ ወደ ገሊላ አገር ሄደ፤

verses.en: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
verses.fr: Joseph se leva, prit le petit enfant et sa mère, et alla dans le pays d''Israël.
verses.am: በነቢያት። ናዝራዊ ይባላል የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ፥ ናዝሬት ወደምትባል ከተማ መጥቶ ኖረ።

verses.en: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
verses.fr: Mais, ayant appris qu''Archélaüs régnait sur la Judée à la place d''Hérode, son père, il craignit de s''y rendre; et, divinement averti en songe, il se retira dans le territoire de la Galilée,
verses.am: በአባቱም በሄሮድስ ፈንታ አርኬላዎስ በይሁዳ እንደ ነገሠ በሰማ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚያ መሄድን ፈራ፤ በሕልምም ተረድቶ ወደ ገሊላ አገር ሄደ፤

verses.en: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
verses.fr: et vint demeurer dans une ville appelée Nazareth, afin que s''accomplît ce qui avait été annoncé par les prophètes: Il sera appelé Nazaréen.
verses.am: በነቢያት። ናዝራዊ ይባላል የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ፥ ናዝሬት ወደምትባል ከተማ መጥቶ ኖረ።

verses.en: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
verses.fr: En ce temps-là parut Jean Baptiste, prêchant dans le désert de Judée.
verses.am: በዚያም ወራት መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት

verses.en: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.fr: Il disait: Repentez-vous, car le royaume des cieux est proche.
verses.am: ቀርባለችና ንስሐ ግቡ ብሎ በይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ እየሰበከ መጣ።

verses.en: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.fr: Jean est celui qui avait été annoncé par Esaïe, le prophète, lorsqu''il dit: C''est ici la voix de celui qui crie dans le désert: Préparez le chemin du Seigneur, Aplanissez ses sentiers.
verses.am: በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ። የጌታን መንገድ አዘጋጁ ጥርጊያውንም አቅኑ እያለ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮህ ሰው ድምፅ የተባለለት ይህ ነውና።

verses.en: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
verses.fr: Jean avait un vêtement de poils de chameau, et une ceinture de cuir autour des reins. Il se nourrissait de sauterelles et de miel sauvage.
verses.am: ራሱም ዮሐንስ የግመል ጠጉር ልብስ ነበረው፥ በወገቡም ጠፍር ይታጠቅ ነበር፤ ምግቡም አንበጣና የበረሀ ማር ነበረ።

verses.en: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
verses.fr: Les habitants de Jérusalem, de toute la Judée et de tout le pays des environs du Jourdain, se rendaient auprès de lui;
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሁዳም ሁሉ በዮርዳኖስም ዙሪያ ያለ አገር ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ ይወጡ ነበር፤

verses.en: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.fr: et, confessant leurs péchés, ils se faisaient baptiser par lui dans le fleuve du Jourdain.
verses.am: ኃጢአታቸውንም እየተናዘዙ በዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ ከእርሱ ይጠመቁ ነበር።

verses.en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.fr: Mais, voyant venir à son baptême beaucoup de pharisiens et de sadducéens, il leur dit: Races de vipères, qui vous a appris à fuir la colère à venir?
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን ብዙዎች ወደ ጥምቀቱ ሲመጡ ባየ ጊዜ፥ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ከሚመጣው ቍጣ እንድትሸሹ ማን አመለከታችሁ?

verses.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
verses.fr: Produisez donc du fruit digne de la repentance,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ለንስሐ የሚገባ ፍሬ አድርጉ፤

verses.en: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.fr: et ne prétendez pas dire en vous-mêmes: Nous avons Abraham pour père! Car je vous déclare que de ces pierres-ci Dieu peut susciter des enfants à Abraham.
verses.am: በልባችሁም። አብርሃም አባት አለን እንደምትሉ አይምሰላችሁ፤ እላችኋለሁና። ከነዚህ ድንጋዮች ለአብርሃም ልጆች ሊያስነሣለት እግዚአብሔር ይችላል።

verses.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.fr: Déjà la cognée est mise à la racine des arbres: tout arbre donc qui ne produit pas de bons fruits sera coupé et jeté au feu.
verses.am: አሁንስ ምሳር በዛፎች ሥር ተቀምጦአል፤ እንግዲህ መልካም ፍሬ የማያደርግ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቈረጣል ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።

verses.en: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance. but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
verses.fr: Moi, je vous baptise d''eau, pour vous amener à la repentance; mais celui qui vient après moi est plus puissant que moi, et je ne suis pas digne de porter ses souliers. Lui, il vous baptisera du Saint-Esprit et de feu.
verses.am: እኔስ ለንስሐ በውኃ አጠምቃችኋለሁ፤ ጫማውን እሸከም ዘንድ የማይገባኝ ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው ግን ከእኔ ይልቅ ይበረታል፤ እርሱ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ በእሳትም ያጠምቃችኋል፤

verses.en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
verses.fr: Il a son van à la main; il nettoiera son aire, et il amassera son blé dans le grenier, mais il brûlera la paille dans un feu qui ne s''éteint point.
verses.am: መንሹም በእጁ ነው፥ አውድማውንም ፈጽሞ ያጠራል፥ ስንዴውንም በጎተራው ይከታል፥ ገለባውን ግን በማይጠፋ እሳት ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
verses.fr: Alors Jésus vint de la Galilée au Jourdain vers Jean, pour être baptisé par lui.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በዮሐንስ ሊጠመቅ ከገሊላ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ መጣ።

verses.en: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
verses.fr: Mais Jean s''y opposait, en disant: C''est moi qui ai besoin d''être baptisé par toi, et tu viens à moi!
verses.am: ዮሐንስ ግን። እኔ በአንተ ልጠመቅ ያስፈልገኛል አንተም ወደ እኔ ትመጣለህን? ብሎ ይከለክለው ነበር።

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Laisse faire maintenant, car il est convenable que nous accomplissions ainsi tout ce qui est juste. Et Jean ne lui résista plus.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። አሁንስ ፍቀድልኝ፤ እንዲህ ጽድቅን ሁሉ መፈጸም ይገባናልና አለው። ያን ጊዜ ፈቀደለት።

verses.en: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
verses.fr: Dès que Jésus eut été baptisé, il sortit de l''eau. Et voici, les cieux s''ouvrirent, et il vit l''Esprit de Dieu descendre comme une colombe et venir sur lui.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከተጠመቀ በኋላ ወዲያው ከውኃ ወጣ፤ እነሆም፥ ሰማያት ተከፈቱ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ እንደ ርግብ ሲወርድ በእርሱ ላይም ሲመጣ አየ፤

verses.en: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.fr: Et voici, une voix fit entendre des cieux ces paroles: Celui-ci est mon Fils bien-aimé, en qui j''ai mis toute mon affection.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ድምፅ ከሰማያት መጥቶ። በእርሱ ደስ የሚለኝ የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው አለ።

verses.en: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
verses.fr: Alors Jésus fut emmené par l''Esprit dans le désert, pour être tenté par le diable.
verses.am: ከዚያ ወዲያ ኢየሱስ ከዲያብሎስ ይፈተን ዘንድ መንፈስ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወሰደው፥

verses.en: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
verses.fr: Après avoir jeûné quarante jours et quarante nuits, il eut faim.
verses.am: አርባ ቀንና አርባ ሌሊትም ከጦመ በኋላ ተራበ።

verses.en: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
verses.fr: Le tentateur, s''étant approché, lui dit: Si tu es Fils de Dieu, ordonne que ces pierres deviennent des pains.
verses.am: ፈታኝም ቀርቦ። የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ከሆንህ፥ እነዚህ ድንጋዮች እንጀራ እንዲሆኑ በል አለው።

verses.en: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Il est écrit: L''homme ne vivra pas de pain seulement, mais de toute parole qui sort de la bouche de Dieu.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። ሰው ከእግዚአብሔር አፍ በሚወጣ ቃል ሁሉ እንጂ በእንጀራ ብቻ አይኖርም ተብሎ ተጽፎአል አለው።

verses.en: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
verses.fr: Le diable le transporta dans la ville sainte, le plaça sur le haut du temple,
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ዲያቢሎስ ወደ ቅድስት ከተማ ወሰደውና እርሱን በመቅደስ ጫፍ ላይ አቁሞ።

verses.en: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.fr: et lui dit: Si tu es Fils de Dieu, jette-toi en bas; car il est écrit: Il donnera des ordres à ses anges à ton sujet; Et ils te porteront sur les mains, De peur que ton pied ne heurte contre une pierre.
verses.am: መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝልሃል እግርህንም በድንጋይ ከቶ እንዳትሰናከል በእጃቸው ያነሡሃል ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና የእግዚአብሔር ልጅስ ከሆንህ፥ ወደ ታች ራስህን ወርውር አለው።

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Il est aussi écrit: Tu ne tenteras point le Seigneur, ton Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ጌታን አምላክህን አትፈታተነው ተብሎ ደግሞ ተጽፎአል አለው።

verses.en: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
verses.fr: Le diable le transporta encore sur une montagne très élevée, lui montra tous les royaumes du monde et leur gloire,
verses.am: ደግሞ ዲያቢሎስ እጅግ ረጅም ወደ ሆነ ተራራ ወሰደው፥ የዓለምንም መንግሥታት ሁሉ ክብራቸውንም አሳይቶ።

verses.en: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
verses.fr: et lui dit: Je te donnerai toutes ces choses, si tu te prosternes et m''adores.
verses.am: ወድቀህ ብትሰግድልኝ ይህን ሁሉ እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Retire-toi, Satan! Car il est écrit: Tu adoreras le Seigneur, ton Dieu, et tu le serviras lui seul.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። ሂድ፥ አንተ ሰይጣን ለጌታህ ለአምላክህ ስገድ እርሱንም ብቻ አምልክ ተብሎ ተጽፎአልና አለው።

verses.en: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
verses.fr: Alors le diable le laissa. Et voici, des anges vinrent auprès de Jésus, et le servaient.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ ዲያቢሎስ ተወው፥ እነሆም፥ መላእክት ቀርበው ያገለግሉት ነበር።

verses.en: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
verses.fr: Jésus, ayant appris que Jean avait été livré, se retira dans la Galilée.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ዮሐንስ አልፎ እንደ ተሰጠ በሰማ ጊዜ ወደ ገሊላ ፈቀቅ ብሎ ሄደ።

verses.en: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
verses.fr: Il quitta Nazareth, et vint demeurer à Capernaüm, située près de la mer, dans le territoire de Zabulon et de Nephthali,
verses.am: ናዝሬትንም ትቶ በዛብሎንና በንፍታሌም አገር በባሕር አጠገብ ወደ አለችው ወደ ቅፍርናሆም መጥቶ ኖረ።

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.fr: afin que s''accomplît ce qui avait été annoncé par Esaïe, le prophète:

verses.en: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
verses.fr: Le peuple de Zabulon et de Nephthali, De la contrée voisine de la mer, du pays au delà du Jourdain, Et de la Galilée des Gentils,

verses.en: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
verses.fr: Ce peuple, assis dans les ténèbres, A vu une grande lumière; Et sur ceux qui étaient assis dans la région et l''ombre de la mort La lumière s''est levée.
verses.am: በነቢዩም በኢሳይያስ። የዛብሎን ምድርና የንፍታሌም ምድር፥ የባሕር መንገድ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ፥ የአሕዛብ ገሊላ፤ በጨለማ የተቀመጠው ሕዝብ ታላቅ ብርሃን አየ፥ በሞት አገርና ጥላ ለተቀመጡትም ብርሃን ወጣላቸው

verses.en: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.fr: Dès ce moment Jésus commença à prêcher, et à dire: Repentez-vous, car le royaume des cieux est proche.
verses.am: የተባለው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሆነ። ከዚያ ዘመን ጀምሮ ኢየሱስ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለችና ንስሐ ግቡ እያለ ይሰብክ ጀመር።

verses.en: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.fr: Comme il marchait le long de la mer de Galilée, il vit deux frères, Simon, appelé Pierre, et André, son frère, qui jetaient un filet dans la mer; car ils étaient pêcheurs.
verses.am: በገሊላ ባሕር አጠገብ ሲመላለስም ሁለት ወንድማማች ጴጥሮስ የሚሉትን ስምዖንን ወንድሙንም እንድርያስን መረባቸውን ወደ ባሕር ሲጥሉ አየ፥ ዓሣ አጥማጆች ነበሩና።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Suivez-moi, et je vous ferai pêcheurs d''hommes.
verses.am: እርሱም። በኋላዬ ኑና ሰዎችን አጥማጆች እንድትሆኑ አደርጋችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
verses.fr: Aussitôt, ils laissèrent les filets, et le suivirent.
verses.am: ወዲያውም መረባቸውን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
verses.fr: De là étant allé plus loin, il vit deux autres frères, Jacques, fils de Zébédée, et Jean, son frère, qui étaient dans une barque avec Zébédée, leur père, et qui réparaient leurs filets. Il les appela,
verses.am: ከዚያም እልፍ ብሎ ሌሎችን ሁለት ወንድማማች የዘብዴዎስን ልጅ ያዕቆብን ወንድሙንም ዮሐንስን ከአባታቸው ከዘብዴዎስ ጋር በታንኳ መረባቸውን ሲያበጁ አየ፤ ጠራቸውም።

verses.en: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
verses.fr: et aussitôt ils laissèrent la barque et leur père, et le suivirent.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወዲያው ታንኳይቱንና አባታቸውን ትተው ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
verses.fr: Jésus parcourait toute la Galilée, enseignant dans les synagogues, prêchant la bonne nouvelle du royaume, et guérissant toute maladie et toute infirmité parmi le peuple.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በምኩራቦቻቸው እያስተማረ የመንግሥትንም ወንጌል እየሰበከ በሕዝብም ያለውን ደዌና ሕማም ሁሉ እየፈወሰ በገሊላ ሁሉ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.en: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
verses.fr: Sa renommée se répandit dans toute la Syrie, et on lui amenait tous ceux qui souffraient de maladies et de douleurs de divers genres, des démoniaques, des lunatiques, des paralytiques; et il les guérissait.
verses.am: ዝናውም ወደ ሶርያ ሁሉ ወጣ፤ በልዩ ልዩ ደዌና ሥቃይም ተይዘው የታመሙትን ሁሉ አጋንንትም ያደሩባቸውን በጨረቃም የሚነሣባቸውን ሽባዎችንም ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፥ ፈወሳቸውም።

verses.en: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
verses.fr: Une grande foule le suivit, de la Galilée, de la Décapole, de Jérusalem, de la Judée, et d''au delà du Jourdain.
verses.am: ከገሊላም ከአሥሩ ከተማም ከኢየሩሳሌምም ከይሁዳም ከዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
verses.fr: Voyant la foule, Jésus monta sur la montagne; et, après qu''il se fut assis, ses disciples s''approchèrent de lui.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም አይቶ ወደ ተራራ ወጣ፤ በተቀመጠም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፤

verses.en: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
verses.fr: Puis, ayant ouvert la bouche, il les enseigna, et dit:
verses.am: አፉንም ከፍቶ አስተማራቸው እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.fr: Heureux les pauvres en esprit, car le royaume des cieux est à eux!
verses.am: በመንፈስ ድሆች የሆኑ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናትና።

verses.en: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.fr: Heureux les affligés, car ils seront consolés!
verses.am: የሚያዝኑ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ መፅናናትን ያገኛሉና።

verses.en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.fr: Heureux les débonnaires, car ils hériteront la terre!
verses.am: የዋሆች ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ ምድርን ይወርሳሉና።

verses.en: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux qui ont faim et soif de la justice, car ils seront rassasiés!
verses.am: ጽድቅን የሚራቡና የሚጠሙ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ ይጠግባሉና።

verses.en: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.fr: Heureux les miséricordieux, car ils obtiendront miséricorde!
verses.am: የሚምሩ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ ይማራሉና።

verses.en: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux qui ont le coeur pur, car ils verront Dieu!
verses.am: ልበ ንጹሖች ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርን ያዩታልና።

verses.en: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux qui procurent la paix, car ils seront appelés fils de Dieu!
verses.am: የሚያስተራርቁ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ይባላሉና።

verses.en: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux qui sont persécutés pour la justice, car le royaume des cieux est à eux!
verses.am: ስለ ጽድቅ የሚሰደዱ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናትና።

verses.en: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.fr: Heureux serez-vous, lorsqu''on vous outragera, qu''on vous persécutera et qu''on dira faussement de vous toute sorte de mal, à cause de moi.
verses.am: ሲነቅፉአችሁና ሲያሳድዱአችሁ በእኔም ምክንያት ክፉውን ሁሉ በውሸት ሲናገሩባችሁ ብፁዓን ናችሁ።

verses.en: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.fr: Réjouissez-vous et soyez dans l''allégresse, parce que votre récompense sera grande dans les cieux; car c''est ainsi qu''on a persécuté les prophètes qui ont été avant vous.
verses.am: ዋጋችሁ በሰማያት ታላቅ ነውና ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ሐሴትም አድርጉ፤ ከእናንተ በፊት የነበሩትን ነቢያትን እንዲሁ አሳድደዋቸዋልና።

verses.en: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.fr: Vous êtes le sel de la terre. Mais si le sel perd sa saveur, avec quoi la lui rendra-t-on? Il ne sert plus qu''à être jeté dehors, et foulé aux pieds par les hommes.
verses.am: እናንተ የምድር ጨው ናችሁ፤ ጨው አልጫ ቢሆን ግን በምን ይጣፍጣል? ወደ ውጭ ተጥሎ በሰው ከመረገጥ በቀር ወደ ፊት ለምንም አይጠቅምም።

verses.en: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.fr: Vous êtes la lumière du monde. Une ville située sur une montagne ne peut être cachée;
verses.am: እናንተ የዓለም ብርሃን ናችሁ። በተራራ ላይ ያለች ከተማ ልትሰወር አይቻላትም።

verses.en: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verses.fr: et on n''allume pas une lampe pour la mettre sous le boisseau, mais on la met sur le chandelier, et elle éclaire tous ceux qui sont dans la maison.
verses.am: መብራትንም አብርተው ከዕንቅብ በታች አይደለም እንጂ በመቅረዙ ላይ ያኖሩታል በቤት ላሉት ሁሉም ያበራል።

verses.en: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.fr: Que votre lumière luise ainsi devant les hommes, afin qu''ils voient vos bonnes oeuvres, et qu''ils glorifient votre Père qui est dans les cieux.
verses.am: መልካሙን ሥራችሁን አይተው በሰማያት ያለውን አባታችሁን እንዲያከብሩ ብርሃናችሁ እንዲሁ በሰው ፊት ይብራ።

verses.en: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
verses.fr: Ne croyez pas que je sois venu pour abolir la loi ou les prophètes; je suis venu non pour abolir, mais pour accomplir.
verses.am: እኔ ሕግንና ነቢያትን ለመሻር የመጣሁ አይምሰላችሁ፤ ልፈጽም እንጂ ለመሻር አልመጣሁም።

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verses.fr: Car, je vous le dis en vérité, tant que le ciel et la terre ne passeront point, il ne disparaîtra pas de la loi un seul iota ou un seul trait de lettre, jusqu''à ce que tout soit arrivé.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰማይና ምድር እስኪያልፍ ድረስ፥ ከሕግ አንዲት የውጣ ወይም አንዲት ነጥብ ከቶ አታልፍም፥ ሁሉ እስኪፈጸም ድረስ።

verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.fr: Celui donc qui supprimera l''un de ces plus petits commandements, et qui enseignera aux hommes à faire de même, sera appelé le plus petit dans le royaume des cieux; mais celui qui les observera, et qui enseignera à les observer, celui-là sera appelé grand dans le royaume des cieux.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከነዚህ ከሁሉ ካነሱት ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን የሚሽር ለሰውም እንዲሁ የሚያስተምር ማንም ሰው በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ከሁሉ ታናሽ ይባላል፤ የሚያደርግ ግን የሚያስተምርም ማንም ቢሆን እርሱ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ታላቅ ይባላል።

verses.en: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.fr: Car, je vous le dis, si votre justice ne surpasse celle des scribes et des pharisiens, vous n''entrerez point dans le royaume des cieux.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁና። ጽድቃችሁ ከጻፎችና ከፈሪሳውያን ጽድቅ ካልበለጠ፥ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ከቶ አትገቡም።

verses.en: Ye have heard that it was said of them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
verses.fr: Vous avez entendu qu''il a été dit aux anciens: Tu ne tueras point; celui qui tuera mérite d''être puni par les juges.
verses.am: ለቀደሙት። አትግደል እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል፤ የገደለም ሁሉ ፍርድ ይገባዋል።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.fr: Mais moi, je vous dis que quiconque se met en colère contre son frère mérite d''être puni par les juges; que celui qui dira à son frère: Raca! mérite d''être puni par le sanhédrin; et que celui qui lui dira: Insensé! mérite d''être puni par le feu de la géhenne.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በወንድሙ ላይ የሚቆጣ ሁሉ ፍርድ ይገባዋል፤ ወንድሙንም ጨርቃም የሚለው ሁሉ የሸንጎ ፍርድ ይገባዋል፤ ደንቆሮ የሚለውም ሁሉ የገሃነመ እሳት ፍርድ ይገባዋል።

verses.en: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
verses.fr: Si donc tu présentes ton offrande à l''autel, et que là tu te souviennes que ton frère a quelque chose contre toi,
verses.am: እንግዲህ መባህን በመሠዊያው ላይ ብታቀርብ፥ በዚያም ወንድምህ አንዳች በአንተ ላይ እንዳለው ብታስብ፥

verses.en: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
verses.fr: laisse là ton offrande devant l''autel, et va d''abord te réconcilier avec ton frère; puis, viens présenter ton offrande.
verses.am: በዚያ በመሠዊያው ፊት መባህን ትተህ ሂድ፥ አስቀድመህም ከወንድምህ ጋር ታረቅ፥ በኋላም መጥተህ መባህን አቅርብ።

verses.en: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
verses.fr: Accorde-toi promptement avec ton adversaire, pendant que tu es en chemin avec lui, de peur qu''il ne te livre au juge, que le juge ne te livre à l''officier de justice, et que tu ne sois mis en prison.
verses.am: አብረኸው በመንገድ ሳለህ ከባላጋራህ ጋር ፈጥነህ ተስማማ፤ ባላጋራ ለዳኛ እንዳይሰጥህ ዳኛም ለሎሌው፥ ወደ ወህኒም ትጣላለህ፤

verses.en: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
verses.fr: Je te le dis en vérité, tu ne sortiras pas de là que tu n''aies payé le dernier quadrant.
verses.am: እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ የመጨረሻዋን ሳንቲም እስክትከፍል ድረስ ከቶ ከዚያ አትወጣም።

verses.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
verses.fr: Vous avez appris qu''il a été dit: Tu ne commettras point d''adultère.
verses.am: አታመንዝር እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.fr: Mais moi, je vous dis que quiconque regarde une femme pour la convoiter a déjà commis un adultère avec elle dans son coeur.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ወደ ሴት ያየ ሁሉ የተመኛትም ያን ጊዜ በልቡ ከእርስዋ ጋር አመንዝሮአል።

verses.en: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.fr: Si ton oeil droit est pour toi une occasion de chute, arrache-le et jette-le loin de toi; car il est avantageux pour toi qu''un seul de tes membres périsse, et que ton corps entier ne soit pas jeté dans la géhenne.
verses.am: ቀኝ ዓይንህም ብታሰናክልህ አውጥተህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሙሉ ሰውነትህ በገሃነም ከሚጣል ይልቅ ከአካላትህ አንድ ቢጠፋ ይሻልሃልና።

verses.en: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.fr: Et si ta main droite est pour toi une occasion de chute, coupe-la et jette-la loin de toi; car il est avantageux pour toi qu''un seul de tes membres périsse, et que ton corps entier n''aille pas dans la géhenne.
verses.am: ቀኝ እጅህም ብታሰናክልህ ቆርጠህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሙሉ ሰውነትህ በገሃነም ከሚጣል ይልቅ ከአካላትህ አንድ ቢጠፋ ይሻላልና።

verses.en: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
verses.fr: Il a été dit: Que celui qui répudie sa femme lui donne une lettre de divorce.
verses.am: ሚስቱን የሚፈታት ሁሉ የፍችዋን ጽሕፈት ይስጣት ተባለ።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
verses.fr: Mais moi, je vous dis que celui qui répudie sa femme, sauf pour cause d''infidélité, l''expose à devenir adultère, et que celui qui épouse une femme répudiée commet un adultère.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ያለ ዝሙት ምክንያት ሚስቱን የሚፈታ ሁሉ አመንዝራ ያደርጋታል፥ የተፈታችውንም የሚያገባ ሁሉ ያመነዝራል።

verses.en: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
verses.fr: Vous avez encore appris qu''il a été dit aux anciens: Tu ne te parjureras point, mais tu t''acquitteras envers le Seigneur de ce que tu as déclaré par serment.
verses.am: ደግሞ ለቀደሙት። በውሸት አትማል ነገር ግን መሐላዎችህን ለጌታ ስጥ እንደተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.en: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
verses.fr: Mais moi, je vous dis de ne jurer aucunement, ni par le ciel, parce que c''est le trône de Dieu;
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ። ከቶ አትማሉ፤ በሰማይ አይሆንም የእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ነውና፤

verses.en: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
verses.fr: ni par la terre, parce que c''est son marchepied; ni par Jérusalem, parce que c''est la ville du grand roi.
verses.am: በምድርም አይሆንም የእግሩ መረገጫ ናትና፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አይሆንም የታላቁ ንጉሥ ከተማ ናትና፤

verses.en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
verses.fr: Ne jure pas non plus par ta tête, car tu ne peux rendre blanc ou noir un seul cheveu.
verses.am: በራስህም አትማል፥ አንዲቱን ጠጉር ነጭ ወይም ጥቁር ልታደርግ አትችልምና።

verses.en: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
verses.fr: Que votre parole soit oui, oui, non, non; ce qu''on y ajoute vient du malin.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ቃላችሁ አዎን አዎን ወይም አይደለም አይደለም ይሁን፤ ከነዚህም የወጣ ከክፉው ነው።

verses.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
verses.fr: Vous avez appris qu''il a été dit: oeil pour oeil, et dent pour dent.
verses.am: ዓይን ስለ ዓይን ጥርስም ስለ ጥርስ እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.fr: Mais moi, je vous dis de ne pas résister au méchant. Si quelqu''un te frappe sur la joue droite, présente-lui aussi l''autre.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ክፉውን አትቃወሙ፤ ዳሩ ግን ቀኝ ጉንጭህን በጥፊ ለሚመታህ ሁሉ ሁለተኛውን ደግሞ አዙርለት፤

verses.en: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un veut plaider contre toi, et prendre ta tunique, laisse-lui encore ton manteau.
verses.am: እንዲከስህም እጀ ጠባብህንም እንዲወስድ ለሚወድ መጎናጸፊያህን ደግሞ ተውለት፤

verses.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un te force à faire un mille, fais-en deux avec lui.
verses.am: ማንም ሰው አንድ ምዕራፍ ትሄድ ዘንድ ቢያስገድድህ ሁለተኛውን ከእርሱ ጋር ሂድ።

verses.en: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
verses.fr: Donne à celui qui te demande, et ne te détourne pas de celui qui veut emprunter de toi.
verses.am: ለሚለምንህ ስጥ፥ ከአንተም ይበደር ዘንድ ከሚወደው ፈቀቅ አትበል።

verses.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
verses.fr: Vous avez appris qu''il a été dit: Tu aimeras ton prochain, et tu haïras ton ennemi.
verses.am: ባልንጀራህን ውደድ ጠላትህንም ጥላ እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።

verses.en: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
verses.fr: Mais moi, je vous dis: Aimez vos ennemis, bénissez ceux qui vous maudissent, faites du bien à ceux qui vous haïssent, et priez pour ceux qui vous maltraitent et qui vous persécutent,

verses.en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.fr: afin que vous soyez fils de votre Père qui est dans les cieux; car il fait lever son soleil sur les méchants et sur les bons, et il fait pleuvoir sur les justes et sur les injustes.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በሰማያት ላለ አባታችሁ ልጆች ትሆኑ ዘንድ ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፥ የሚረግሙአችሁንም መርቁ፥ ለሚጠሉአችሁም መልካም አድርጉ፥ ስለሚያሳድዱአችሁም ጸልዩ፤ እርሱ በክፎዎችና በበጎዎች ላይ ፀሐይን ያወጣልና፥ በጻድቃንና በኃጢአተኞችም ላይ ዝናቡን ያዘንባልና።

verses.en: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
verses.fr: Si vous aimez ceux qui vous aiment, quelle récompense méritez-vous? Les publicains aussi n''agissent-ils pas de même?
verses.am: የሚወዱአችሁን ብትወዱ ምን ዋጋ አላችሁ? ቀራጮችስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?

verses.en: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
verses.fr: Et si vous saluez seulement vos frères, que faites-vous d''extraordinaire? Les païens aussi n''agissent-ils pas de même?
verses.am: ወንድሞቻችሁንም ብቻ እጅ ብትነሡ ምን ብልጫ ታደርጋላችሁ? አሕዛብስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?

verses.en: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
verses.fr: Soyez donc parfaits, comme votre Père céleste est parfait.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ ፍጹም እንደ ሆነ እናንተ ፍጹማን ሁኑ።

verses.en: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
verses.fr: Gardez-vous de pratiquer votre justice devant les hommes, pour en être vus; autrement, vous n''aurez point de récompense auprès de votre Père qui est dans les cieux.
verses.am: ለሰዎች ትታዩ ዘንድ ምጽዋታችሁን በፊታቸው እንዳታደርጉ ተጠንቀቁ፤ ያለዚያ በሰማያት ባለው አባታችሁ ዘንድ ዋጋ የላችሁም።

verses.en: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.fr: Lors donc que tu fais l''aumône, ne sonne pas de la trompette devant toi, comme font les hypocrites dans les synagogues et dans les rues, afin d''être glorifiés par les hommes. Je vous le dis en vérité, ils reçoivent leur récompense.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምጽዋት ስታደርግ፥ ግብዞች በሰው ዘንድ ሊከበሩ በምኩራብ በመንገድም እንደሚያደርጉ በፊትህ መለከት አታስነፋ፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.en: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
verses.fr: Mais quand tu fais l''aumône, que ta main gauche ne sache pas ce que fait ta droite,

verses.en: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
verses.fr: afin que ton aumône se fasse en secret; et ton Père, qui voit dans le secret, te le rendra.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ምጽዋት ስታደርግ ምጽዋትህ በስውር እንዲሆን ቀኝህ የምትሠራውን ግራህ አትወቅ፤ በስውር የሚያይ አባትህም በግልጥ ይከፍልሃል።

verses.en: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.fr: Lorsque vous priez, ne soyez pas comme les hypocrites, qui aiment à prier debout dans les synagogues et aux coins des rues, pour être vus des hommes. Je vous le dis en vérité, ils reçoivent leur récompense.
verses.am: ስትጸልዩም እንደ ግብዞች አትሁኑ፤ ለሰው ይታዩ ዘንድ በምኩራብና በመንገድ ማዕዘን ቆመው መጸለይን ይወዳሉና፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.en: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
verses.fr: Mais quand tu pries, entre dans ta chambre, ferme ta porte, et prie ton Père qui est là dans le lieu secret; et ton Père, qui voit dans le secret, te le rendra.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ስትጸልይ፥ ወደ እልፍኝህ ግባ መዝጊያህንም ዘግተህ በስውር ላለው አባትህ ጸልይ፤ በስውር የሚያይ አባትህም በግልጥ ይከፍልሃል።

verses.en: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
verses.fr: En priant, ne multipliez pas de vaines paroles, comme les païens, qui s''imaginent qu''à force de paroles ils seront exaucés.
verses.am: አሕዛብም በመናገራቸው ብዛት እንዲሰሙ ይመስላቸዋልና ስትጸልዩ እንደ እነርሱ በከንቱ አትድገሙ።

verses.en: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
verses.fr: Ne leur ressemblez pas; car votre Père sait de quoi vous avez besoin, avant que vous le lui demandiez.
verses.am: ስለዚህ አትምሰሉአቸው፤ ሳትለምኑት አባታችሁ የሚያስፈልጋችሁን ያውቃልና።

verses.en: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verses.fr: Voici donc comment vous devez prier: Notre Père qui es aux cieux! Que ton nom soit sanctifié;
verses.am: እንግዲህ እናንተስ እንዲህ ጸልዩ። በሰማያት የምትኖር አባታችን ሆይ፥

verses.en: Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
verses.fr: que ton règne vienne; que ta volonté soit faite sur la terre comme au ciel.
verses.am: ስምህ ይቀደስ፤ መንግሥትህ ትምጣ፤ ፈቃድህ በሰማይ እንደ ሆነች እንዲሁ በምድር ትሁን፤

verses.en: Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.fr: Donne-nous aujourd''hui notre pain quotidien;
verses.am: የዕለት እንጀራችንን ዛሬ ስጠን፤

verses.en: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
verses.fr: pardonne-nous nos offenses, comme nous aussi nous pardonnons à ceux qui nous ont offensés;
verses.am: እኛም ደግሞ የበደሉንን ይቅር እንደምንል በደላችንን ይቅር በለን፤

verses.en: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
verses.fr: ne nous induis pas en tentation, mais délivre-nous du malin. Car c''est à toi qu''appartiennent, dans tous les siècles, le règne, la puissance et la gloire. Amen!
verses.am: ከክፉም አድነን እንጂ ወደ ፈተና አታግባን፤ መንግሥት ያንተ ናትና ኃይልም ክብርም ለዘለዓለሙ፤ አሜን።

verses.en: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
verses.fr: Si vous pardonnez aux hommes leurs offenses, votre Père céleste vous pardonnera aussi;
verses.am: ለሰዎች ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር ብትሉ፥ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ እናንተን ደግሞ ይቅር ይላችኋልና፤

verses.en: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.fr: mais si vous ne pardonnez pas aux hommes, votre Père ne vous pardonnera pas non plus vos offenses.
verses.am: ለሰዎች ግን ኃጢአታቸውን ይቅር ባትሉ፥ አባታችሁም ኃጢአታችሁን ይቅር አይላችሁም።

verses.en: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.fr: Lorsque vous jeûnez, ne prenez pas un air triste, comme les hypocrites, qui se rendent le visage tout défait, pour montrer aux hommes qu''ils jeûnent. Je vous le dis en vérité, ils reçoivent leur récompense.
verses.am: ስትጦሙም፥ እንደ ግብዞች አትጠውልጉ፤ ለሰዎች እንደ ጦመኛ ሊታዩ ፊታቸውን ያጠፋሉና፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋቸውን ተቀብለዋል።

verses.en: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
verses.fr: Mais quand tu jeûnes, parfume ta tête et lave ton visage,
verses.am: ብልና ዝገት በሚያጠፉት ሌቦችም ቆፍረው በሚሠርቁት ዘንድ ለእናንተ በምድር ላይ መዝገብ አትሰብስቡ፤

verses.en: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
verses.fr: afin de ne pas montrer aux hommes que tu jeûnes, mais à ton Père qui est là dans le lieu secret; et ton Père, qui voit dans le secret, te le rendra.
verses.am: ብልና ዝገት በሚያጠፉት ሌቦችም ቆፍረው በሚሠርቁት ዘንድ ለእናንተ በምድር ላይ መዝገብ አትሰብስቡ፤

verses.en: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
verses.fr: Ne vous amassez pas des trésors sur la terre, où la teigne et la rouille détruisent, et où les voleurs percent et dérobent;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ብልም ዝገትም በማያጠፉት ሌቦችም ቆፍረው በማይሠርቁት ዘንድ ለእናንተ በሰማይ መዝገብ ሰብስቡ፤

verses.en: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
verses.fr: mais amassez-vous des trésors dans le ciel, où la teigne et la rouille ne détruisent point, et où les voleurs ne percent ni ne dérobent.
verses.am: መዝገብህ ባለበት ልብህ ደግሞ በዚያ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.fr: Car là où est ton trésor, là aussi sera ton coeur.
verses.am: የሰውነት መብራት ዓይን ናት። ዓይንህ እንግዲህ ጤናማ ብትሆን፥ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ ብሩህ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
verses.fr: L''oeil est la lampe du corps. Si ton oeil est en bon état, tout ton corps sera éclairé;
verses.am: ዓይንህ ግን ታማሚ ብትሆን፥ ሰውነትህ ሁሉ የጨለመ ይሆናል። እንግዲህ በአንተ ያለው ብርሃን ጨለማ ከሆነ፥ ጨለማውስ እንዴት ይበረታ!

verses.en: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
verses.fr: mais si ton oeil est en mauvais état, tout ton corps sera dans les ténèbres. Si donc la lumière qui est en toi est ténèbres, combien seront grandes ces ténèbres!
verses.am: ለሁለት ጌቶች መገዛት የሚቻለው ማንም የለም፤ ወይም አንዱን ይጠላል ሁለተኛውንም ይወዳል፤ ወይም ወደ አንዱ ይጠጋል ሁለተኛውንም ይንቃል፤ ለእግዚአብሔርና ለገንዘብ መገዛት አትችሉም።

verses.en: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.fr: Nul ne peut servir deux maîtres. Car, ou il haïra l''un, et aimera l''autre; ou il s''attachera à l''un, et méprisera l''autre. Vous ne pouvez servir Dieu et Mamon.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ ስለ ነፍሳችሁ በምትበሉትና በምትጠጡት፥ ወይም ስለ ሰውነታችሁ በምትለብሱት አትጨነቁ፤ ነፍስ ከመብል ሰውነትም ከልብስ አይበልጥምን?

verses.en: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je vous dis: Ne vous inquiétez pas pour votre vie de ce que vous mangerez, ni pour votre corps, de quoi vous serez vêtus. La vie n''est-elle pas plus que la nourriture, et le corps plus que le vêtement?
verses.am: ወደ ሰማይ ወፎች ተመልከቱ፤ አይዘሩም አያጭዱምም በጎተራም አይከቱም፥ የሰማዩ አባታችሁም ይመግባቸዋል፤ እናንተ ከእነርሱ እጅግ አትበልጡምን?

verses.en: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
verses.fr: Regardez les oiseaux du ciel: ils ne sèment ni ne moissonnent, et ils n''amassent rien dans des greniers; et votre Père céleste les nourrit. Ne valez-vous pas beaucoup plus qu''eux?
verses.am: ከእናንተ ተጨንቆ በቁመቱ ላይ አንድ ክንድ መጨመር የሚችል ማን ነው?

verses.en: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
verses.fr: Qui de vous, par ses inquiétudes, peut ajouter une coudée à la durée de sa vie?
verses.am: ስለ ልብስስ ስለ ምን ትጨነቃላችሁ? የሜዳ አበቦች እንዴት እንዲያድጉ ልብ አድርጋችሁ ተመልከቱ፤

verses.en: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
verses.fr: Et pourquoi vous inquiéter au sujet du vêtement? Considérez comment croissent les lis des champs: ils ne travaillent ni ne filent;
verses.am: አይደክሙም አይፈትሉምም፤ ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰሎሞንስ እንኳ በክብሩ ሁሉ ከነዚህ እንደ አንዱ አልለበሰም።

verses.en: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.fr: cependant je vous dis que Salomon même, dans toute sa gloire, n''a pas été vêtu comme l''un d''eux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ዛሬ ያለውን ነገም ወደ እቶን የሚጣለውን የሜዳን ሣር እንዲህ የሚያለብሰው ከሆነ፥ እናንተ እምነት የጎደላችሁ፥ እናንተንማ ይልቁን እንዴት?

verses.en: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
verses.fr: Si Dieu revêt ainsi l''herbe des champs, qui existe aujourd''hui et qui demain sera jetée au four, ne vous vêtira-t-il pas à plus forte raison, gens de peu de foi?
verses.am: እንግዲህ። ምን እንበላለን? ምንስ እንጠጣለን? ምንስ እንለብሳለን? ብላችሁ አትጨነቁ፤

verses.en: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
verses.fr: Ne vous inquiétez donc point, et ne dites pas: Que mangerons-nous? que boirons-nous? de quoi serons-nous vêtus?
verses.am: ይህንስ ሁሉ አሕዛብ ይፈልጋሉ፤ ይህ ሁሉ እንዲያስፈልጋችሁ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ ያውቃልና።

verses.en: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
verses.fr: Car toutes ces choses, ce sont les païens qui les recherchent. Votre Père céleste sait que vous en avez besoin.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አስቀድማችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ጽድቁንም ፈልጉ፥ ይህም ሁሉ ይጨመርላችኋል።

verses.en: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.fr: Cherchez premièrement le royaume et la justice de Dieu; et toutes ces choses vous seront données par-dessus.
verses.am: ነገ ለራሱ ይጨነቃልና ለነገ አትጨነቁ፤ ለቀኑ ክፋቱ ይበቃዋል።

verses.en: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
verses.fr: Ne vous inquiétez donc pas du lendemain; car le lendemain aura soin de lui-même. A chaque jour suffit sa peine.
verses.am: ነገ ለራሱ ይጨነቃልና ለነገ አትጨነቁ፤ ለቀኑ ክፋቱ ይበቃዋል።

verses.en: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
verses.fr: Ne jugez point, afin que vous ne soyez point jugés.
verses.am: እንዳይፈረድባችሁ አትፍረዱ፤

verses.en: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
verses.fr: Car on vous jugera du jugement dont vous jugez, et l''on vous mesurera avec la mesure dont vous mesurez.
verses.am: በምትፈርዱበት ፍርድ ይፈረድባችኋልና፥ በምትሰፍሩበትም መስፈሪያ ይሰፈርባችኋል።

verses.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.fr: Pourquoi vois-tu la paille qui est dans l''oeil de ton frère, et n''aperçois-tu pas la poutre qui est dans ton oeil?
verses.am: በወንድምህም ዓይን ያለውን ጉድፍ ስለምን ታያለህ፥ በዓይንህ ግን ያለውን ምሰሶ ስለ ምን አትመለከትም?

verses.en: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
verses.fr: Ou comment peux-tu dire à ton frère: Laisse-moi ôter une paille de ton oeil, toi qui as une poutre dans le tien?
verses.am: ወይም ወንድምህን። ከዓይንህ ጉድፍ ላውጣ ፍቀድልኝ እንዴትስ ትለዋለህ? እነሆም፥ በዓይንህ ምሰሶ አለ።

verses.en: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
verses.fr: Hypocrite, ôte premièrement la poutre de ton oeil, et alors tu verras comment ôter la paille de l''oeil de ton frère.
verses.am: አንተ ግብዝ፥ አስቀድመህ ከዓይንህ ምሰሶውን አውጣ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ከወንድምህ ዓይን ጉድፉን ታወጣ ዘንድ አጥርተህ ታያለህ።

verses.en: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
verses.fr: Ne donnez pas les choses saintes aux chiens, et ne jetez pas vos perles devant les pourceaux, de peur qu''ils ne les foulent aux pieds, ne se retournent et ne vous déchirent.
verses.am: በእግራቸው እንዳይረግጡት ተመልሰውም እንዳይነክሱአችሁ፥ የተቀደሰውን ለውሾች አትስጡ፥ ዕንቁዎቻችሁንም በእሪያዎች ፊት አትጣሉ።

verses.en: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.fr: Demandez, et l''on vous donnera; cherchez, et vous trouverez; frappez, et l''on vous ouvrira.
verses.am: ለምኑ፥ ይሰጣችሁማል፤ ፈልጉ፥ ታገኙማላችሁ፤ መዝጊያን አንኳኩ፥ ይከፈትላችሁማል።

verses.en: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.fr: Car quiconque demande reçoit, celui qui cherche trouve, et l''on ouvre à celui qui frappe.
verses.am: የሚለምነው ሁሉ ይቀበላልና፥ የሚፈልገውም ያገኛል፥ መዝጊያንም ለሚያንኳኳ ይከፈትለታል።

verses.en: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
verses.fr: Lequel de vous donnera une pierre à son fils, s''il lui demande du pain?
verses.am: ወይስ ከእናንተ፥ ልጁ እንጀራ ቢለምነው፥ ድንጋይን የሚሰጠው ከእናንተ ማን ሰው ነው?

verses.en: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
verses.fr: Ou, s''il demande un poisson, lui donnera-t-il un serpent?
verses.am: ዓሣስ ቢለምነው እባብን ይሰጠዋልን?

verses.en: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verses.fr: Si donc, méchants comme vous l''êtes, vous savez donner de bonnes choses à vos enfants, à combien plus forte raison votre Père qui est dans les cieux donnera-t-il de bonnes choses à ceux qui les lui demandent.
verses.am: እንኪያስ እናንተ ክፉዎች ስትሆኑ ለልጆቻችሁ መልካም ስጦታ መስጠትን ካወቃችሁ፥ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁ ለሚለምኑት እንዴት አብልጦ መልካም ነገርን ይሰጣቸው?

verses.en: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.fr: Tout ce que vous voulez que les hommes fassent pour vous, faites-le de même pour eux, car c''est la loi et les prophètes.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሰዎች ሊያደርጉላችሁ የምትወዱትን ሁሉ እናንተ ደግሞ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው፤ ሕግም ነቢያትም ይህ ነውና።

verses.en: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
verses.fr: Entrez par la porte étroite. Car large est la porte, spacieux est le chemin qui mènent à la perdition, et il y en a beaucoup qui entrent par là.
verses.am: በጠበበው ደጅ ግቡ፤ ወደ ጥፋት የሚወስደው ደጅ ሰፊ፥ መንገዱም ትልቅ ነውና፥ ወደ እርሱም የሚገቡ ብዙዎች ናቸው፤

verses.en: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
verses.fr: Mais étroite est la porte, resserré le chemin qui mènent à la vie, et il y en a peu qui les trouvent.
verses.am: ወደ ሕይወት የሚወስደው ደጅ የጠበበ፥ መንገዱም የቀጠነ ነውና፥ የሚያገኙትም ጥቂቶች ናቸው።

verses.en: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
verses.fr: Gardez-vous des faux prophètes. Ils viennent à vous en vêtements de brebis, mais au dedans ce sont des loups ravisseurs.
verses.am: የበግ ለምድ ለብሰው ከሚመጡባችሁ በውሥጣቸው ግን ነጣቂዎች ተኵላዎች ከሆኑ ከሐሰተኞች ነቢያት ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
verses.fr: Vous les reconnaîtrez à leurs fruits. Cueille-t-on des raisins sur des épines, ou des figues sur des chardons?
verses.am: ከፍሬያቸው ታውቋቸዋላችሁ። ከእሾህ ወይን ከኩርንችትስ በለስ ይለቀማልን?

verses.en: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
verses.fr: Tout bon arbre porte de bons fruits, mais le mauvais arbre porte de mauvais fruits.
verses.am: እንዲሁ መልካም ዛፍ ሁሉ መልካም ፍሬ ያደርጋል፥ ክፉም ዛፍ ክፉ ፍሬ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.fr: Un bon arbre ne peut porter de mauvais fruits, ni un mauvais arbre porter de bons fruits.
verses.am: መልካም ዛፍ ክፉ ፍሬ ማፍራት፥ ወይም ክፉ ዛፍ መልካም ፍሬ ማፍራት አይቻለውም።

verses.en: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.fr: Tout arbre qui ne porte pas de bons fruits est coupé et jeté au feu.
verses.am: መልካም ፍሬ የማያደርግ ዛፍ ሁሉ ይቆረጣል ወደ እሳትም ይጣላል።

verses.en: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
verses.fr: C''est donc à leurs fruits que vous les reconnaîtrez.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ከፍሬያቸው ታውቋቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.fr: Ceux qui me disent: Seigneur, Seigneur! n''entreront pas tous dans le royaume des cieux, mais celui-là seul qui fait la volonté de mon Père qui est dans les cieux.
verses.am: በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ እንጂ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ የሚለኝ ሁሉ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የሚገባ አይደለም።

verses.en: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
verses.fr: Plusieurs me diront en ce jour-là: Seigneur, Seigneur, n''avons-nous pas prophétisé par ton nom? n''avons-nous pas chassé des démons par ton nom? et n''avons-nous pas fait beaucoup de miracles par ton nom?
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ብዙዎች። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ጌታ ሆይ፥ በስምህ ትንቢት አልተናገርንምን፥ በስምህስ አጋንንትን አላወጣንምን፥ በስምህስ ብዙ ተአምራትን አላደረግንምን? ይሉኛል።

verses.en: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
verses.fr: Alors je leur dirai ouvertement: Je ne vous ai jamais connus, retirez-vous de moi, vous qui commettez l''iniquité.
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜም። ከቶ አላወቅኋችሁም፤ እናንተ ዓመፀኞች፥ ከእኔ ራቁ ብዬ እመሰክርባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, quiconque entend ces paroles que je dis et les met en pratique, sera semblable à un homme prudent qui a bâti sa maison sur le roc.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ይህን ቃሌን ሰምቶ የሚያደርገው ሁሉ ቤቱን በዓለት ላይ የሠራ ልባም ሰውን ይመስላል።

verses.en: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.fr: La pluie est tombée, les torrents sont venus, les vents ont soufflé et se sont jetés contre cette maison: elle n''est point tombée, parce qu''elle était fondée sur le roc.
verses.am: ዝናብም ወረደ ጎርፍም መጣ ነፋስም ነፈሰ ያንም ቤት ገፋው፥ በዓለት ላይም ስለ ተመሠረተ አልወደቀም።

verses.en: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
verses.fr: Mais quiconque entend ces paroles que je dis, et ne les met pas en pratique, sera semblable à un homme insensé qui a bâti sa maison sur le sable.
verses.am: ይህንም ቃሌን ሰምቶ የማያደርገው ሰው ሁሉ ቤቱን በአሸዋ ላይ የሠራ ሰነፍ ሰውን ይመስላል።

verses.en: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
verses.fr: La pluie est tombée, les torrents sont venus, les vents ont soufflé et ont battu cette maison: elle est tombée, et sa ruine a été grande.
verses.am: ዝናብም ወረደ ጎርፍም መጣ ነፋስም ነፈሰ ያንም ቤት መታው፥ ወደቀም፥ አወዳደቁም ታላቅ ሆነ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
verses.fr: Après que Jésus eut achevé ces discours, la foule fut frappée de sa doctrine;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ነገር በጨረሰ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ፤ እንደ ጻፎቻቸው ሳይሆን

verses.en: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.fr: car il enseignait comme ayant autorité, et non pas comme leurs scribes.
verses.am: እንደ ባለ ሥልጣን ያስተምራቸው ነበርና።

verses.en: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus fut descendu de la montagne, une grande foule le suivit.
verses.am: ከተራራም በወረደ ጊዜ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.fr: Et voici, un lépreux s''étant approché se prosterna devant lui, et dit: Seigneur, si tu le veux, tu peux me rendre pur.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ለምጻም ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ብትወድስ ልታነጻኝ ትችላለህ እያለ ሰገደለት።

verses.en: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.fr: Jésus étendit la main, le toucha, et dit: Je le veux, sois pur. Aussitôt il fut purifié de sa lèpre.
verses.am: እጁንም ዘርግቶ ዳሰሰውና። እወዳለሁ፥ ንጻ አለው። ወዲያውም ለምጹ ነጻ።

verses.en: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.fr: Puis Jésus lui dit: Garde-toi d''en parler à personne; mais va te montrer au sacrificateur, et présente l''offrande que Moïse a prescrite, afin que cela leur serve de témoignage.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ለማንም እንዳትናገር ተጠንቀቅ፥ ነገር ግን ሄደህ ራስህን ለካህን አሳይ፥ ለእነርሱም ምስክር እንዲሆን ሙሴ ያዘዘውን መባ አቅርብ አለው።

verses.en: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
verses.fr: Comme Jésus entrait dans Capernaüm, un centenier l''aborda, le priant
verses.am: ወደ ቅፍርናሆምም በገባ ጊዜ የመቶ አለቃ ወደ እርሱ ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥

verses.en: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
verses.fr: et disant: Seigneur, mon serviteur est couché à la maison, atteint de paralysie et souffrant beaucoup.
verses.am: ብላቴናዬ ሽባ ሆኖ እጅግ እየተሣቀየ በቤት ተኝቶአል ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.en: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: J''irai, et je le guérirai.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔ መጥቼ እፈውሰዋለሁ አለው።

verses.en: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.fr: Le centenier répondit: Seigneur, je ne suis pas digne que tu entres sous mon toit; mais dis seulement un mot, et mon serviteur sera guéri.
verses.am: የመቶ አለቃውም መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በቤቴ ጣራ ከታች ልትገባ አይገባኝም፤ ነገር ግን ቃል ብቻ ተናገር፥ ብላቴናዬም ይፈወሳል።

verses.en: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.fr: Car, moi qui suis soumis à des supérieurs, j''ai des soldats sous mes ordres; et je dis à l''un: Va! et il va; à l''autre: Viens! et il vient; et à mon serviteur: Fais cela! et il le fait.
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ ለሌሎች ተገዥ ነኝና፥ ከእኔም በታች ጭፍራ አለኝ፤ አንዱንም። ሂድ ብለው ይሄዳል፥ ሌላውንም። ና ብለው ይመጣል፥ ባሪያዬንም። ይህን አድርግ ብለው ያደርጋል አለው።

verses.en: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.fr: Après l''avoir entendu, Jésus fut dans l''étonnement, et il dit à ceux qui le suivaient: Je vous le dis en vérité, même en Israël je n''ai pas trouvé une aussi grande foi.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሰምቶ ተደነቀና ለተከተሉት እንዲህ አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በእስራኤል እንኳ እንዲህ ያለ ትልቅ እምነት አላገኘሁም።

verses.en: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.fr: Or, je vous déclare que plusieurs viendront de l''orient et de l''occident, et seront à table avec Abraham, Isaac et Jacob, dans le royaume des cieux.
verses.am: እላችኋለሁም፥ ብዙዎች ከምሥራቅና ከምዕራብ ይመጣሉ ከአብርሃምና ከይስሐቅ ከያዕቆብም ጋር በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ይቀመጣሉ፤

verses.en: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.fr: Mais les fils du royaume seront jetés dans les ténèbres du dehors, où il y aura des pleurs et des grincements de dents.
verses.am: የመንግሥት ልጆች ግን በውጭ ወደ አለው ጨለማ ይጣላሉ፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
verses.fr: Puis Jésus dit au centenier: Va, qu''il te soit fait selon ta foi. Et à l''heure même le serviteur fut guéri.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ለመቶ አለቃ። ሂድና እንዳመንህ ይሁንልህ አለው። ብላቴናውም በዚያች ሰዓት ተፈወሰ።

verses.en: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
verses.fr: Jésus se rendit ensuite à la maison de Pierre, dont il vit la belle-mère couchée et ayant la fièvre.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ ጴጥሮስ ቤት ገብቶ አማቱን በንዳድ ታማ ተኝታ አያት፤

verses.en: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
verses.fr: Il toucha sa main, et la fièvre la quitta; puis elle se leva, et le servit.
verses.am: እጅዋንም ዳሰሰ፥ ንዳዱም ለቀቃት፤ ተነሥታም አገለገለቻቸው።

verses.en: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
verses.fr: Le soir, on amena auprès de Jésus plusieurs démoniaques. Il chassa les esprits par sa parole, et il guérit tous les malades,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ብዙ ሰዎች ሲከቡት አይቶ ወደ ማዶ እንዲሻገሩ አዘዘ።

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
verses.fr: afin que s''accomplît ce qui avait été annoncé par Esaïe, le prophète: Il a pris nos infirmités, et il s''est chargé de nos maladies.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ብዙ ሰዎች ሲከቡት አይቶ ወደ ማዶ እንዲሻገሩ አዘዘ።

verses.en: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
verses.fr: Jésus, voyant une grande foule autour de lui, donna l''ordre de passer à l''autre bord.
verses.am: አንድ ጻፊም ቀርቦ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ወደምትሄድበት ሁሉ እከተልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.fr: Un scribe s''approcha, et lui dit: Maître, je te suivrai partout où tu iras.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ለቀበሮዎች ጉድጓድ ለሰማይም ወፎች መሳፈሪያ አላቸው፥ ለሰው ልጅ ግን ራሱን የሚያስጠጋበት የለውም አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Les renards ont des tanières, et les oiseaux du ciel ont des nids; mais le Fils de l''homme n''a pas où reposer sa tête.
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሌላው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አስቀድሜ እንድሄድ አባቴን እንድቀብር ፍቀድልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.fr: Un autre, d''entre les disciples, lui dit: Seigneur, permets-moi d''aller d''abord ensevelir mon père.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ተከተለኝ፥ ሙታናቸውንም እንዲቀብሩ ሙታንን ተዋቸው አለው።

verses.en: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus lui répondit: Suis-moi, et laisse les morts ensevelir leurs morts.
verses.am: ወደ ታንኳም ሲገባ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
verses.fr: Il monta dans la barque, et ses disciples le suivirent.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ማዕበሉ ታንኳይቱን እስኪደፍናት ድረስ በባሕር ታላቅ መናወጥ ሆነ፤ እርሱ ግን ተኝቶ ነበር።

verses.en: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
verses.fr: Et voici, il s''éleva sur la mer une si grande tempête que la barque était couverte par les flots. Et lui, il dormait.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አድነን፥ ጠፋን እያሉ አስነሡት።

verses.en: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
verses.fr: Les disciples s''étant approchés le réveillèrent, et dirent: Seigneur, sauve-nous, nous périssons!
verses.am: እርሱም። እናንተ እምነት የጎደላችሁ፥ ስለ ምን ትፈራላችሁ? አላቸው፤ ከዚህ በኋላ ተነሥቶ ነፋሱንና ባሕሩን ገሠጸ፥ ታላቅ ጸጥታም ሆነ።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Pourquoi avez-vous peur, gens de peu de foi? Alors il se leva, menaça les vents et la mer, et il y eut un grand calme.
verses.am: ሰዎቹም። ነፋሳትና ባሕርስ ስንኳ የሚታዘዙለት፥ ይህ እንዴት ያለ ሰው ነው? እያሉ ተደነቁ።

verses.en: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
verses.fr: Ces hommes furent saisis d''étonnement: Quel est celui-ci, disaient-ils, à qui obéissent même les vents et la mer?
verses.am: ወደ ማዶም ወደ ጌርጋሴኖን አገር በመጣ ጊዜ፥ አጋንንት ያደሩባቸው ሁለት ሰዎች ከመቃብር ወጥተው ተገናኙት፤ እነርሱም ሰው በዚያ መንገድ ማለፍ እስኪሳነው ድረስ እጅግ ክፉዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut à l''autre bord, dans le pays des Gadaréniens, deux démoniaques, sortant des sépulcres, vinrent au-devant de lui. Ils étaient si furieux que personne n''osait passer par là.
verses.am: እነሆም። ኢየሱስ ሆይ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለን? ጊዜው ሳይደርስ ልትሣቅየን ወደዚህ መጣህን? እያሉ ጮኹ።

verses.en: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
verses.fr: Et voici, ils s''écrièrent: Qu''y a-t-il entre nous et toi, Fils de Dieu? Es-tu venu ici pour nous tourmenter avant le temps?
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ርቆ የብዙ እሪያ መንጋ ይሰማራ ነበር።

verses.en: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
verses.fr: Il y avait loin d''eux un grand troupeau de pourceaux qui paissaient.
verses.am: አጋንንቱም። ታወጣንስ እንደሆንህ፥ ወደ እሪያው መንጋ ስደደን ብለው ለመኑት። ሂዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
verses.fr: Les démons priaient Jésus, disant: Si tu nous chasses, envoie-nous dans ce troupeau de pourceaux.
verses.am: እነርሱም ወጥተው ወደ እሪያዎቹ ሄዱና ገቡ፤ እነሆም፥ የእሪያዎቹ መንጋ ሁሉ ከአፋፉ ወደ ባሕር እየተጣደፉ ሮጡ በውኃም ውስጥ ሞቱ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Allez! Ils sortirent, et entrèrent dans les pourceaux. Et voici, tout le troupeau se précipita des pentes escarpées dans la mer, et ils périrent dans les eaux.
verses.am: እረኞችም ሸሹ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም ሄደው ነገሩን ሁሉ አጋንንትም በአደሩባቸው የሆነውን አወሩ።

verses.en: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
verses.fr: Ceux qui les faisaient paître s''enfuirent, et allèrent dans la ville raconter tout ce qui s''était passé et ce qui était arrivé aux démoniaques.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከተማው ሁሉ ኢየሱስን ሊገናኝ ወጣ፥ ባዩትም ጊዜ ከአገራቸው እንዲሄድላቸው ለመኑት።

verses.en: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
verses.fr: Alors toute la ville sortit à la rencontre de Jésus; et, dès qu''ils le virent, ils le supplièrent de quitter leur territoire.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከተማው ሁሉ ኢየሱስን ሊገናኝ ወጣ፥ ባዩትም ጊዜ ከአገራቸው እንዲሄድላቸው ለመኑት።

verses.en: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
verses.fr: Jésus, étant monté dans une barque, traversa la mer, et alla dans sa ville.
verses.am: በታንኳም ገብቶ ተሻገረና ወደ ገዛ ከተማው መጣ።

verses.en: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.fr: Et voici, on lui amena un paralytique couché sur un lit. Jésus, voyant leur foi, dit au paralytique: Prends courage, mon enfant, tes péchés te sont pardonnés.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በአልጋ የተኛ ሽባ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ። ኢየሱስም እምነታቸውን አይቶ ሽባውን። አንተ ልጅ፥ አይዞህ፥ ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ አለው።

verses.en: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
verses.fr: Sur quoi, quelques scribes dirent au dedans d''eux: Cet homme blasphème.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከጻፎቹ አንዳንዱ በልባቸው። ይህስ ይሳደባል አሉ።

verses.en: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
verses.fr: Et Jésus, connaissant leurs pensées, dit: Pourquoi avez-vous de mauvaises pensées dans vos coeurs?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አሳባቸውን አውቆ እንዲህ አለ። ስለ ምን በልባችሁ ክፉ ታስባላችሁ?

verses.en: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
verses.fr: Car, lequel est le plus aisé, de dire: Tes péchés sont pardonnés, ou de dire: Lève-toi, et marche?
verses.am: ኃጢአትህ ተሰረየችልህ ከማለት ወይስ። ተነሣና ሂድ ከማለት ማናቸው ይቀላል?

verses.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
