verses.fr: Or, afin que vous sachiez que le Fils de l''homme a sur la terre le pouvoir de pardonner les péchés: Lève-toi, dit-il au paralytique, prends ton lit, et va dans ta maison.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በምድር ላይ ኃጢአትን ያስተሰርይ ዘንድ ለሰው ልጅ ሥልጣን እንዳለው እንድታውቁ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ሽባውን። ተነሣ፤ አልጋህን ተሸከምና ወደ ቤትህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: And he arose, and departed to his house.
verses.fr: Et il se leva, et s''en alla dans sa maison.
verses.am: ተነሥቶም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
verses.fr: Quand la foule vit cela, elle fut saisie de crainte, et elle glorifia Dieu, qui a donné aux hommes un tel pouvoir.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም አይተው ተደነቁ፥ ለሰውም እንዲህ ያለ ሥልጣን የሰጠ እግዚአብሔርን አከበሩ።

verses.en: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verses.fr: De là étant allé plus loin, Jésus vit un homme assis au lieu des péages, et qui s''appelait Matthieu. Il lui dit: Suis-moi. Cet homme se leva, et le suivit.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ አልፎ በመቅረጫው ተቀምጦ የነበረ ማቴዎስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው አየና። ተከተለኝ አለው። ተነሥቶም ተከተለው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
verses.fr: Comme Jésus était à table dans la maison, voici, beaucoup de publicains et de gens de mauvaise vie vinrent se mettre à table avec lui et avec ses disciples.
verses.am: በቤቱም በማዕድ ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ እነሆ፥ ብዙ ቀራጮችና ኃጢአተኞች መጥተው ከኢየሱስና ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር አብረው ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
verses.fr: Les pharisiens virent cela, et ils dirent à ses disciples: Pourquoi votre maître mange-t-il avec les publicains et les gens de mauvaise vie?
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም አይተው ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። መምህራችሁ ከቀራጮችና ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር አብሮ ስለ ምን ይበላል? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
verses.fr: Ce que Jésus ayant entendu, il dit: Ce ne sont pas ceux qui se portent bien qui ont besoin de médecin, mais les malades.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሰምቶ። ሕመምተኞች እንጂ ባለ ጤናዎች ባለ መድኃኒት አያስፈልጋቸውም፤

verses.en: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.fr: Allez, et apprenez ce que signifie: Je prends plaisir à la miséricorde, et non aux sacrifices. Car je ne suis pas venu appeler des justes, mais des pécheurs.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሄዳችሁ። ምሕረትን እወዳለሁ መሥዋዕትንም አይደለም ያለው ምን እንደ ሆነ ተማሩ፤ ኃጢአተኞችን ወደ ንስሐ እንጂ ጻድቃንን ልጠራ አልመጣሁምና አላቸው።

verses.en: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.fr: Alors les disciples de Jean vinrent auprès de Jésus, et dirent: Pourquoi nous et les pharisiens jeûnons-nous, tandis que tes disciples ne jeûnent point?
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርት ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። እኛና ፈሪሳውያን፥ ብዙ ጊዜ የምንጦመው፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህ ግን የማይጦሙት ስለ ምንድር ነው? አሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Les amis de l''époux peuvent-ils s''affliger pendant que l''époux est avec eux? Les jours viendront où l''époux leur sera enlevé, et alors ils jeûneront.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። ሚዜዎች ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ ጋር ሳለ ሊያዝኑ ይችላሉን? ነገር ግን ሙሽራው ከእነርሱ የሚወሰድበት ወራት ይመጣል፥ በዚያ ጊዜም ይጦማሉ።

verses.en: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
verses.fr: Personne ne met une pièce de drap neuf à un vieil habit; car elle emporterait une partie de l''habit, et la déchirure serait pire.
verses.am: በአረጀ ልብስ አዲስ እራፊ የሚያኖር የለም፤ መጣፊያው ልብሱን ይቦጭቀዋልና፥ መቀደዱም የባሰ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
verses.fr: On ne met pas non plus du vin nouveau dans de vieilles outres; autrement, les outres se rompent, le vin se répand, et les outres sont perdues; mais on met le vin nouveau dans des outres neuves, et le vin et les outres se conservent.
verses.am: በአረጀ አቁማዳ አዲስ የወይን ጠጅ የሚያኖር የለም፤ ቢደረግ ግን፥ አቁማዳው ይፈነዳል፥ የወይን ጠጁም ይፈሳል አቁማዳውም ይጠፋል፤ ነገር ግን አዲሱን የወይን ጠጅ በአዲስ አቁማዳ ያኖረዋል፥ ሁለቱም ይጠባበቃሉ።

verses.en: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
verses.fr: Tandis qu''il leur adressait ces paroles, voici, un chef arriva, se prosterna devant lui, et dit: Ma fille est morte il y a un instant; mais viens, impose-lui les mains, et elle vivra.
verses.am: ይህንም ሲነግራቸው፥ አንድ መኰንን መጥቶ። ልጄ አሁን ሞተች፤ ነገር ግን መጥተህ እጅህን ጫንባት፥ በሕይወትም ትኖራለች እያለ ሰገደለት።

verses.en: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
verses.fr: Jésus se leva, et le suivit avec ses disciples.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ተነሥቶ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተከተለው።

verses.en: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
verses.fr: Et voici, une femme atteinte d''une perte de sang depuis douze ans s''approcha par derrière, et toucha le bord de son vêtement.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ጀምሮ ደም የሚፈስሳት ሴት በኋላው ቀርባ የልብሱን ጫፍ ዳሰሰች፤

verses.en: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
verses.fr: Car elle disait en elle-même: Si je puis seulement toucher son vêtement, je serai guérie.
verses.am: በልብዋ። ልብሱን ብቻ የዳሰስሁ እንደ ሆነ፥ እድናለሁ ትል ነበረችና።

verses.en: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
verses.fr: Jésus se retourna, et dit, en la voyant: Prends courage, ma fille, ta foi t''a guérie. Et cette femme fut guérie à l''heure même.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ዘወር ብሎ አያትና። ልጄ ሆይ፥ አይዞሽ፤ እምነትሽ አድኖሻል አላት። ሴቲቱም ከዚያች ሰዓት ጀምራ ዳነች።

verses.en: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus fut arrivé à la maison du chef, et qu''il vit les joueurs de flûte et la foule bruyante,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ መኰንኑ ቤት በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ እምቢልተኞችንና የሚንጫጫውን ሕዝብ አይቶ።

verses.en: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
verses.fr: il leur dit: Retirez-vous; car la jeune fille n''est pas morte, mais elle dort. Et ils se moquaient de lui.
verses.am: ብላቴናይቱ ተኝታለች እንጂ አልሞተችምና ፈቀቅ በሉ አላቸው። በጣምም ሳቁበት።

verses.en: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
verses.fr: Quand la foule eut été renvoyée, il entra, prit la main de la jeune fille, et la jeune fille se leva.
verses.am: ሕዝቡን ግን ከአስወጡ በኋላ ገብቶ እጅዋን ያዛት፥ ብላቴናይቱም ተነሣች።

verses.en: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
verses.fr: Le bruit s''en répandit dans toute la contrée.
verses.am: ያም ዝና ወደዚያ አገር ሁሉ ወጣ።

verses.en: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou son of David, have mercy on us.
verses.fr: Etant parti de là, Jésus fut suivi par deux aveugles, qui criaient: Aie pitié de nous, Fils de David!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ ሲያልፍ ሁለት ዕውሮች። የዳዊት ልጅ ሆይ፥ ማረን ብለው እየጮሁ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut arrivé à la maison, les aveugles s''approchèrent de lui, et Jésus leur dit: Croyez-vous que je puisse faire cela? Oui, Seigneur, lui répondirent-ils.
verses.am: ወደ ቤትም በገባ ጊዜ ዕውሮቹ ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፥ ኢየሱስም። ይህን ማድረግ እንድችል ታምናላችሁን? አላቸው። አዎን፥ ጌታ ሆይ አሉት።

verses.en: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
verses.fr: Alors il leur toucha les yeux, en disant: Qu''il vous soit fait selon votre foi.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ። እንደ እምነታችሁ ይሁንላችሁ ብሎ ዓይኖቻቸውን ዳሰሰ።

verses.en: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
verses.fr: Et leurs yeux s''ouvrirent. Jésus leur fit cette recommandation sévère: Prenez garde que personne ne le sache.
verses.am: ዓይኖቻቸውም ተከፈቱ።

verses.en: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
verses.fr: Mais, dès qu''ils furent sortis, ils répandirent sa renommée dans tout le pays.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ማንም እንዳያውቅ ተጠንቀቁ ብሎ በብርቱ አዘዛቸው። እነርሱ ግን ወጥተው በዚያ አገር ሁሉ ስለ እርሱ አወሩ።

verses.en: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
verses.fr: Comme ils s''en allaient, voici, on amena à Jésus un démoniaque muet.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሲወጡ እነሆ፥ ጋኔን ያደረበትን ዲዳ ሰው ወደ እርሱ አመጡ።

verses.en: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
verses.fr: Le démon ayant été chassé, le muet parla. Et la foule étonnée disait: Jamais pareille chose ne s''est vue en Israël.
verses.am: ጋኔኑንም ካወጣው በኋላ ዲዳው ተናገረ። ሕዝቡም። እንዲህ ያለ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ከቶ አልታየም እያሉ ተደነቁ።

verses.en: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
verses.fr: Mais les pharisiens dirent: C''est par le prince des démons qu''il chasse les démons.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያን ግን። በአጋንንት አለቃ አጋንንትን ያወጣል አሉ።

verses.en: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
verses.fr: Jésus parcourait toutes les villes et les villages, enseignant dans les synagogues, prêchant la bonne nouvelle du royaume, et guérissant toute maladie et toute infirmité.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በምኩራቦቻቸው እያስተማረ፥ የመንግሥትንም ወንጌል እየሰበከ፥ በሕዝብም ያለውን ደዌና ሕማም ሁሉ እየፈወሰ፥ በከተማዎችና በመንደሮች ሁሉ ይዞር ነበር።

verses.en: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
verses.fr: Voyant la foule, il fut ému de compassion pour elle, parce qu''elle était languissante et abattue, comme des brebis qui n''ont point de berger.
verses.am: ብዙ ሕዝብም ባየ ጊዜ፥ እረኛ እንደ ሌላቸው በጎች ተጨንቀው ተጥለውም ነበርና አዘነላቸው።

verses.en: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
verses.fr: Alors il dit à ses disciples: La moisson est grande, mais il y a peu d''ouvriers.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። መከሩስ ብዙ ነው፥ ሠራተኞች ግን ጥቂቶች ናቸው፤

verses.en: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.fr: Priez donc le maître de la moisson d''envoyer des ouvriers dans sa moisson.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የመከሩን ጌታ ወደ መከሩ ሠራተኞች እንዲልክ ለምኑት አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
verses.fr: Puis, ayant appelé ses douze disciples, il leur donna le pouvoir de chasser les esprits impurs, et de guérir toute maladie et toute infirmité.
verses.am: አሥራ ሁለቱን ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ፥ እንዲያወጡአቸው በርኩሳን መናፍስት ላይ ደዌንና ሕማምንም ሁሉ እንዲፈውሱ ሥልጣን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
verses.fr: Voici les noms des douze apôtres. Le premier, Simon appelé Pierre, et André, son frère; Jacques, fils de Zébédée, et Jean, son frère;
verses.am: የአሥራ ሁለቱም ሐዋርያት ስም ይህ ነው፤ መጀመሪያው ጴጥሮስ የተባለው ስምዖን ወንድሙ እንድርያስም፥ የዘብዴዎስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም ወንድሙ ዮሐንስም፥

verses.en: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
verses.fr: Philippe, et Barthélemy; Thomas, et Matthieu, le publicain; Jacques, fils d''Alphée, et Thaddée;
verses.am: ፊልጶስም በርተሎሜዎስም፥ ቶማስም ቀራጩ ማቴዎስም፥ የእልፍዮስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም ታዴዎስም የተባለው ልብድዮስ፥

verses.en: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.fr: Simon le Cananite, et Judas l''Iscariot, celui qui livra Jésus.
verses.am: ቀነናዊውም ስምዖን ደግሞም አሳልፎ የሰጠው የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ።

verses.en: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
verses.fr: Tels sont les douze que Jésus envoya, après leur avoir donné les instructions suivantes: N''allez pas vers les païens, et n''entrez pas dans les villes des Samaritains;
verses.am: እነዚህን አሥራ ሁለቱን ኢየሱስ ላካቸው፥ አዘዛቸውም፥ እንዲህም አለ። በአሕዛብ መንገድ አትሂዱ፥ ወደ ሳምራውያንም ከተማ አትግቡ፤

verses.en: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.fr: allez plutôt vers les brebis perdues de la maison d''Israël.
verses.am: ይልቅስ የእስራኤል ቤት ወደሚሆኑ ወደ ጠፉት በጎች ሂዱ እንጂ።

verses.en: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.fr: Allez, prêchez, et dites: Le royaume des cieux est proche.
verses.am: ሄዳችሁም። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ቀርባለች ብላችሁ ስበኩ።

verses.en: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
verses.fr: Guérissez les malades, ressuscitez les morts, purifiez les lépreux, chassez les démons. Vous avez reçu gratuitement, donnez gratuitement.
verses.am: ድውዮችን ፈውሱ፤ ሙታንን አስነሡ፤ ለምጻሞችን አንጹ፤ አጋንንትን አውጡ፤ በከንቱ ተቀበላችሁ፥ በከንቱ ስጡ።

verses.en: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
verses.fr: Ne prenez ni or, ni argent, ni monnaie, dans vos ceintures;
verses.am: ወርቅ ወይም ብር ወይም ናስ በመቀነታችሁ፥

verses.en: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
verses.fr: ni sac pour le voyage, ni deux tuniques, ni souliers, ni bâton; car l''ouvrier mérite sa nourriture.
verses.am: ወይም ለመንገድ ከረጢት ወይም ሁለት እጀ ጠባብ ወይም ጫማ ወይም በትር አታግኙ፤ ለሠራተኛ ምግቡ ይገባዋልና።

verses.en: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
verses.fr: Dans quelque ville ou village que vous entriez, informez-vous s''il s''y trouve quelque homme digne de vous recevoir; et demeurez chez lui jusqu''à ce que vous partiez.
verses.am: በምትገቡባትም በማናቸይቱም ከተማ ወይም መንደር፥ በዚያ የሚገባው ማን እንደ ሆነ በጥንቃቄ መርምሩ፤ እስክትወጡም ድረስ በዚያ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
verses.fr: En entrant dans la maison, saluez-la;
verses.am: ወደ ቤትም ስትገቡ ሰላምታ ስጡ፤

verses.en: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.fr: et, si la maison en est digne, que votre paix vienne sur elle; mais si elle n''en est pas digne, que votre paix retourne à vous.
verses.am: ቤቱም የሚገባው ቢሆን ሰላማችሁ ይድረስለት፤ ባይገባው ግን ሰላማችሁ ይመለስላችሁ።

verses.en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''on ne vous recevra pas et qu''on n''écoutera pas vos paroles, sortez de cette maison ou de cette ville et secouez la poussière de vos pieds.
verses.am: ከማይቀበላችሁም ቃላችሁንም ከማይሰሙ ሁሉ፥ ከዚያ ቤት ወይም ከዚያች ከተማ ስትወጡ የእግራችሁን ትቢያ አራግፉ።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité: au jour du jugement, le pays de Sodome et de Gomorrhe sera traité moins rigoureusement que cette ville-là.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በፍርድ ቀን ከዚያች ከተማ ይልቅ ለሰዶምና ለገሞራ አገር ይቀልላቸዋል።

verses.en: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
verses.fr: Voici, je vous envoie comme des brebis au milieu des loups. Soyez donc prudents comme les serpents, et simples comme les colombes.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ እንደ በጎች በተኵላዎች መካከል እልካችኋለሁ፤ ስለዚህ እንደ እባብ ልባሞች እንደ ርግብም የዋሆች ሁኑ።

verses.en: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
verses.fr: Mettez-vous en garde contre les hommes; car ils vous livreront aux tribunaux, et ils vous battront de verges dans leurs synagogues;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ ሸንጎ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል፥ በምኩራቦቻቸውም ይገርፉአችኋልና ከሰዎች ተጠበቁ፤

verses.en: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
verses.fr: vous serez menés, à cause de moi, devant des gouverneurs et devant des rois, pour servir de témoignage à eux et aux païens.
verses.am: ለእነርሱና ለአሕዛብም ምስክር እንዲሆን፥ ስለ እኔ ወደ ገዥዎች ወደ ነገሥታትም ትወሰዳላችሁ።

verses.en: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
verses.fr: Mais, quand on vous livrera, ne vous inquiétez ni de la manière dont vous parlerez ni de ce que vous direz: ce que vous aurez à dire vous sera donné à l''heure même;
verses.am: አሳልፈውም ሲሰጡአችሁ፥ የምትናገሩት በዚያች ሰዓት ይሰጣችኋልና እንዴት ወይስ ምን እንድትናገሩ አትጨነቁ፤

verses.en: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
verses.fr: car ce n''est pas vous qui parlerez, c''est l''Esprit de votre Père qui parlera en vous.
verses.am: በእናንተ የሚናገር የአባታችሁ መንፈስ ነው እንጂ፥ የምትናገሩ እናንተ አይደላችሁምና።

verses.en: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.fr: Le frère livrera son frère à la mort, et le père son enfant; les enfants se soulèveront contre leurs parents, et les feront mourir.
verses.am: ወንድምም ወንድሙን፥ አባትም ልጁን ለሞት አሳልፎ ይሰጣል፥ ልጆችም በወላጆቻቸው ላይ ይነሣሉ ይገድሉአቸውማል።

verses.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
verses.fr: Vous serez haïs de tous, à cause de mon nom; mais celui qui persévérera jusqu''à la fin sera sauvé.
verses.am: በሁሉም ስለ ስሜ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ፤ እስከ መጨረሻ የሚጸና ግን እርሱ ይድናል።

verses.en: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
verses.fr: Quand on vous persécutera dans une ville, fuyez dans une autre. Je vous le dis en vérité, vous n''aurez pas achevé de parcourir les villes d''Israël que le Fils de l''homme sera venu.
verses.am: በአንዲቱ ከተማም መከራ ቢያሳዩአችሁ ወደ ሌላይቱ ሽሹ፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁና፥ የሰው ልጅ እስኪመጣ ድረስ የእስራኤልን ከተማዎች አትዘልቁም።

verses.en: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
verses.fr: Le disciple n''est pas plus que le maître, ni le serviteur plus que son seigneur.
verses.am: ደቀ መዝሙር ከመምህሩ፥ ባሪያም ከጌታው አይበልጥም።

verses.en: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
verses.fr: Il suffit au disciple d''être traité comme son maître, et au serviteur comme son seigneur. S''ils ont appelé le maître de la maison Béelzébul, à combien plus forte raison appelleront-ils ainsi les gens de sa maison!
verses.am: ደቀ መዝሙር እንደ መምህሩ፥ ባሪያም እንደ ጌታው መሆኑ ይበቃዋል። ባለቤቱን ብዔል ዜቡል ካሉት፥ ቤተሰዎቹንማ እንዴት አብዝተው አይሉአቸው!

verses.en: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.fr: Ne les craignez donc point; car il n''y a rien de caché qui ne doive être découvert, ni de secret qui ne doive être connu.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አትፍሩአቸው፤ የማይገለጥ የተከደነ፥ የማይታወቅም የተሰወረ ምንም የለምና።

verses.en: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
verses.fr: Ce que je vous dis dans les ténèbres, dites-le en plein jour; et ce qui vous est dit à l''oreille, prêchez-le sur les toits.
verses.am: በጨለማ የምነግራችሁን በብርሃን ተናገሩ፤ በጆሮም የምትሰሙትን በሰገነት ላይ ስበኩ።

verses.en: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.fr: Ne craignez pas ceux qui tuent le corps et qui ne peuvent tuer l''âme; craignez plutôt celui qui peut faire périr l''âme et le corps dans la géhenne.
verses.am: ሥጋንም የሚገድሉትን ነፍስን ግን መግደል የማይቻላቸውን አትፍሩ፤ ይልቅስ ነፍስንም ሥጋንም በገሃነም ሊያጠፋ የሚቻለውን ፍሩ።

verses.en: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
verses.fr: Ne vend-on pas deux passereaux pour un sou? Cependant, il n''en tombe pas un à terre sans la volonté de votre Père.
verses.am: ሁለት ድንቢጦች በአምስት ሳንቲም ይሸጡ የለምን? ከእነርሱም አንዲቱ ያለ አባታችሁ ፈቃድ በምድር ላይ አትወድቅም።

verses.en: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.fr: Et même les cheveux de votre tête sont tous comptés.
verses.am: የእናንተስ የራሳችሁ ጠጉር ሁሉ እንኳ ተቈጥሮአል።

verses.en: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.fr: Ne craignez donc point: vous valez plus que beaucoup de passereaux.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አትፍሩ ከብዙ ድንቢጦች እናንተ ትበልጣላችሁ።

verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, quiconque me confessera devant les hommes, je le confesserai aussi devant mon Père qui est dans les cieux;
verses.am: ስለዚህ በሰው ፊት ለሚመሰክርልኝ ሁሉ እኔ ደግሞ በሰማያት ባለው በአባቴ ፊት እመሰክርለታለሁ፤

verses.en: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.fr: mais quiconque me reniera devant les hommes, je le renierai aussi devant mon Père qui est dans les cieux.
verses.am: በሰው ፊትም የሚክደኝን ሁሉ እኔ ደግሞ በሰማያት ባለው በአባቴ ፊት እክደዋለሁ።

verses.en: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
verses.fr: Ne croyez pas que je sois venu apporter la paix sur la terre; je ne suis pas venu apporter la paix, mais l''épée.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ሰላምን ለማምጣት የመጣሁ አይምሰላችሁ፤ ሰይፍን እንጂ ሰላምን ለማምጣት አልመጣሁም።

verses.en: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.fr: Car je suis venu mettre la division entre l''homme et son père, entre la fille et sa mère, entre la belle-fille et sa belle-mère;
verses.am: ሰውን ከአባቱ፥ ሴት ልጅንም ከእናትዋ፥ ምራትንም ከአማትዋ እለያይ ዘንድ መጥቻለሁና፤

verses.en: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.
verses.fr: et l''homme aura pour ennemis les gens de sa maison.
verses.am: ለሰውም ቤተ ሰዎቹ ጠላቶች ይሆኑበታል።

verses.en: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
verses.fr: Celui qui aime son père ou sa mère plus que moi n''est pas digne de moi, et celui qui aime son fils ou sa fille plus que moi n''est pas digne de moi;
verses.am: ከእኔ ይልቅ አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚወድ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም፤ ከእኔ ይልቅም ወንድ ልጁን ወይም ሴት ልጁን የሚወድ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም፤

verses.en: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
verses.fr: celui qui ne prend pas sa croix, et ne me suit pas, n''est pas digne de moi.
verses.am: መስቀሉንም የማይዝ በኋላዬም የማይከተለኝ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም።

verses.en: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.fr: Celui qui conservera sa vie la perdra, et celui qui perdra sa vie à cause de moi la retrouvera.
verses.am: ነፍሱን የሚያገኝ ያጠፋታል፥ ነፍሱንም ስለ እኔ የሚያጠፋ ያገኛታል።

verses.en: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.fr: Celui qui vous reçoit me reçoit, et celui qui me reçoit, reçoit celui qui m''a envoyé.
verses.am: እናንተን የሚቀበል እኔን ይቀበላል፥ እኔንም የሚቀበል የላከኝን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
verses.fr: Celui qui reçoit un prophète en qualité de prophète recevra une récompense de prophète, et celui qui reçoit un juste en qualité de juste recevra une récompense de juste.
verses.am: ነቢይን በነቢይ ስም የሚቀበል የነቢይን ዋጋ ይወስዳል፥ ጻድቅንም በጻድቅ ስም የሚቀበል የጻድቁን ዋጋ ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.fr: Et quiconque donnera seulement un verre d''eau froide à l''un de ces petits parce qu''il est mon disciple, je vous le dis en vérité, il ne perdra point sa récompense.
verses.am: ማንም ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ ለአንዱ ቀዝቃዛ ጽዋ ውኃ ብቻ በደቀ መዝሙር ስም የሚያጠጣ፥ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋው አይጠፋበትም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus eut achevé de donner ses instructions à ses douze disciples, il partit de là, pour enseigner et prêcher dans les villes du pays.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አሥራ ሁለቱን ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ማዘዝ በፈጸመ ጊዜ በከተሞቻቸው ሊያስተምርና ሊሰብክ ከዚያ አለፈ።

verses.en: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
verses.fr: Jean, ayant entendu parler dans sa prison des oeuvres du Christ, lui fit dire par ses disciples:
verses.am: ዮሐንስም በወህኒ ሳለ የክርስቶስን ሥራ ሰምቶ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለት ላከና።

verses.en: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
verses.fr: Es-tu celui qui doit venir, ou devons-nous en attendre un autre?
verses.am: የሚመጣው አንተ ነህን? ወይስ ሌላ እንጠብቅ? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Allez rapporter à Jean ce que vous entendez et ce que vous voyez:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ሄዳችሁ ያያችሁትን የሰማችሁትንም ለዮሐንስ አውሩለት፤

verses.en: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
verses.fr: les aveugles voient, les boiteux marchent, les lépreux sont purifiés, les sourds entendent, les morts ressuscitent, et la bonne nouvelle est annoncée aux pauvres.
verses.am: ዕውሮች ያያሉ አንካሶችም ይሄዳሉ፥ ለምጻሞችም ይነጻሉ ደንቆሮችም ይሰማሉ፥ ሙታንም ይነሣሉ

verses.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.fr: Heureux celui pour qui je ne serai pas une occasion de chute!
verses.am: ለድሆችም ወንጌል ይሰበካል፤ በእኔም የማይሰናከለው ሁሉ ብፁዕ ነው።

verses.en: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.fr: Comme ils s''en allaient, Jésus se mit à dire à la foule, au sujet de Jean: Qu''êtes-vous allés voir au désert? un roseau agité par le vent?
verses.am: እነዚያም ሲሄዱ ኢየሱስ ለሕዝቡ ስለ ዮሐንስ ሊናገር ጀመረ እንዲህም አለ። ምን ልታዩ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጣችሁ?

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
verses.fr: Mais, qu''êtes-vous allés voir? un homme vêtu d''habits précieux? Voici, ceux qui portent des habits précieux sont dans les maisons des rois.
verses.am: ነፋስ የሚወዘውዘውን ሸምበቆን? ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ? ቀጭን ልብስ የለበሰ ሰውን? እነሆ፥ ቀጭን ልብስ የለበሱ በነገሥታት ቤት አሉ።

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
verses.fr: Qu''êtes-vous donc allés voir? un prophète? Oui, vous dis-je, et plus qu''un prophète.
verses.am: ወይስ ምን ልታዩ ወጣችሁ? ነቢይን? አዎን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከነቢይም የሚበልጠውን።

verses.en: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.fr: Car c''est celui dont il est écrit: Voici, j''envoie mon messager devant ta face, Pour préparer ton chemin devant toi.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ መንገድህን በፊትህ የሚጠርግ መልክተኛዬን በፊትህ እልካለሁ

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, parmi ceux qui sont nés de femmes, il n''en a point paru de plus grand que Jean-Baptiste. Cependant, le plus petit dans le royaume des cieux est plus grand que lui.
verses.am: ተብሎ የተጻፈለት ይህ ነውና። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሴቶች ከተወለዱት መካከል ከመጥምቁ ዮሐንስ የሚበልጥ አልተነሣም፤ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ግን ከሁሉ የሚያንሰው ይበልጠዋል።

verses.en: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
verses.fr: Depuis le temps de Jean-Baptiste jusqu''à présent, le royaume des cieux est forcé, et ce sont les violents qui s''en emparent.
verses.am: ከመጥምቁም ከዮሐንስ ዘመን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ትገፋለች፥ ግፈኞችም ይናጠቋታል።

verses.en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
verses.fr: Car tous les prophètes et la loi ont prophétisé jusqu''à Jean;
verses.am: ነቢያት ሁሉና ሕጉ እስከ ዮሐንስ ድረስ ትንቢት ተናገሩ፤

verses.en: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
verses.fr: et, si vous voulez le comprendre, c''est lui qui est l''Elie qui devait venir.
verses.am: ልትቀበሉትስ ብትወዱ፥ ይመጣ ዘንድ ያለው ኤልያስ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.fr: Que celui qui a des oreilles pour entendre entende.
verses.am: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.en: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
verses.fr: A qui comparerai-je cette génération? Elle ressemble à des enfants assis dans des places publiques, et qui, s''adressant à d''autres enfants,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህን ትውልድ በምን እመስለዋለሁ? በገበያ የሚቀመጡትን ልጆች ይመስላሉ፥ እነርሱም ባልንጀሮቻቸውን እየጠሩ።

verses.en: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
verses.fr: disent: Nous vous avons joué de la flûte, et vous n''avez pas dansé; nous avons chanté des complaintes, et vous ne vous êtes pas lamentés.
verses.am: እንቢልታ ነፋንላችሁ ዘፈንም አልዘፈናችሁም ሙሾ አወጣንላችሁ ዋይ ዋይም አላላችሁም ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
verses.fr: Car Jean est venu, ne mangeant ni ne buvant, et ils disent: Il a un démon.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ ሳይበላና ሳይጠጣ መጣ፥ እነርሱም። ጋኔን አለበት አሉት።

verses.en: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
verses.fr: Le Fils de l''homme est venu, mangeant et buvant, et ils disent: C''est un mangeur et un buveur, un ami des publicains et des gens de mauvaise vie. Mais la sagesse a été justifiée par ses oeuvres.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ እየበላና እየጠጣ መጣ፥ እነርሱም። እነሆ፥ በላተኛና የወይን ጠጅ ጠጭ፥ የቀራጮችና የኃጢአተኞች ወዳጅ ይሉታል። ጥበብም በልጆችዋ ጸደቀች።

verses.en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
verses.fr: Alors il se mit à faire des reproches aux villes dans lesquelles avaient eu lieu la plupart de ses miracles, parce qu''elles ne s''étaient pas repenties.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የሚበዙ ተአምራት የተደረገባቸውን ከተማዎች ንስሐ ስላልገቡ ሊነቅፋቸው ጀመረ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.fr: Malheur à toi, Chorazin! malheur à toi, Bethsaïda! car, si les miracles qui ont été faits au milieu de vous avaient été faits dans Tyr et dans Sidon, il y a longtemps qu''elles se seraient repenties, en prenant le sac et la cendre.
verses.am: ወዮልሽ ኮራዚ፤ ወዮልሽ ቤተ ሳይዳ፤ በእናንተ የተደረገው ተአምራት በጢሮስና በሲዶና ተደርጎ ቢሆን፥ ማቅ ለብሰው አመድም ነስንሰው ከብዙ ጊዜ በፊት ንስሐ በገቡ ነበርና።

verses.en: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je vous le dis: au jour du jugement, Tyr et Sidon seront traitées moins rigoureusement que vous.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በፍርድ ቀን ከእናንተ ይልቅ ለጢሮስና ለሲዶና ይቀልላቸዋል።

verses.en: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
verses.fr: Et toi, Capernaüm, seras-tu élevée jusqu''au ciel? Non. Tu seras abaissée jusqu''au séjour des morts; car, si les miracles qui ont été faits au milieu de toi avaient été faits dans Sodome, elle subsisterait encore aujourd''hui.
verses.am: አንቺም ቅፍርናሆም፥ እስከ ሰማይ ከፍ አልሽን? ወደ ሲኦል ትወርጃለሽ፤ በአንቺ የተደረገው ተአምራት በሰዶም ተደርጎ ቢሆን፥ እስከ ዛሬ በኖረች ነበርና።

verses.en: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je vous le dis: au jour du jugement, le pays de Sodome sera traité moins rigoureusement que toi.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በፍርድ ቀን ከአንቺ ይልቅ ለሰዶም አገር ይቀልላታል።

verses.en: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, Jésus prit la parole, et dit: Je te loue, Père, Seigneur du ciel et de la terre, de ce que tu as caché ces choses aux sages et aux intelligents, et de ce que tu les as révélées aux enfants.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። አባት ሆይ፥ የሰማይና የምድር ጌታ፥ ይህን ከጥበበኞችና ከአስተዋዮች ሰውረህ ለሕፃናት ስለ ገለጥህላቸው አመሰግንሃለሁ፤

verses.en: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
verses.fr: Oui, Père, je te loue de ce que tu l''as voulu ainsi.
verses.am: አዎን፥ አባት ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህ በፊትህ እንዲህ ሆኖአልና።

verses.en: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
verses.fr: Toutes choses m''ont été données par mon Père, et personne ne connaît le Fils, si ce n''est le Père; personne non plus ne connaît le Père, si ce n''est le Fils et celui à qui le Fils veut le révéler.
verses.am: ሁሉ ከአባቴ ዘንድ ተሰጥቶኛል፤ ከአብ በቀር ወልድን የሚያውቅ የለም፥ ከወልድም በቀር ወልድም ሊገለጥለት ከሚፈቅድ በቀር አብን የሚያውቅ የለም።

verses.en: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.fr: Venez à moi, vous tous qui êtes fatigués et chargés, et je vous donnerai du repos.
verses.am: እናንተ ደካሞች ሸክማችሁ የከበደ ሁሉ፥ ወደ እኔ ኑ፥ እኔም አሳርፋችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
verses.fr: Prenez mon joug sur vous et recevez mes instructions, car je suis doux et humble de coeur; et vous trouverez du repos pour vos âmes.
verses.am: ቀንበሬን በላያችሁ ተሸከሙ ከእኔም ተማሩ፥ እኔ የዋህ በልቤም ትሑት ነኝና፥ ለነፍሳችሁም ዕረፍት ታገኛላችሁ፤

verses.en: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
verses.fr: Car mon joug est doux, et mon fardeau léger.
verses.am: ቀንበሬ ልዝብ ሸክሜም ቀሊል ነውና።

verses.en: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn and to eat.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, Jésus traversa des champs de blé un jour de sabbat. Ses disciples, qui avaient faim, se mirent à arracher des épis et à manger.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ በሰንበት ቀን በእርሻ መካከል አለፈ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ተራቡና እሸት ይቀጥፉ ይበሉም ጀመር።

verses.en: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens, voyant cela, lui dirent: Voici, tes disciples font ce qu''il n''est pas permis de faire pendant le sabbat.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም አይተው። እነሆ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርትህ በሰንበት ማድረግ ያልተፈቀደውን ያደርጋሉ አሉት።

verses.en: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
verses.fr: Mais Jésus leur répondit: N''avez-vous pas lu ce que fit David, lorsqu''il eut faim, lui et ceux qui étaient avec lui;

verses.en: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
verses.fr: comment il entra dans la maison de Dieu, et mangea les pains de proposition, qu''il ne lui était pas permis de manger, non plus qu''à ceux qui étaient avec lui, et qui étaient réservés aux sacrificateurs seuls?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን እንዲህ አላቸው። ዳዊትና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት በተራቡ ጊዜ፥ እርሱ ያደረገውን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ገባ ካህናትም ብቻ እንጂ እርሱና ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩት ሊበሉት ያልተፈቀደውን የመሥዋዕቱን ኅብስት እንደ በላ አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.en: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
verses.fr: Ou, n''avez-vous pas lu dans la loi que, les jours de sabbat, les sacrificateurs violent le sabbat dans le temple, sans se rendre coupables?
verses.am: ካህናትም በሰንበት በመቅደስ ሰንበትን እንዲያረክሱ ኃጢአትም እንዳይሆንባቸው በሕጉ አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.en: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
verses.fr: Or, je vous le dis, il y a ici quelque chose de plus grand que le temple.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከመቅደስ የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.en: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
verses.fr: Si vous saviez ce que signifie: Je prends plaisir à la miséricorde, et non aux sacrifices, vous n''auriez pas condamné des innocents.
verses.am: ምሕረትን እወዳለሁ መሥዋዕትንም አይደለም ያለው ምን እንደሆነ ብታውቁስ ኃጢአት የሌለባቸውን ባልኰነናችሁም ነበር።

verses.en: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
verses.fr: Car le Fils de l''homme est maître du sabbat.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ የሰንበት ጌታ ነውና።

verses.en: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
verses.fr: Etant parti de là, Jésus entra dans la synagogue.
verses.am: ከዚያም አልፎ ወደ ምኩራባቸው ገባ።

verses.en: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
verses.fr: Et voici, il s''y trouvait un homme qui avait la main sèche. Ils demandèrent à Jésus: Est-il permis de faire une guérison les jours de sabbat? C''était afin de pouvoir l''accuser.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ እጁ የሰለለች ሰው ነበረ፤ ይከሱትም ዘንድ። በሰንበት መፈወስ ተፈቅዶአልን? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Lequel d''entre vous, s''il n''a qu''une brebis et qu''elle tombe dans une fosse le jour du sabbat, ne la saisira pour l''en retirer?
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ከእናንተ አንድ በግ ያለው በሰንበት በጉድጓድ ቢወድቅበት፥ ይዞ የማያወጣው ሰው ማን ነው?

verses.en: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
verses.fr: Combien un homme ne vaut-il pas plus qu''une brebis! Il est donc permis de faire du bien les jours de sabbat.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሰው ከበግ ይልቅ እንደምን አይበልጥም! ስለዚህ በሰንበት መልካም መሥራት ተፈቅዶአል አላቸው።

verses.en: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
verses.fr: Alors il dit à l''homme: Etends ta main. Il l''étendit, et elle devint saine comme l''autre.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ሰውየውን። እጅህን ዘርጋ አለው። ዘረጋትም፥ እንደ ሁለተኛይቱም ደህና ሆነች።

verses.en: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens sortirent, et ils se consultèrent sur les moyens de le faire périr.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያን ግን ወጥተው እንዴት አድርገው እንዲያጠፉት ተማከሩበት።

verses.en: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
verses.fr: Mais Jésus, l''ayant su, s''éloigna de ce lieu. Une grande foule le suivit. Il guérit tous les malades,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አውቆ ከዚያ ፈቀቅ አለ። ብዙ ሰዎችም ተከተሉት፥ ሁሉንም ፈወሳቸው፥ እንዳይገልጡትም አዘዛቸው፤

verses.en: And charged them that they should not make him known:
verses.fr: et il leur recommanda sévèrement de ne pas le faire connaître,
verses.am: እነሆ የመረጥሁት ብላቴናዬ፥ ነፍሴ ደስ የተሰኘችበት ወዳጄ፤ መንፈሴን በእርሱ ላይ አኖራለሁ፥ ፍርድንም ለአሕዛብ ያወራል።

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.fr: afin que s''accomplît ce qui avait été annoncé par Esaïe, le prophète:
verses.am: እነሆ የመረጥሁት ብላቴናዬ፥ ነፍሴ ደስ የተሰኘችበት ወዳጄ፤ መንፈሴን በእርሱ ላይ አኖራለሁ፥ ፍርድንም ለአሕዛብ ያወራል።

verses.en: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.fr: Voici mon serviteur que j''ai choisi, Mon bien-aimé en qui mon âme a pris plaisir. Je mettrai mon Esprit sur lui, Et il annoncera la justice aux nations.
verses.am: አይከራከርም አይጮህምም፥ ድምፁንም በአደባባይ የሚሰማ የለም።

verses.en: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
verses.fr: Il ne contestera point, il ne criera point, Et personne n''entendra sa voix dans les rues.
verses.am: ፍርድን ድል ለመንሣት እስኪያወጣ፥ የተቀጠቀጠን ሸምበቆ አይሰብርም የሚጤስን የጥዋፍ ክርም አያጠፋም።

verses.en: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
verses.fr: Il ne brisera point le roseau cassé, Et il n''éteindra point le lumignon qui fume, Jusqu''à ce qu''il ait fait triompher la justice.
verses.am: አሕዛብም በስሙ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.fr: Et les nations espéreront en son nom.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ጋኔን ያደረበትን ዕውር ዲዳም ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ዕውሩም ዲዳውም እስኪያይና እስኪናገር ድረስ ፈወሰው።

verses.en: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
verses.fr: Alors on lui amena un démoniaque aveugle et muet, et il le guérit, de sorte que le muet parlait et voyait.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ተገረሙና። እንጃ ይህ ሰው የዳዊት ልጅ ይሆንን? አሉ።

verses.en: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
verses.fr: Toute la foule étonnée disait: N''est-ce point là le Fils de David?
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያን ግን ሰምተው። ይህ በብዔል ዜቡል በአጋንንት አለቃ ካልሆነ በቀር አጋንንትን አያወጣም አሉ።

verses.en: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens, ayant entendu cela, dirent: Cet homme ne chasse les démons que par Béelzébul, prince des démons.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን አሳባቸውን አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። እርስ በርስዋ የምትለያይ መንግሥት ሁላ ትጠፋለች፥ እርስ በርሱ የሚለያይ ከተማም ሁሉ ወይም ቤት አይቆምም።

verses.en: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
verses.fr: Comme Jésus connaissait leurs pensées, il leur dit: Tout royaume divisé contre lui-même est dévasté, et toute ville ou maison divisée contre elle-même ne peut subsister.
verses.am: ሰይጣንም ሰይጣንን የሚያወጣ ከሆነ፥ እርስ በርሱ ተለያየ፥ እንግዲህ መንግሥቱ እንዴት ትቆማለች?

verses.en: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
verses.fr: Si Satan chasse Satan, il est divisé contre lui-même; comment donc son royaume subsistera-t-il?
verses.am: እኔስ በብዔል ዜቡል አጋንንትን የማወጣ ከሆንሁ፥ ልጆቻችሁ በማን ያወጡአቸዋል? ስለዚህ እነርሱ ፈራጆች ይሆኑባችኋል።

verses.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
verses.fr: Et si moi, je chasse les démons par Béelzébul, vos fils, par qui les chassent-ils? C''est pourquoi ils seront eux-mêmes vos juges.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ አጋንንትን የማወጣ ከሆንሁ፥ እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ወደ እናንተ ደርሳለች።

verses.en: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
verses.fr: Mais, si c''est par l''Esprit de Dieu que je chasse les démons, le royaume de Dieu est donc venu vers vous.
verses.am: ወይስ ሰው አስቀድሞ ኃይለኛውን ሳያስር ወደ ኃይለኛው ቤት ገብቶ እቃውን ሊነጥቀው እንዴት ይችላል? ከዚያም ወዲያ ቤቱን ይበዘብዛል።

verses.en: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
verses.fr: Ou, comment quelqu''un peut-il entrer dans la maison d''un homme fort et piller ses biens, sans avoir auparavant lié cet homme fort? Alors seulement il pillera sa maison.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ያልሆነ ይቃወመኛል፥ ከእኔ ጋርም የማያከማች ይበትናል።

verses.en: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
verses.fr: Celui qui n''est pas avec moi est contre moi, et celui qui n''assemble pas avec moi disperse.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ ኃጢአትና ስድብ ሁሉ ለሰዎች ይሰረይላቸዋል፥ ነገር ግን መንፈስ ቅዱስን ለሰደበ አይሰረይለትም።

verses.en: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je vous dis: Tout péché et tout blasphème sera pardonné aux hommes, mais le blasphème contre l''Esprit ne sera point pardonné.
verses.am: በሰው ልጅ ላይ ቃል የሚናገር ሁሉ ይሰረይለታል፤ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ላይ ግን የሚናገር ሁሉ በዚህ ዓለም ቢሆን ወይም በሚመጣው አይሰረይለትም።

verses.en: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
verses.fr: Quiconque parlera contre le Fils de l''homme, il lui sera pardonné; mais quiconque parlera contre le Saint-Esprit, il ne lui sera pardonné ni dans ce siècle ni dans le siècle à venir.
verses.am: ዛፍ ከፍሬዋ ትታወቃለችና ዛፍዋን መልካም፥ ፍሬዋንም መልካም አድርጉ፥ ወይም ዛፍዋን ክፉ ፍሬዋንም ክፉ አድርጉ።

verses.en: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
verses.fr: Ou dites que l''arbre est bon et que son fruit est bon, ou dites que l''arbre est mauvais et que son fruit est mauvais; car on connaît l''arbre par le fruit.
verses.am: እናንተ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ክፉዎች ስትሆኑ መልካም ለመናገር እንዴት ትችላላችሁ? በልብ ሞልቶ ከተረፈው አፍ ይናገራልና።

verses.en: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
verses.fr: Races de vipères, comment pourriez-vous dire de bonnes choses, méchants comme vous l''êtes? Car c''est de l''abondance du coeur que la bouche parle.
verses.am: መልካም ሰው ከልቡ መልካም መዝገብ መልካም ነገርን ያወጣል፥ ክፉ ሰውም ከክፉ መዝገብ ክፉ ነገርን ያወጣል።

verses.en: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
verses.fr: L''homme bon tire de bonnes choses de son bon trésor, et l''homme méchant tire de mauvaises choses de son mauvais trésor.
verses.am: እኔ እላችኋለሁ፥ ሰዎች ስለሚናገሩት ስለ ከንቱ ነገር ሁሉ በፍርድ ቀን መልስ ይሰጡበታል፤

verses.en: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis: au jour du jugement, les hommes rendront compte de toute parole vaine qu''ils auront proférée.
verses.am: ከቃልህ የተነሣ ትጸድቃለህና ከቃልህም የተነሣ ትኰነናለህ።

verses.en: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
verses.fr: Car par tes paroles tu seras justifié, et par tes paroles tu seras condamné.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ከጻፎችና ከፈሪሳውያን አንዳንዶቹ መለሱና። መምህር ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ምልክት እንድናይ እንወዳለን አሉ።

verses.en: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
verses.fr: Alors quelques-uns des scribes et des pharisiens prirent la parole, et dirent: Maître, nous voudrions te voir faire un miracle.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ክፉና አመንዝራ ትውልድ ምልክት ይሻል፥ ከነቢዩም ከዮናስ ምልክት በቀር ምልክት አይሰጠውም።

verses.en: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Une génération méchante et adultère demande un miracle; il ne lui sera donné d''autre miracle que celui du prophète Jonas.
verses.am: ዮናስ በዓሣ አንባሪ ሆድ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት እንደ ነበረ፥ እንዲሁ የሰው ልጅ በምድር ልብ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት ይኖራል።

verses.en: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
verses.fr: Car, de même que Jonas fut trois jours et trois nuits dans le ventre d''un grand poisson, de même le Fils de l''homme sera trois jours et trois nuits dans le sein de la terre.
verses.am: የነነዌ ሰዎች በፍርድ ቀን ከዚህ ትውልድ ጋር ተነሥተው ይፈርዱበታል፤ በዮናስ ስብከት ንስሐ ገብተዋልና፥ እነሆም፥ ከዮናስ የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.en: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
verses.fr: Les hommes de Ninive se lèveront, au jour du jugement, avec cette génération et la condamneront, parce qu''ils se repentirent à la prédication de Jonas; et voici, il y a ici plus que Jonas.
verses.am: ንግሥተ ዓዜብ በፍርድ ቀን ከዚህ ትውልድ ጋር ተነሥታ ትፈርድበታለች፤ የሰሎሞንን ጥበብ ለመስማት ከምድር ዳር መጥታለችና፥ እነሆም፥ ከሰሎሞን የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

verses.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
verses.fr: La reine du Midi se lèvera, au jour du jugement, avec cette génération et la condamnera, parce qu''elle vint des extrémités de la terre pour entendre la sagesse de Salomon, et voici, il y a ici plus que Salomon.
verses.am: ርኩስ መንፈስ ግን ከሰው በወጣ ጊዜ፥ ዕረፍት እየፈለገ ውኃ በሌለበት ቦታ ያልፋል፥ አያገኝምም።

verses.en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
verses.fr: Lorsque l''esprit impur est sorti d''un homme, il va par des lieux arides, cherchant du repos, et il n''en trouve point.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም። ወደ ወጣሁበት ቤቴ እመለሳለሁ ይላል፤ ቢመጣም ባዶ ሆኖ ተጠርጎና አጊጦ ያገኘዋል።

verses.en: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
verses.fr: Alors il dit: Je retournerai dans ma maison d''où je suis sorti; et, quand il arrive, il la trouve vide, balayée et ornée.
verses.am: ከዚያ ወዲያ ይሄድና ከእርሱ የከፉትን ሰባት ሌሎችን አጋንንት ከእርሱ ጋር ይወስዳል፥ ገብተውም በዚያ ይኖራሉ፤ ለዚያም ሰው ከፊተኛው ይልቅ የኋለኛው ይብስበታል። ለዚህ ክፉ ትውልድ ደግሞ እንዲሁ ይሆንበታል።

verses.en: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
verses.fr: Il s''en va, et il prend avec lui sept autres esprits plus méchants que lui; ils entrent dans la maison, s''y établissent, et la dernière condition de cet homme est pire que la première. Il en sera de même pour cette génération méchante.
verses.am: ገናም ለሕዝቡ ሲናገር፥ እነሆ፥ እናቱና ወንድሞቹ ሊነጋገሩት ፈልገው በውጭ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
verses.fr: Comme Jésus s''adressait encore à la foule, voici, sa mère et ses frères, qui étaient dehors, cherchèrent à lui parler.
verses.am: አንዱም። እነሆ፥ እናትህና ወንድሞችህ ሊነጋገሩህ ፈልገው በውጭ ቆመዋል አለው።

verses.en: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
verses.fr: Quelqu''un lui dit: Voici, ta mère et tes frères sont dehors, et ils cherchent à te parler.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ለነገረው መልሶ። እናቴ ማን ናት? ወንድሞቼስ እነማን ናቸው? አለው።

verses.en: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
verses.fr: Mais Jésus répondit à celui qui le lui disait: Qui est ma mère, et qui sont mes frères?
verses.am: እጁንም ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ዘርግቶ። እነሆ እናቴና ወንድሞቼ፤

verses.en: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
verses.fr: Puis, étendant la main sur ses disciples, il dit: Voici ma mère et mes frères.
verses.am: በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ፥ እርሱ ወንድሜ እኅቴም እናቴም ነውና አለ።

verses.en: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
verses.fr: Car, quiconque fait la volonté de mon Père qui est dans les cieux, celui-là est mon frère, et ma soeur, et ma mère.
verses.am: በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ፥ እርሱ ወንድሜ እኅቴም እናቴም ነውና አለ።

verses.en: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
verses.fr: Ce même jour, Jésus sortit de la maison, et s''assit au bord de la mer.
verses.am: በዚያን ቀን ኢየሱስ ከቤት ወጥቶ በባሕር አጠገብ ተቀመጠ፤

verses.en: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
verses.fr: Une grande foule s''étant assemblée auprès de lui, il monta dans une barque, et il s''assit. Toute la foule se tenait sur le rivage.
verses.am: እርሱም በታንኳ ገብቶ እስኪቀመጥ ድረስ ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በወደቡ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
verses.fr: Il leur parla en paraboles sur beaucoup de choses, et il dit: Un semeur sortit pour semer.
verses.am: በምሳሌም ብዙ ነገራቸው እንዲህም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ ዘሪ ሊዘራ ወጣ።

verses.en: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
verses.fr: Comme il semait, une partie de la semence tomba le long du chemin: les oiseaux vinrent, et la mangèrent.
verses.am: እርሱም ሲዘራ አንዳንዱ በመንገድ ዳር ወደቀ፥ ወፎችም መጥተው በሉት።

verses.en: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
verses.fr: Une autre partie tomba dans les endroits pierreux, où elle n''avait pas beaucoup de terre: elle leva aussitôt, parce qu''elle ne trouva pas un sol profond;
verses.am: ሌላውም ብዙ መሬት በሌለበት በጭንጫ ላይ ወደቀ፤ ጥልቅ መሬትም ስላልነበረው ወዲያው በቀለ፥

verses.en: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.fr: mais, quand le soleil parut, elle fut brûlée et sécha, faute de racines.
verses.am: ፀሐይ በወጣ ጊዜ ግን ጠወለገ፥ ሥርም ስላልነበረው ደረቀ።

verses.en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
verses.fr: Une autre partie tomba parmi les épines: les épines montèrent, et l''étouffèrent.
verses.am: ሌላውም በእሾህ መካከል ወደቀ፥ እሾህም ወጣና አነቀው።

verses.en: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
verses.fr: Une autre partie tomba dans la bonne terre: elle donna du fruit, un grain cent, un autre soixante, un autre trente.
verses.am: ሌላውም በመልካም መሬት ወደቀ፤ አንዱም መቶ፥ አንዱም ስድሳ፥ አንዱም ሠላሳ ፍሬ ሰጠ።

verses.en: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.fr: Que celui qui a des oreilles pour entendre entende.
verses.am: የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.en: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
verses.fr: Les disciples s''approchèrent, et lui dirent: Pourquoi leur parles-tu en paraboles?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው። ስለ ምን በምሳሌ ትነግራቸዋለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Parce qu''il vous a été donné de connaître les mystères du royaume des cieux, et que cela ne leur a pas été donné.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ለእናንተ የመንግሥተ ሰማያትን ምሥጢር ማወቅ ተሰጥቶአችኋል፥ ለእነርሱ ግን አልተሰጣቸውም።

verses.en: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
verses.fr: Car on donnera à celui qui a, et il sera dans l''abondance, mais à celui qui n''a pas on ôtera même ce qu''il a.
verses.am: ላለው ይሰጠዋልና ይበዛለትማል፤ ከሌለው ግን ያው ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.en: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je leur parle en paraboles, parce qu''en voyant ils ne voient point, et qu''en entendant ils n''entendent ni ne comprennent.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እያዩ ስለማያዩ እየሰሙም ስለማይሰሙ ስለማያስተውሉም በምሳሌ እነግራቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
verses.fr: Et pour eux s''accomplit cette prophétie d''Esaïe: Vous entendrez de vos oreilles, et vous ne comprendrez point; Vous regarderez de vos yeux, et vous ne verrez point.
verses.am: መስማት ትሰማላችሁና አታስተውሉም፥ ማየትም ታያላችሁና አትመለከቱም።

verses.en: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.fr: Car le coeur de ce peuple est devenu insensible; Ils ont endurci leurs oreilles, et ils ont fermé leurs yeux, De peur qu''ils ne voient de leurs yeux, qu''ils n''entendent de leurs oreilles, Qu''ils ne comprennent de leur coeur, Qu''ils ne se convertissent, et que je ne les guérisse.
verses.am: በዓይናቸው እንዳያዩ፥ በጆሮአቸውም እንዳይሰሙ፥ በልባቸውም እንዳያስተውሉ፥ ተመልሰውም እንዳልፈውሳቸው፥ የዚህ ሕዝብ ልብ ደንድኖአልና ጆሮአቸውም ደንቁሮአል ዓይናቸውንም ጨፍነዋል የሚል የኢሳይያስ ትንቢት በእነርሱ ይፈጸማል።

verses.en: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
verses.fr: Mais heureux sont vos yeux, parce qu''ils voient, et vos oreilles, parce qu''elles entendent!
verses.am: የእናንተ ግን ዓይኖቻችሁ ስለሚያዩ ጆሮቻችሁም ስለሚሰሙ ብፁዓን ናቸው።

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, beaucoup de prophètes et de justes ont désiré voir ce que vous voyez, et ne l''ont pas vu, entendre ce que vous entendez, et ne l''ont pas entendu.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ብዙዎች ነቢያትና ጻድቃን የምታዩትን ሊያዩ ተመኝተው አላዩም፥ የምትሰሙትንም ሊሰሙ ተመኝተው አልሰሙም።

verses.en: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
verses.fr: Vous donc, écoutez ce que signifie la parabole du semeur.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እናንተ የዘሪውን ምሳሌ ስሙ።

verses.en: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un homme écoute la parole du royaume et ne la comprend pas, le malin vient et enlève ce qui a été semé dans son coeur: cet homme est celui qui a reçu la semence le long du chemin.
verses.am: የመንግሥትን ቃል ሰምቶ በማያስተውል ሁሉ፥ ክፉው ይመጣል፥ በልቡ የተዘራውንም ይነጥቃል፤ በመንገድ ዳር የተዘራው ይህ ነው።

verses.en: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
verses.fr: Celui qui a reçu la semence dans les endroits pierreux, c''est celui qui entend la parole et la reçoit aussitôt avec joie;
verses.am: በጭንጫ ላይ የተዘራውም ይህ ቃሉን ሰምቶ ወዲያው በደስታ የሚቀበለው ነው፤

verses.en: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
verses.fr: mais il n''a pas de racines en lui-même, il manque de persistance, et, dès que survient une tribulation ou une persécution à cause de la parole, il y trouve une occasion de chute.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለጊዜው ነው እንጂ በእርሱ ሥር የለውም፥ በቃሉ ምክንያትም መከራ ወይም ስደት በሆነ ጊዜ ወዲያው ይሰናከላል።

verses.en: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
verses.fr: Celui qui a reçu la semence parmi les épines, c''est celui qui entend la parole, mais en qui les soucis du siècle et la séduction des richesses étouffent cette parole, et la rendent infructueuse.
verses.am: በእሾህ መካከል የተዘራውም ይህ ቃሉን የሚሰማ ነው፥ የዚህም ዓለም አሳብና የባለጠግነት መታለል ቃሉን ያንቃል፥ የማያፈራም ይሆናል።

verses.en: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.fr: Celui qui a reçu la semence dans la bonne terre, c''est celui qui entend la parole et la comprend; il porte du fruit, et un grain en donne cent, un autre soixante, un autre trente.
verses.am: በመልካም መሬት የተዘራውም ይህ ቃሉን ሰምቶ የሚያስተውል ነው፤ እርሱም ፍሬ ያፈራል አንዱም መቶ አንዱም ስድሳ አንዱም ሠላሳ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
verses.fr: Il leur proposa une autre parabole, et il dit: Le royaume des cieux est semblable à un homme qui a semé une bonne semence dans son champ.
verses.am: ሌላ ምሳሌ አቀረበላቸው እንዲህም አለ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት በእርሻው መልካም ዘርን የዘራን ሰው ትመስላለች።

verses.en: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
verses.fr: Mais, pendant que les gens dormaient, son ennemi vint, sema de l''ivraie parmi le blé, et s''en alla.
verses.am: ሰዎቹ ሲተኙ ግን ጠላቱ መጣና በስንዴው መካከል እንክርዳድን ዘርቶ ሄደ።

verses.en: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
verses.fr: Lorsque l''herbe eut poussé et donné du fruit, l''ivraie parut aussi.
verses.am: ስንዴውም በበቀለና በአፈራ ጊዜ እንክርዳዱ ደግሞ ያን ጊዜ ታየ።

verses.en: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
verses.fr: Les serviteurs du maître de la maison vinrent lui dire: Seigneur, n''as-tu pas semé une bonne semence dans ton champ? D''où vient donc qu''il y a de l''ivraie?
verses.am: የባለቤቱም ባሮች ቀርበው። ጌታ ሆይ፥ መልካምን ዘር በእርሻህ ዘርተህ አልነበርህምን? እንክርዳዱንስ ከወዴት አገኘ? አሉት።

verses.en: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: C''est un ennemi qui a fait cela. Et les serviteurs lui dirent: Veux-tu que nous allions l''arracher?
verses.am: እርሱም። ጠላት ይህን አደረገ አላቸው። ባሮቹም። እንግዲህ ሄደን ብንለቅመው ትወዳለህን? አሉት።

verses.en: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
verses.fr: Non, dit-il, de peur qu''en arrachant l''ivraie, vous ne déraciniez en même temps le blé.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። እንክርዳዱን ስትለቅሙ ስንዴውን ከእርሱ ጋር እንዳትነቅሉት አይሆንም።

verses.en: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
verses.fr: Laissez croître ensemble l''un et l''autre jusqu''à la moisson, et, à l''époque de la moisson, je dirai aux moissonneurs: Arrachez d''abord l''ivraie, et liez-la en gerbes pour la brûler, mais amassez le blé dans mon grenier.
verses.am: ተዉአቸው፤ እስከ መከር ጊዜ አብረው ይደጉ፤ በመከር ጊዜም አጫጆችን። እንክርዳዱን አስቀድማችሁ ልቀሙ በእሳትም ለማቃጠል በየነዶው እሰሩ፥ ስንዴውን ግን በጎተራዬ ክተቱ እላለሁ አለ።

verses.en: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
verses.fr: Il leur proposa une autre parabole, et il dit: Le royaume des cieux est semblable à un grain de sénevé qu''un homme a pris et semé dans son champ.
verses.am: ሌላ ምሳሌ አቀረበላቸው እንዲህም አለ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ሰው ወስዶ በእርሻው የዘራትን የሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት ትመስላለች፤

verses.en: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
verses.fr: C''est la plus petite de toutes les semences; mais, quand il a poussé, il est plus grand que les légumes et devient un arbre, de sorte que les oiseaux du ciel viennent habiter dans ses branches.
verses.am: እርስዋም ከዘር ሁሉ ታንሳለች፥ በአደገች ጊዜ ግን፥ ከአታክልቶች ትበልጣለች የሰማይም ወፎች መጥተው በቅርንጫፎችዋ እስኪሰፍሩ ድረስ ዛፍ ትሆናለች።

verses.en: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.fr: Il leur dit cette autre parabole: Le royaume des cieux est semblable à du levain qu''une femme a pris et mis dans trois mesures de farine, jusqu''à ce que la pâte soit toute levée.
verses.am: ሌላ ምሳሌ ነገራቸው እንዲህም አለ። መንግሥተ ሰማያት ሁሉ እስኪቦካ ድረስ ሴት ወስዳ በሦስት መስፈሪያ ዱቄት የሸሸገችውን እርሾ ትመስላለች።

verses.en: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
verses.fr: Jésus dit à la foule toutes ces choses en paraboles, et il ne lui parlait point sans parabole,
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ሕዝቡን ትቶ ወደ ቤት ገባ። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። የእርሻውን እንክርዳድ ምሳሌ ተርጕምልን አሉት።

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
verses.fr: afin que s''accomplît ce qui avait été annoncé par le prophète: J''ouvrirai ma bouche en paraboles, Je publierai des choses cachées depuis la création du monde.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ሕዝቡን ትቶ ወደ ቤት ገባ። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። የእርሻውን እንክርዳድ ምሳሌ ተርጕምልን አሉት።

verses.en: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
verses.fr: Alors il renvoya la foule, et entra dans la maison. Ses disciples s''approchèrent de lui, et dirent: Explique-nous la parabole de l''ivraie du champ.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። መልካምን ዘር የዘራው የሰው ልጅ ነው፤ እርሻውም ዓለም ነው፤

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
verses.fr: Il répondit: Celui qui sème la bonne semence, c''est le Fils de l''homme;
verses.am: መልካሙም ዘር የመንግሥት ልጆች ናቸው፤

verses.en: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
verses.fr: le champ, c''est le monde; la bonne semence, ce sont les fils du royaume; l''ivraie, ce sont les fils du malin;
verses.am: እንክርዳዱም የክፉው ልጆች ናቸው፥ የዘራውም ጠላት ዲያብሎስ ነው፤ መከሩም የዓለም መጨረሻ ነው፥ አጫጆችም መላእክት ናቸው።

verses.en: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
verses.fr: l''ennemi qui l''a semée, c''est le diable; la moisson, c''est la fin du monde; les moissonneurs, ce sont les anges.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንክርዳድ ተለቅሞ በእሳት እንደሚቃጠል፥ በዓለም መጨረሻ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
verses.fr: Or, comme on arrache l''ivraie et qu''on la jette au feu, il en sera de même à la fin du monde.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ መላእክቱን ይልካል፥ ከመንግሥቱም እንቅፋትን ሁሉ ዓመፃንም የሚያደርጉትን ይለቅማሉ፥

verses.en: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
verses.fr: Le Fils de l''homme enverra ses anges, qui arracheront de son royaume tous les scandales et ceux qui commettent l''iniquité:
verses.am: ወደ እቶነ እሳትም ይጥሉአቸዋል፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.fr: et ils les jetteront dans la fournaise ardente, où il y aura des pleurs et des grincements de dents.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጻድቃን በአባታቸው መንግሥት እንደ ፀሐይ ይበራሉ። የሚሰማ ጆሮ ያለው ይስማ።

verses.en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.fr: Alors les justes resplendiront comme le soleil dans le royaume de leur Père. Que celui qui a des oreilles pour entendre entende.
verses.am: ደግሞ መንግሥተ ሰማያት በእርሻ ውስጥ የተሰወረውን መዝገብ ትመስላለች፤ ሰውም አግኝቶ ሰወረው፥ ከደስታውም የተነሣ ሄዶ ያለውን ሁሉ ሸጠና ያን እርሻ ገዛ።

verses.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
verses.fr: Le royaume des cieux est encore semblable à un trésor caché dans un champ. L''homme qui l''a trouvé le cache; et, dans sa joie, il va vendre tout ce qu''il a, et achète ce champ.
verses.am: ደግሞ መንግሥተ ሰማያት መልካምን ዕንቁ የሚሻ ነጋዴን ትመስላለች፤

verses.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
verses.fr: Le royaume des cieux est encore semblable à un marchand qui cherche de belles perles.
verses.am: ዋጋዋም እጅግ የበዛ አንዲት ዕንቁ በአገኘ ጊዜ ሄዶ ያለውን ሁሉ ሸጠና ገዛት።

verses.en: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.fr: Il a trouvé une perle de grand prix; et il est allé vendre tout ce qu''il avait, et l''a achetée.
verses.am: ደግሞ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ወደ ባሕር የተጣለች ከሁሉም ዓይነት የሰበሰበች መረብን ትመስላለች፤

verses.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
verses.fr: Le royaume des cieux est encore semblable à un filet jeté dans la mer et ramassant des poissons de toute espèce.
verses.am: በሞላችም ጊዜ ወደ ወደቡ አወጡአት፥ ተቀምጠውም መልካሙን ለቅመው በዕቃዎች ውስጥ አከማቹ ክፉውን ግን ወደ ውጭ ጣሉት።

verses.en: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
verses.fr: Quand il est rempli, les pêcheurs le tirent; et, après s''être assis sur le rivage, ils mettent dans des vases ce qui est bon, et ils jettent ce qui est mauvais.
verses.am: በዓለም መጨረሻ እንዲሁ ይሆናል፤ መላእክት መጥተው ኃጢአተኞችን ከጻድቃን መካከል ይለዩአቸዋል፥ ወደ እቶነ እሳትም ይጥሉአቸዋል፤

verses.en: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
verses.fr: Il en sera de même à la fin du monde. Les anges viendront séparer les méchants d''avec les justes,
verses.am: በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.fr: et ils les jetteront dans la fournaise ardente, où il y aura des pleurs et des grincements de dents.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ይህን ሁሉ አስተዋላችሁን? አላቸው አዎን አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.fr: Avez-vous compris toutes ces choses? -Oui, répondirent-ils.
verses.am: እርሱም። ስለዚህ የመንግሥተ ሰማያት ደቀ መዝሙር የሆነ ጻፊ ሁሉ ከመዝገቡ አዲሱንና አሮጌውን የሚያወጣ ባለቤትን ይመስላል አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
verses.fr: Et il leur dit: C''est pourquoi, tout scribe instruit de ce qui regarde le royaume des cieux est semblable à un maître de maison qui tire de son trésor des choses nouvelles et des choses anciennes.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እነዚህም ምሳሌዎች ከጨረሰ በኋላ ከዚያ ሄደ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus eut achevé ces paraboles, il partit de là.
verses.am: ወደ ገዛ አገሩም መጥቶ እስኪገረሙ ድረስ በምኩራባቸው ያስተምራቸው ነበር፤ እንዲህም አሉ። ይህን ጥበብና ተአምራት ይህ ከወዴት አገኘው?

verses.en: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
verses.fr: S''étant rendu dans sa patrie, il enseignait dans la synagogue, de sorte que ceux qui l''entendirent étaient étonnés et disaient: D''où lui viennent cette sagesse et ces miracles?
verses.am: ይህ የጸራቢ ልጅ አይደለምን? እናቱስ ማርያም ትባል የለምን? ወንድሞቹስ ያዕቆብና ዮሳ ስምዖንም ይሁዳም አይደሉምን?

verses.en: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas le fils du charpentier? n''est-ce pas Marie qui est sa mère? Jacques, Joseph, Simon et Jude, ne sont-ils pas ses frères?
verses.am: እኅቶቹስ ሁሉ በእኛ ዘንድ ያሉ አይደሉምን? እንኪያስ ይህን ሁሉ ከወዴት አገኘው? ተሰናከሉበትም።

verses.en: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
verses.fr: et ses soeurs ne sont-elles pas toutes parmi nous? D''où lui viennent donc toutes ces choses?
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። ነቢይ ከገዛ አገሩና ከገዛ ቤቱ በቀር ሳይከበር አይቀርም አላቸው።

verses.en: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verses.fr: Et il était pour eux une occasion de chute. Mais Jésus leur dit: Un prophète n''est méprisé que dans sa patrie et dans sa maison.
verses.am: በአለማመናቸውም ምክንያት በዚያ ብዙ ተአምራት አላደረገም።

verses.en: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.fr: Et il ne fit pas beaucoup de miracles dans ce lieu, à cause de leur incrédulité.
verses.am: በአለማመናቸውም ምክንያት በዚያ ብዙ ተአምራት አላደረገም።

verses.en: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, Hérode le tétrarque, ayant entendu parler de Jésus,
verses.am: በዚያ ዘመን የአራተኛው ክፍል ገዥ ሄሮድስ የኢየሱስን ዝና ሰማ፥

verses.en: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.fr: dit à ses serviteurs: C''est Jean-Baptiste! Il est ressuscité des morts, et c''est pour cela qu''il se fait par lui des miracles.
verses.am: ለሎሌዎቹም። ይህ መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ ነው፤ እርሱ ከሙታን ተነሥቶአል፥ ስለዚህም ኃይል በእርሱ ይደረጋል አለ።

verses.en: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
verses.fr: Car Hérode, qui avait fait arrêter Jean, l''avait lié et mis en prison, à cause d''Hérodias, femme de Philippe, son frère,
verses.am: ሄሮድስ በወንድሙ በፊልጶስ ሚስት በሄሮድያዳ ምክንያት ዮሐንስን አስይዞ አሳስሮት በወህኒ አኑሮት ነበርና፤

verses.en: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
verses.fr: parce que Jean lui disait: Il ne t''est pas permis de l''avoir pour femme.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ። እርስዋ ለአንተ ትሆን ዘንድ አልተፈቀደም ይለው ነበርና።

verses.en: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.fr: Il voulait le faire mourir, mais il craignait la foule, parce qu''elle regardait Jean comme un prophète.
verses.am: ሊገድለውም ወዶ ሳለ፥ ሕዝቡ እንደ ነቢይ ስለ አዩት ፈራቸው።

verses.en: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
verses.fr: Or, lorsqu''on célébra l''anniversaire de la naissance d''Hérode, la fille d''Hérodias dansa au milieu des convives, et plut à Hérode,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሄሮድስ የተወለደበት ቀን በሆነ ጊዜ፥ የሄሮድያዳ ልጅ በመካከላቸው ዘፈነች ሄሮድስንም ደስ አሰኘችው፤

verses.en: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
verses.fr: de sorte qu''il promit avec serment de lui donner ce qu''elle demanderait.
verses.am: ስለዚህም የምትለምነውን ሁሉ እንዲሰጣት በመሐላ ተስፋ አደረገላት።

verses.en: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
verses.fr: A l''instigation de sa mère, elle dit: Donne-moi ici, sur un plat, la tête de Jean-Baptiste.
verses.am: እርስዋም በእናትዋ ተመክራ። የመጥምቁን የዮሐንስን ራስ በዚህ በወጭት ስጠኝ አለችው።

verses.en: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
verses.fr: Le roi fut attristé; mais, à cause de ses serments et des convives, il commanda qu''on la lui donne,
verses.am: ንጉሡም አዘነ፥ ነገር ግን ስለ መሐላው ከእርሱም ጋር ተቀምጠው ስላሉት ሰዎች እንዲሰጡአት አዘዘ፤

verses.en: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.fr: et il envoya décapiter Jean dans la prison.
verses.am: ልኮም የዮሐንስን ራስ በወህኒ አስቆረጠው።

verses.en: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
verses.fr: Sa tête fut apportée sur un plat, et donnée à la jeune fille, qui la porta à sa mère.
verses.am: ራሱንም በወጭት አምጥተው ለብላቴናይቱ ሰጡአት፥ ወደ እናትዋም ወሰደችው።

verses.en: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
verses.fr: Les disciples de Jean vinrent prendre son corps, et l''ensevelirent. Et ils allèrent l''annoncer à Jésus.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው በድኑን ወሰዱና ቀበሩት፥ መጥተውም ለኢየሱስ አወሩለት።

verses.en: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
verses.fr: A cette nouvelle, Jésus partit de là dans une barque, pour se retirer à l''écart dans un lieu désert; et la foule, l''ayant su, sortit des villes et le suivit à pied.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በሰማ ጊዜ ከዚያ ብቻውን ወደ ምድረ በዳ በታንኳ ፈቀቅ አለ፤ ሕዝቡም ሰምተው ከከተማዎቹ በእግር ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
verses.fr: Quand il sortit de la barque, il vit une grande foule, et fut ému de compassion pour elle, et il guérit les malades.
verses.am: ወጥቶም ብዙ ሕዝብ አየና አዘነላቸው ድውዮቻቸውንም ፈወሰ።

verses.en: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
verses.fr: Le soir étant venu, les disciples s''approchèrent de lui, et dirent: Ce lieu est désert, et l''heure est déjà avancée; renvoie la foule, afin qu''elle aille dans les villages, pour s''acheter des vivres.
verses.am: በመሸም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። ቦታው ምድረ በዳ ነው አሁንም ሰዓቱ አልፎአል፤ ወደ መንደሮች ሄደው ለራሳቸው ምግብ እንዲገዙ ሕዝቡን አሰናብት አሉት።

verses.en: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Ils n''ont pas besoin de s''en aller; donnez-leur vous-mêmes à manger.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እናንተ የሚበሉትን ስጡአቸው እንጂ ሊሄዱ አያስፈልግም አላቸው።

verses.en: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
verses.fr: Mais ils lui dirent: Nous n''avons ici que cinq pains et deux poissons.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ከአምስት እንጀራና ከሁለት ዓሣ በቀር በዚህ የለንም አሉት።

verses.en: He said, Bring them hither to me.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Apportez-les-moi.
verses.am: እርሱም። እነዚያን ወደዚህ አምጡልኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.fr: Il fit asseoir la foule sur l''herbe, prit les cinq pains et les deux poissons, et, levant les yeux vers le ciel, il rendit grâces. Puis, il rompit les pains et les donna aux disciples, qui les distribuèrent à la foule.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም በሣር ላይ እንዲቀመጡ አዘዘ፥ አምስቱንም እንጀራና ሁለቱን ዓሣ ይዞ ወደ ሰማይ አሻቅቦ አየና ባረከ፥ እንጀራውንም ቆርሶ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለሕዝቡ።

verses.en: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
verses.fr: Tous mangèrent et furent rassasiés, et l''on emporta douze paniers pleins des morceaux qui restaient.
verses.am: ሁሉም በልተው ጠገቡ፥ የተረፈውንም ቁርስራሽ አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ ሙሉ አነሡ።

verses.en: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.fr: Ceux qui avaient mangé étaient environ cinq mille hommes, sans les femmes et les enfants.
verses.am: ከሴቶችና ከልጆችም በቀር የበሉት አምስት ሺህ ወንዶች ያህሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
verses.fr: Aussitôt après, il obligea les disciples à monter dans la barque et à passer avant lui de l''autre côté, pendant qu''il renverrait la foule.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ሕዝቡን ሲያሰናብት ሳለ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በታንኳይቱ ገብተው ወደ ማዶ እንዲቀድሙት ግድ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
verses.fr: Quand il l''eut renvoyée, il monta sur la montagne, pour prier à l''écart; et, comme le soir était venu, il était là seul.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም አሰናብቶ ይጸልይ ዘንድ ብቻውን ወደ ተራራ ወጣ። በመሸም ጊዜ ብቻውን በዚያ ነበረ።

verses.en: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
verses.fr: La barque, déjà au milieu de la mer, était battue par les flots; car le vent était contraire.
verses.am: ታንኳይቱም አሁን በባሕር መካከል ሳለች፥ ነፋስ ከወደ ፊት ነበርና በማዕበል ትጨነቅ ነበር።

verses.en: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
verses.fr: A la quatrième veille de la nuit, Jésus alla vers eux, marchant sur la mer.
verses.am: ከሌሊቱም በአራተኛው ክፍል ኢየሱስ በባሕር ላይ እየሄደ ወደ እነርሱ መጣ።

verses.en: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
verses.fr: Quand les disciples le virent marcher sur la mer, ils furent troublés, et dirent: C''est un fantôme! Et, dans leur frayeur, ils poussèrent des cris.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በባሕር ላይ ሲሄድ ባዩት ጊዜ። ምትሐት ነው ብለው ታወኩ በፍርሃትም ጮኹ።

verses.en: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit aussitôt: Rassurez-vous, c''est moi; n''ayez pas peur!
verses.am: ወዲያውም ኢየሱስ ተናገራቸውና። አይዞአችሁ፥ እኔ ነኝ፤ አትፍሩ አላቸው።
