verses.en: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
verses.fr: Pierre lui répondit: Seigneur, si c''est toi, ordonne que j''aille vers toi sur les eaux.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተስ ከሆንህ በውኃው ላይ ወደ አንተ እንድመጣ እዘዘኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Viens! Pierre sortit de la barque, et marcha sur les eaux, pour aller vers Jésus.
verses.am: እርሱም። ና አለው። ጴጥሮስም ከታንኳይቱ ወርዶ ወደ ኢየሱስ ሊደርስ በውኃው ላይ ሄደ።

verses.en: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
verses.fr: Mais, voyant que le vent était fort, il eut peur; et, comme il commençait à enfoncer, il s''écria: Seigneur, sauve-moi!
verses.am: ነገር ግን የነፋሱን ኃይል አይቶ ፈራ፥ ሊሰጥምም በጀመረ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አድነኝ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
verses.fr: Aussitôt Jésus étendit la main, le saisit, et lui dit: Homme de peu de foi, pourquoi as-tu douté?
verses.am: ወዲያውም ኢየሱስ እጁን ዘርግቶ ያዘውና። አንተ እምነት የጎደለህ፥ ስለምን ተጠራጠርህ? አለው።

verses.en: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
verses.fr: Et ils montèrent dans la barque, et le vent cessa.
verses.am: ወደ ታንኳይቱም በወጡ ጊዜ ነፋሱ ተወ።

verses.en: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
verses.fr: Ceux qui étaient dans la barque vinrent se prosterner devant Jésus, et dirent: Tu es véritablement le Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: በታንኳይቱም የነበሩት። በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ ብለው ሰገዱለት።

verses.en: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
verses.fr: Après avoir traversé la mer, ils vinrent dans le pays de Génésareth.
verses.am: ተሻግረውም ወደ ጌንሴሬጥ ምድር መጡ።

verses.en: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
verses.fr: Les gens de ce lieu, ayant reconnu Jésus, envoyèrent des messagers dans tous les environs, et on lui amena tous les malades.
verses.am: የዚያ ቦታ ሰዎችም ባወቁት ጊዜ በዙርያው ወዳለ አገር ሁሉ ላኩ፥ ሕመምተኞችንም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤

verses.en: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
verses.fr: Ils le prièrent de leur permettre seulement de toucher le bord de son vêtement. Et tous ceux qui le touchèrent furent guéris.
verses.am: የልብሱንም ጫፍ ብቻ ሊዳስሱ ይለምኑት ነበር፤ የዳሰሱትም ሁሉ ዳኑ።

verses.en: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.fr: Alors des pharisiens et des scribes vinrent de Jérusalem auprès de Jésus, et dirent:
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረቡና።

verses.en: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
verses.fr: Pourquoi tes disciples transgressent-ils la tradition des anciens? Car ils ne se lavent pas les mains, quand ils prennent leurs repas.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርትህ ስለ ምን የሽማግሎችን ወግ ይተላለፋሉ? እንጀራ ሲበሉ እጃቸውን አይታጠቡምና አሉት።

verses.en: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Et vous, pourquoi transgressez-vous le commandement de Dieu au profit de votre tradition?
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተስ ስለ ወጋችሁ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ስለ ምን ትተላለፋላችሁ?

verses.en: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
verses.fr: Car Dieu a dit: Honore ton père et ta mère; et: Celui qui maudira son père ou sa mère sera puni de mort.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር። አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፤ ደግሞ። አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሰደበ ፈጽሞ ይሙት ብሎአልና፤

verses.en: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
verses.fr: Mais vous, vous dites: Celui qui dira à son père ou à sa mère: Ce dont j''aurais pu t''assister est une offrande à Dieu,
verses.am: እናንተ ግን። አባቱን ወይም እናቱን። ከእኔ የምትጠቀምበት መባ ነው የሚል ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
verses.fr: n''est pas tenu d''honorer son père ou sa mère. Vous annulez ainsi la parole de Dieu au profit de votre tradition.
verses.am: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን አያከብርም ትላላችሁ፤ ስለ ወጋችሁም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ሻራችሁ።

verses.en: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
verses.fr: Hypocrites, Esaïe a bien prophétisé sur vous, quand il a dit:
verses.am: እናንተ ግብዞች፥ ኢሳይያስ ስለ እናንተ።

verses.en: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
verses.fr: Ce peuple m''honore des lèvres, Mais son coeur est éloigné de moi.
verses.am: ይህ ሕዝብ በከንፈሩ ያከብረኛል፥ ልቡ ግን ከእኔ በጣም የራቀ ነው፤

verses.en: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
verses.fr: C''est en vain qu''ils m''honorent, en enseignant des préceptes qui sont des commandements d''hommes.
verses.am: የሰውም ሥርዓት የሆነ ትምህርት እያስተማሩ በከንቱ ያመልኩኛል ብሎ በእውነት ትንቢት ተናገረ።

verses.en: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
verses.fr: Ayant appelé à lui la foule, il lui dit: Ecoutez, et comprenez.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም ጠርቶ። ስሙ አስተውሉም፤

verses.en: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas ce qui entre dans la bouche qui souille l''homme; mais ce qui sort de la bouche, c''est ce qui souille l''homme.
verses.am: ሰውን የሚያረክሰው ወደ አፍ የሚገባ አይደለም፥ ከአፍ የሚወጣው ግን ሰውን የሚያረክሰው ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
verses.fr: Alors ses disciples s''approchèrent, et lui dirent: Sais-tu que les pharisiens ont été scandalisés des paroles qu''ils ont entendues?
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ቀርበው። ፈሪሳውያን ይህን ቃል ሰምተው እንደ ተሰናከሉ አወቅህን? አሉት።

verses.en: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Toute plante que n''a pas plantée mon Père céleste sera déracinée.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። የሰማዩ አባቴ ያልተከለው ተክል ሁሉ ይነቀላል።

verses.en: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
verses.fr: Laissez-les: ce sont des aveugles qui conduisent des aveugles; si un aveugle conduit un aveugle, ils tomberont tous deux dans une fosse.
verses.am: ተዉአቸው፤ ዕውሮችን የሚመሩ ዕውሮች ናቸው፤ ዕውርም ዕውርን ቢመራው ሁለቱም ወደ ጉድጓድ ይወድቃሉ አለ።

verses.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
verses.fr: Pierre, prenant la parole, lui dit: Explique-nous cette parabole.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። ምሳሌውን ተርጕምልን አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
verses.fr: Et Jésus dit: Vous aussi, êtes-vous encore sans intelligence?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አለ። እናንተ ደግሞ እስካሁን የማታስተውሉ ናችሁን?

verses.en: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
verses.fr: Ne comprenez-vous pas que tout ce qui entre dans la bouche va dans le ventre, puis est jeté dans les lieux secrets?
verses.am: ወደ አፍ የሚገባ ሁሉ ወደ ሆድ አልፎ ወደ እዳሪ እንዲጣል አትመለከቱምን?

verses.en: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
verses.fr: Mais ce qui sort de la bouche vient du coeur, et c''est ce qui souille l''homme.
verses.am: ከአፍ የሚወጣ ግን ከልብ ይወጣል፥ ሰውንም የሚያረክሰው ያ ነው።

verses.en: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
verses.fr: Car c''est du coeur que viennent les mauvaises pensées, les meurtres, les adultères, les impudicités, les vols, les faux témoignages, les calomnies.
verses.am: ከልብ ክፉ አሳብ፥ መግደል፥ ምንዝርነት፥ ዝሙት፥ መስረቅ፥ በውሸት መመስከር፥ ስድብ ይወጣልና።

verses.en: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
verses.fr: Voilà les choses qui souillent l''homme; mais manger sans s''être lavé les mains, cela ne souille point l''homme.
verses.am: ሰውን የሚያረክሰው ይህ ነው እንጂ፥ ባልታጠበ እጅ መብላትስ ሰውን አያረክሰውም።

verses.en: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
verses.fr: Jésus, étant parti de là, se retira dans le territoire de Tyr et de Sidon.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ ወጥቶ ወደ ጢሮስና ወደ ሲዶና አገር ሄደ።

verses.en: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
verses.fr: Et voici, une femme cananéenne, qui venait de ces contrées, lui cria: Aie pitié de moi, Seigneur, Fils de David! Ma fille est cruellement tourmentée par le démon.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከነናዊት ሴት ከዚያ አገር ወጥታ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ማረኝ፤ ልጄን ጋኔን ክፉኛ ይዞአታል ብላ ጮኸች።

verses.en: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
verses.fr: Il ne lui répondit pas un mot, et ses disciples s''approchèrent, et lui dirent avec instance: Renvoie-la, car elle crie derrière nous.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን አንዳች አልመለሰላትም። ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ቀርበው። በኋላችን ትጮኻለችና አሰናብታት እያሉ ለመኑት።

verses.en: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Je n''ai été envoyé qu''aux brebis perdues de la maison d''Israël.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። ከእስራኤል ቤት ለጠፉት በጎች በቀር አልተላክሁም አለ።

verses.en: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
verses.fr: Mais elle vint se prosterner devant lui, disant: Seigneur, secours-moi!
verses.am: እርስዋ ግን መጥታ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እርዳኝ እያለች ሰገደችለት።

verses.en: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Il n''est pas bien de prendre le pain des enfants, et de le jeter aux petits chiens.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። የልጆችን እንጀራ ይዞ ለቡችሎች መጣል አይገባም አለ።

verses.en: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
verses.fr: Oui, Seigneur, dit-elle, mais les petits chiens mangent les miettes qui tombent de la table de leurs maîtres.
verses.am: እርስዋም። አዎን ጌታ ሆይ፤ ቡችሎችም እኮ ከጌቶቻቸው ማዕድ የወደቀውን ፍርፋሪ ይበላሉ አለች።

verses.en: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
verses.fr: Alors Jésus lui dit: Femme, ta foi est grande; qu''il te soit fait comme tu veux. Et, à l''heure même, sa fille fut guérie.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ መልሶ። አንቺ ሴት፥ እምነትሽ ታላቅ ነው፤ እንደወደድሽ ይሁንልሽ አላት። ልጅዋም ከዚያች ሰዓት ጀምሮ ዳነች።

verses.en: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
verses.fr: Jésus quitta ces lieux, et vint près de la mer de Galilée. Etant monté sur la montagne, il s''y assit.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከዚያ አልፎ ወደ ገሊላ ባሕር አጠገብ መጣ፥ ወደ ተራራም ወጥቶ በዚያ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
verses.fr: Alors s''approcha de lui une grande foule, ayant avec elle des boiteux, des aveugles, des muets, des estropiés, et beaucoup d''autres malades. On les mit à ses pieds, et il les guérit;
verses.am: ብዙ ሕዝብም አንካሶችን፥ ዕውሮችንም፥ ዲዳዎችንም፥ ጉንድሾችንም፥ ሌሎችንም ብዙ ይዘው ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፥ በኢየሱስም እግር አጠገብ ጣሉአቸው፤ ፈወሳቸውም፤

verses.en: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
verses.fr: en sorte que la foule était dans l''admiration de voir que les muets parlaient, que les estropiés étaient guéris, que les boiteux marchaient, que les aveugles voyaient; et elle glorifiait le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ሕዝቡ ዲዳዎች ሲናገሩ፥ ጉንድሾችም ሲድኑ፥ አንካሶችም ሲሄዱ፥ ዕውሮችም ሲያዩ አይተው ተደነቁ፤ የእስራኤልንም አምላክ አከበሩ።

verses.en: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
verses.fr: Jésus, ayant appelé ses disciples, dit: Je suis ému de compassion pour cette foule; car voilà trois jours qu''ils sont près de moi, et ils n''ont rien à manger. Je ne veux pas les renvoyer à jeun, de peur que les forces ne leur manquent en chemin.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ጠርቶ። ሕዝቡ ከእኔ ጋር እስካሁን ሦስት ቀን ውለዋልና የሚበሉት ስለ ሌላቸው አዝንላቸዋለሁ፤ በመንገድም እንዳይዝሉ ጦማቸውን ላሰናብታቸው አልወድም አላቸው።

verses.en: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
verses.fr: Les disciples lui dirent: Comment nous procurer dans ce lieu désert assez de pains pour rassasier une si grande foule?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። ይህን ያህል ሕዝብ የሚያጠግብ ይህን ያህል እንጀራ በምድረ በዳ ከወዴት እናገኛለን? አሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
verses.fr: Jésus leur demanda: Combien avez-vous de pains? Sept, répondirent-ils, et quelques petits poissons.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ስንት እንጀራ አላችሁ? አላቸው። እነርሱም። ሰባት፥ ጥቂትም ትንሽ ዓሣ አሉት።

verses.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
verses.fr: Alors il fit asseoir la foule par terre,
verses.am: ሕዝቡም በምድር ላይ እንዲቀመጡ አዘዘ፤

verses.en: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.fr: prit les sept pains et les poissons, et, après avoir rendu grâces, il les rompit et les donna à ses disciples, qui les distribuèrent à la foule.
verses.am: ሰባቱንም እንጀራ ዓሣውንም ይዞ አመሰገነ ቈርሶም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለሕዝቡ።

verses.en: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
verses.fr: Tous mangèrent et furent rassasiés, et l''on emporta sept corbeilles pleines des morceaux qui restaient.
verses.am: ሁሉም በሉና ጠገቡ፥ የተረፈውንም ቁርስራሽ ሰባት ቅርጫት ሙሉ አነሡ።

verses.en: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.fr: Ceux qui avaient mangé étaient quatre mille hommes, sans les femmes et les enfants.
verses.am: የበሉትም ከሴቶችና ከልጆች በቀር አራት ሺህ ወንዶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
verses.fr: Ensuite, il renvoya la foule, monta dans la barque, et se rendit dans la contrée de Magadan.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም ካሰናበተ በኋላ ወደ ታንኳይቱ ገብቶ ወደ መጌዶል አገር መጣ።

verses.en: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens et les sadducéens abordèrent Jésus et, pour l''éprouver, lui demandèrent de leur faire voir un signe venant du ciel.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንና ሰዱቃውያንም ቀርበው ሲፈትኑት ከሰማይ ምልክት እንዲያሳያቸው ለመኑት።

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Le soir, vous dites: Il fera beau, car le ciel est rouge;
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። በመሸ ጊዜ። ሰማዩ ቀልቶአልና ብራ ይሆናል ትላላችሁ፤

verses.en: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowering. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
verses.fr: et le matin: Il y aura de l''orage aujourd''hui, car le ciel est d''un rouge sombre. Vous savez discerner l''aspect du ciel, et vous ne pouvez discerner les signes des temps.
verses.am: ማለዳም። ሰማዩ ደምኖ ቀልቶአልና ዛሬ ይዘንባል ትላላችሁ። የሰማዩን ፊትማ መለየት ታውቃላችሁ፥ የዘመኑንስ ምልክት መለየት አትችሉምን?

verses.en: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
verses.fr: Une génération méchante et adultère demande un miracle; il ne lui sera donné d''autre miracle que celui de Jonas. Puis il les quitta, et s''en alla.
verses.am: ክፉና አመንዝራ ትውልድ ምልክት ይሻል፥ ከነቢዩም ከዮናስ ምልክት በቀር ምልክት አይሰጠውም። ትቶአቸውም ሄደ።

verses.en: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
verses.fr: Les disciples, en passant à l''autre bord, avaient oublié de prendre des pains.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ ማዶ በመጡ ጊዜ እንጀራ መያዝን ረሱ።

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: Gardez-vous avec soin du levain des pharisiens et des sadducéens.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን እርሾ ተጠንቀቁና ተጠበቁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
verses.fr: Les disciples raisonnaient en eux-mêmes, et disaient: C''est parce que nous n''avons pas pris de pains.
verses.am: እነርሱም። እንጀራ ባንይዝ ነው ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.en: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
verses.fr: Jésus, l''ayant connu, dit: Pourquoi raisonnez-vous en vous-mêmes, gens de peu de foi, sur ce que vous n''avez pas pris de pains?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። እናንተ እምነት የጐደላችሁ፥ እንጀራ ስለ ሌላችሁ ስለ ምን እርስ በርሳችሁ ትነጋገራላችሁ? ገና አታስተውሉምን?

verses.en: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.fr: Etes-vous encore sans intelligence, et ne vous rappelez-vous plus les cinq pains des cinq mille hommes et combien de paniers vous avez emportés,
verses.am: ለአምስቱ ሺህ አምስቱ እንጀራ፥ ስንት መሶብም እንዳነሣችሁ ትዝ አይላችሁምን?

verses.en: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
verses.fr: ni les sept pains des quatre mille hommes et combien de corbeilles vous avez emportées?
verses.am: ወይስ ለአራቱ ሺህ ሰባቱ እንጀራ፥ ስንት ቅርጫትም እንዳነሣችሁ ትዝ አይላችሁምን?

verses.en: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
verses.fr: Comment ne comprenez-vous pas que ce n''est pas au sujet de pains que je vous ai parlé? Gardez-vous du levain des pharisiens et des sadducéens.
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን እርሾ እንድትጠበቁ ብዬ ስለ እንጀራ እንዳልተናገርኋችሁ እንዴት አታስተውሉምን?

verses.en: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
verses.fr: Alors ils comprirent que ce n''était pas du levain du pain qu''il avait dit de se garder, mais de l''enseignement des pharisiens et des sadducéens.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከፈሪሳውያንና ከሰዱቃውያን ትምህርት እንጂ ከእንጀራ እርሾ እንዲጠበቁ እንዳላላቸው ያን ጊዜ አስተዋሉ።

verses.en: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
verses.fr: Jésus, étant arrivé dans le territoire de Césarée de Philippe, demanda à ses disciples: Qui dit-on que je suis, moi, le Fils de l''homme?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ ፊልጶስ ቂሣርያ አገር በደረሰ ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። ሰዎች የሰውን ልጅ ማን እንደ ሆነ ይሉታል? ብሎ ጠየቀ።

verses.en: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
verses.fr: Ils répondirent: Les uns disent que tu es Jean-Baptiste; les autres, Elie; les autres, Jérémie, ou l''un des prophètes.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አንዳንዱ መጥምቁ ዮሐንስ፥ ሌሎችም ኤልያስ፥ ሌሎችም ኤርምያስ ወይም ከነቢያት አንዱ ነው ይላሉ አሉት።

verses.en: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
verses.fr: Et vous, leur dit-il, qui dites-vous que je suis?
verses.am: እርሱም። እናንተስ እኔን ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ትላላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
verses.fr: Simon Pierre répondit: Tu es le Christ, le Fils du Dieu vivant.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። አንተ ክርስቶስ የሕያው እግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ አለ።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
verses.fr: Jésus, reprenant la parole, lui dit: Tu es heureux, Simon, fils de Jonas; car ce ne sont pas la chair et le sang qui t''ont révélé cela, mais c''est mon Père qui est dans les cieux.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ሆይ፥ በሰማያት ያለው አባቴ እንጂ ሥጋና ደም ይህን አልገለጠልህምና ብፁዕ ነህ።

verses.en: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
verses.fr: Et moi, je te dis que tu es Pierre, et que sur cette pierre je bâtirai mon Eglise, et que les portes du séjour des morts ne prévaudront point contre elle.
verses.am: እኔም እልሃለሁ፥ አንተ ጴጥሮስ ነህ፥ በዚችም ዓለት ላይ ቤተ ክርስቲያኔን እሠራለሁ፥ የገሃነም ደጆችም አይችሉአትም።

verses.en: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.fr: Je te donnerai les clefs du royaume des cieux: ce que tu lieras sur la terre sera lié dans les cieux, et ce que tu délieras sur la terre sera délié dans les cieux.
verses.am: የመንግሥተ ሰማያትንም መክፈቻዎች እሰጥሃለሁ፤ በምድር የምታስረው ሁሉ በሰማያት የታሰረ ይሆናል፥ በምድርም የምትፈታው ሁሉ በሰማያት የተፈታ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
verses.fr: Alors il recommanda aux disciples de ne dire à personne qu''il était le Christ.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜም እርሱ ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ ለማንም እንዳይነግሩ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
verses.fr: Dès lors Jésus commença à faire connaître à ses disciples qu''il fallait qu''il allât à Jérusalem, qu''il souffrît beaucoup de la part des anciens, des principaux sacrificateurs et des scribes, qu''il fût mis à mort, et qu''il ressuscitât le troisième jour.
verses.am: ከዚያን ቀን ጀምሮ ኢየሱስ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሄድ ዘንድ ከሽማግሎችና ከካህናት አለቆች ከጻፎችም ብዙ መከራ ይቀበልና ይገደል ዘንድ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣ ዘንድ እንዲገባው ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ይገልጥላቸው ጀመር።

verses.en: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
verses.fr: Pierre, l''ayant pris à part, se mit à le reprendre, et dit: A Dieu ne plaise, Seigneur! Cela ne t''arrivera pas.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ወደ እርሱ ወስዶ። አይሁንብህ ጌታ ሆይ፤ ይህ ከቶ አይደርስብህም ብሎ ሊገሥጸው ጀመረ።

verses.en: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus, se retournant, dit à Pierre: Arrière de moi, Satan! tu m''es en scandale; car tes pensées ne sont pas les pensées de Dieu, mais celles des hommes.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ዘወር ብሎ ጴጥሮስን። ወደ ኋላዬ ሂድ፥ አንተ ሰይጣን፤ የሰውን እንጂ የእግዚአብሔርን አታስብምና ዕንቅፋት ሆነህብኛል አለው።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
verses.fr: Alors Jésus dit à ses disciples: Si quelqu''un veut venir après moi, qu''il renonce à lui-même, qu''il se charge de sa croix, et qu''il me suive.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንዲህ አለ። እኔን መከተል የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ ራሱን ይካድ መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ።

verses.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.fr: Car celui qui voudra sauver sa vie la perdra, mais celui qui la perdra à cause de moi la trouvera.
verses.am: ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚወድ ሁሉ ያጠፋታል፤ ስለ እኔ ግን ነፍሱን የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ ያገኛታል።

verses.en: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
verses.fr: Et que servirait-il à un homme de gagner tout le monde, s''il perdait son âme? ou, que donnerait un homme en échange de son âme?
verses.am: ሰው ዓለሙን ሁሉ ቢያተርፍ ነፍሱንም ቢያጐድል ምን ይጠቅመዋል? ወይስ ሰው ስለ ነፍሱ ቤዛ ምን ይሰጣል?

verses.en: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
verses.fr: Car le Fils de l''homme doit venir dans la gloire de son Père, avec ses anges; et alors il rendra à chacun selon ses oeuvres.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ከመላእክቱ ጋር በአባቱ ክብር ይመጣ ዘንድ አለውና፤ ያን ጊዜም ለሁሉ እንደ ሥራው ያስረክበዋል።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, quelques-uns de ceux qui sont ici ne mourront point, qu''ils n''aient vu le Fils de l''homme venir dans son règne.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የሰው ልጅ በመንግሥቱ ሲመጣ እስኪያዩ ድረስ እዚህ ከሚቆሙት ሞትን የማይቀምሱ አንዳንድ አሉ።

verses.en: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
verses.fr: Six jours après, Jésus prit avec lui Pierre, Jacques, et Jean, son frère, et il les conduisit à l''écart sur une haute montagne.
verses.am: ከስድስት ቀንም በኋላ ኢየሱስ ጴጥሮስንና ያዕቆብን ወንድሙንም ዮሐንስን ይዞ ወደ ረጅም ተራራ ብቻቸውን አወጣቸው።

verses.en: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
verses.fr: Il fut transfiguré devant eux; son visage resplendit comme le soleil, et ses vêtements devinrent blancs comme la lumière.
verses.am: በፊታቸውም ተለወጠ፥ ፊቱም እንደ ፀሐይ በራ፥ ልብሱም እንደ ብርሃን ነጭ ሆነ።

verses.en: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
verses.fr: Et voici, Moïse et Elie leur apparurent, s''entretenant avec lui.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ሙሴና ኤልያስ ከእርሱ ጋር ሲነጋገሩ ታዩአቸው።

verses.en: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
verses.fr: Pierre, prenant la parole, dit à Jésus: Seigneur, il est bon que nous soyons ici; si tu le veux, je dresserai ici trois tentes, une pour toi, une pour Moïse, et une pour Elie.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ ኢየሱስን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በዚህ መሆን ለእኛ መልካም ነው፤ ብትወድስ፥ በዚህ ሦስት ዳስ አንዱን ለአንተ አንዱንም ለሙሴ አንዱንም ለኤልያስ እንሥራ አለ።

verses.en: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
verses.fr: Comme il parlait encore, une nuée lumineuse les couvrit. Et voici, une voix fit entendre de la nuée ces paroles: Celui-ci est mon Fils bien-aimé, en qui j''ai mis toute mon affection: écoutez-le!
verses.am: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር፥ እነሆ፥ ብሩህ ደመና ጋረዳቸው፥ እነሆም፥ ከደመናው። በእርሱ ደስ የሚለኝ የምወደው ልጄ ይህ ነው፤ እርሱን ስሙት የሚል ድምፅ መጣ።

verses.en: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils entendirent cette voix, les disciples tombèrent sur leur face, et furent saisis d''une grande frayeur.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሰምተው በፊታቸው ወደቁ እጅግም ፈርተው ነበር።

verses.en: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
verses.fr: Mais Jésus, s''approchant, les toucha, et dit: Levez-vous, n''ayez pas peur!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ቀርቦ ዳሰሳቸውና። ተነሡ አትፍሩም አላቸው።

verses.en: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
verses.fr: Ils levèrent les yeux, et ne virent que Jésus seul.
verses.am: ዓይናቸውንም አቅንተው ሲያዩ ከኢየሱስ ብቻ በቀር ማንንም አላዩም።

verses.en: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
verses.fr: Comme ils descendaient de la montagne, Jésus leur donna cet ordre: Ne parlez à personne de cette vision, jusqu''à ce que le Fils de l''homme soit ressuscité des morts.
verses.am: ከተራራውም በወረዱ ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። የሰው ልጅ ከሙታን እስኪነሣ ድረስ ያያችሁትን ለማንም አትንገሩ ብሎ አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
verses.fr: Les disciples lui firent cette question: Pourquoi donc les scribes disent-ils qu''Elie doit venir premièrement?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። እንግዲህ ጻፎች። ኤልያስ አስቀድሞ ሊመጣ ይገባዋል ስለ ምን ይላሉ? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Il est vrai qu''Elie doit venir, et rétablir toutes choses.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ኤልያስማ አስቀድሞ ይመጣል ሁሉንም ያቀናል፤

verses.en: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
verses.fr: Mais je vous dis qu''Elie est déjà venu, qu''ils ne l''ont pas reconnu, et qu''ils l''ont traité comme ils ont voulu. De même le Fils de l''homme souffrira de leur part.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ኤልያስ ከዚህ በፊት መጣ፤ የወደዱትንም ሁሉ አደረጉበት እንጂ አላወቁትም፤ እንዲሁም ደግሞ የሰው ልጅ ከእነርሱ መከራ ይቀበል ዘንድ አለው አላቸው።

verses.en: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
verses.fr: Les disciples comprirent alors qu''il leur parlait de Jean-Baptiste.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለ መጥምቁ ስለ ዮሐንስ እንደ ነገራቸው አስተዋሉ።

verses.en: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils furent arrivés près de la foule, un homme vint se jeter à genoux devant Jésus, et dit:
verses.am: ወደ ሕዝቡም ሲደርሱ አንድ ሰው ወደ እርሱ ቀረበና ተንበርክኮ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ልጄን ማርልኝ፥ በጨረቃ እየተነሣበት ክፉኛ ይሣቀያልና፤

verses.en: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
verses.fr: Seigneur, aie pitié de mon fils, qui est lunatique, et qui souffre cruellement; il tombe souvent dans le feu, et souvent dans l''eau.
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በእሳት ብዙ ጊዜም በውኃ ይወድቃልና።

verses.en: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
verses.fr: Je l''ai amené à tes disciples, et ils n''ont pas pu le guérir.
verses.am: ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርትህም አመጣሁት ሊፈውሱትም አቃታቸው አለው።

verses.en: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
verses.fr: Race incrédule et perverse, répondit Jésus, jusques à quand serai-je avec vous? jusques à quand vous supporterai-je? Amenez-le-moi ici.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። የማታምን ጠማማ ትውልድ ሆይ፥ እስከ መቼ ከእናንተ ጋር እኖራለሁ? እስከ መቼስ እታገሣችኋለሁ? ወደዚህ ወደ እኔ አምጡት አለ።

verses.en: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
verses.fr: Jésus parla sévèrement au démon, qui sortit de lui, et l''enfant fut guéri à l''heure même.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ገሠጸው ጋኔኑም ከእርሱ ወጣ፥ ብላቴናውም ከዚያች ሰዓት ጀምሮ ተፈወሰ።

verses.en: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
verses.fr: Alors les disciples s''approchèrent de Jésus, et lui dirent en particulier: Pourquoi n''avons-nous pu chasser ce démon?
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ብቻቸውን ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረቡና። እኛ ልናወጣው ያልቻልን ስለ ምን ነው? አሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
verses.fr: C''est à cause de votre incrédulité, leur dit Jésus. Je vous le dis en vérité, si vous aviez de la foi comme un grain de sénevé, vous diriez à cette montagne: Transporte-toi d''ici là, et elle se transporterait; rien ne vous serait impossible.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ስለ እምነታችሁ ማነስ ነው፤ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የሰናፍጭ ቅንጣት የሚያህል እምነት ቢኖራችሁ፥ ይህን ተራራ። ከዚህ ወደዚያ እለፍ ብትሉት ያልፋል፤ የሚሳናችሁም ነገር የለም።

verses.en: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
verses.fr: Mais cette sorte de démon ne sort que par la prière et par le jeûne.
verses.am: ይህ ዓይነት ግን ከጸሎትና ከጦም በቀር አይወጣም አላቸው።

verses.en: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils parcouraient la Galilée, Jésus leur dit: Le Fils de l''homme doit être livré entre les mains des hommes;
verses.am: በገሊላም ሲመላለሱ ኢየሱስ። የሰው ልጅ በሰዎች እጅ አልፎ ይሰጥ ዘንድ አለው፥ ይገድሉትማል፥

verses.en: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
verses.fr: ils le feront mourir, et le troisième jour il ressuscitera. Ils furent profondément attristés.
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል አላቸው። እጅግም አዘኑ።

verses.en: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils arrivèrent à Capernaüm, ceux qui percevaient les deux drachmes s''adressèrent à Pierre, et lui dirent: Votre maître ne paie-t-il pas les deux drachmes?
verses.am: ወደ ቅፍርናሆምም በመጡ ጊዜ ግብር የሚቀበሉ ሰዎች ወደ ጴጥሮስ ቀረቡና። መምህራችሁ ሁለቱን ዲናር*ፍ1* አይገብርምን? አሉት።

verses.en: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
verses.fr: Oui, dit-il. Et quand il fut entré dans la maison, Jésus le prévint, et dit: Que t''en semble, Simon? Les rois de la terre, de qui perçoivent-ils des tributs ou des impôts? de leurs fils, ou des étrangers?
verses.am: አዎን ይገብራል አለ። ወደ ቤትም በገባ ጊዜ ኢየሱስ አስቀድሞ። ስምዖን ሆይ፥ ምን ይመስልሃል? የምድር ነገሥታት ቀረጥና ግብር ከማን ይቀበላሉ? ከልጆቻቸውን ወይስ ከእንግዶች? አለው።

verses.en: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
verses.fr: Il lui dit: Des étrangers. Et Jésus lui répondit: Les fils en sont donc exempts.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። ከእንግዶች ባለው ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። እንኪያስ ልጆቻቸው ነጻ ናቸው።

verses.en: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
verses.fr: Mais, pour ne pas les scandaliser, va à la mer, jette l''hameçon, et tire le premier poisson qui viendra; ouvre-lui la bouche, et tu trouveras un statère. Prends-le, et donne-le-leur pour moi et pour toi.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንዳናሰናክላቸው፥ ወደ ባሕር ሂድና መቃጥን ጣል፥ መጀመሪያም የሚወጣውን ዓሣ ውሰድና አፉን ስትከፍት እስታቴር*ፍ2* ታገኛለህ፤ ያን ወስደህ ስለ እኔና ስለ አንተ ስጣቸው አለው።  ፍ1 አንድ ዲናር አምሳ የኢት@ ብር ሳንቲም ያህል ነው።  ፍ2 እስታቴር ሁለት ብር ያህል ነው።

verses.en: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
verses.fr: En ce moment, les disciples s''approchèrent de Jésus, et dirent: Qui donc est le plus grand dans le royaume des cieux?
verses.am: በዚያች ሰዓት ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀርበው። በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ከሁሉ የሚበልጥ ማን ይሆን? አሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
verses.fr: Jésus, ayant appelé un petit enfant, le plaça au milieu d''eux,
verses.am: ሕፃንም ጠርቶ በመካከላቸው አቆመ

verses.en: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.fr: et dit: Je vous le dis en vérité, si vous ne vous convertissez et si vous ne devenez comme les petits enfants, vous n''entrerez pas dans le royaume des cieux.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ካልተመለሳችሁ እንደ ሕፃናትም ካልሆናችሁ፥ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ከቶ አትገቡም።

verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, quiconque se rendra humble comme ce petit enfant sera le plus grand dans le royaume des cieux.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደዚህ ሕፃን ራሱን የሚያዋርድ ሁሉ፥ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት የሚበልጥ እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
verses.fr: Et quiconque reçoit en mon nom un petit enfant comme celui-ci, me reçoit moi-même.
verses.am: እንደዚህም ያለውን አንድ ሕፃን በስሜ የሚቀበል ሁሉ እኔን ይቀበላል፤

verses.en: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
verses.fr: Mais, si quelqu''un scandalisait un de ces petits qui croient en moi, il vaudrait mieux pour lui qu''on suspendît à son cou une meule de moulin, et qu''on le jetât au fond de la mer.
verses.am: በእኔም ከሚያምኑ ከነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱን የሚያሰናክል ሁሉ፥ የወፍጮ ድንጋይ በአንገቱ ታስሮ ወደ ጥልቅ ባሕር መስጠም ይሻለው ነበር።

verses.en: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
verses.fr: Malheur au monde à cause des scandales! Car il est nécessaire qu''il arrive des scandales; mais malheur à l''homme par qui le scandale arrive!
verses.am: ወዮ ለዓለም ስለ ማሰናከያ፤ ማሰናከያ ሳይመጣ አይቀርምና፥ ነገር ግን በእርሱ ጠንቅ ማሰናከያ ለሚመጣበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት።

verses.en: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
verses.fr: Si ta main ou ton pied est pour toi une occasion de chute, coupe-les et jette-les loin de toi; mieux vaut pour toi entrer dans la vie boiteux ou manchot, que d''avoir deux pieds ou deux mains et d''être jeté dans le feu éternel.
verses.am: እጅህ ወይም እግርህ ብታሰናክልህ፥ ቈርጠህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሁለት እጅ ወይም ሁለት እግር ኖሮህ ወደ ዘላለም እሳት ከምትጣል ይልቅ አንካሳ ወይም ጉንድሽ ሆነህ ወደ ህይወት መግባት ይሻልሀል።

verses.en: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
verses.fr: Et si ton oeil est pour toi une occasion de chute, arrache-le et jette-le loin de toi; mieux vaut pour toi entrer dans la vie, n''ayant qu''un oeil, que d''avoir deux yeux et d''être jeté dans le feu de la géhenne.
verses.am: ዓይንህ ብታሰናክልህ አውጥተህ ከአንተ ጣላት፤ ሁለት ዓይን ኖሮህ ወደ ገሃነመ እሳት ከምትጣል ይልቅ አንዲት ዓይን ኖራህ ወደ ሕይወት መግባት ይሻልሃል።

verses.en: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.fr: Gardez-vous de mépriser un seul de ces petits; car je vous dis que leurs anges dans les cieux voient continuellement la face de mon Père qui est dans les cieux.
verses.am: ከነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱን እንዳትንቁ ተጠንቀቁ፤ መላእክቶቻቸው በሰማያት ዘወትር በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፊት ያያሉ እላችኋለሁና።

verses.en: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
verses.fr: Car le Fils de l''homme est venu sauver ce qui était perdu.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ የጠፋውን ለማዳን መጥቶአልና።

verses.en: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
verses.fr: Que vous en semble? Si un homme a cent brebis, et que l''une d''elles s''égare, ne laisse-t-il pas les quatre-vingt-dix-neuf autres sur les montagnes, pour aller chercher celle qui s''est égarée?
verses.am: ምን ይመስላችኋል? ለአንድ ሰው መቶ በጎች ቢኖሩት ከእነርሱም አንዱ ቢባዝን፥ ዘጠና ዘጠኙን በተራራ ትቶ ሄዶም የባዘነውን አይፈልግምን?

verses.en: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
verses.fr: Et, s''il la trouve, je vous le dis en vérité, elle lui cause plus de joie que les quatre-vingt-dix-neuf qui ne se sont pas égarées.
verses.am: ቢያገኘውም፥ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ካልባዘኑቱ ከዘጠና ዘጠኙ ይልቅ በእርሱ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
verses.fr: De même, ce n''est pas la volonté de votre Père qui est dans les cieux qu''il se perde un seul de ces petits.
verses.am: እንደዚሁ ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱ እንዲጠፋ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁ ፈቃድ አይደለም።

verses.en: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
verses.fr: Si ton frère a péché, va et reprends-le entre toi et lui seul. S''il t''écoute, tu as gagné ton frère.
verses.am: ወንድምህም ቢበድልህ፥ ሄደህ አንተና እርሱ ብቻችሁን ሆናችሁ ውቀሰው። ቢሰማህ፥ ወንድምህን ገንዘብ አደረግኸው፤

verses.en: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
verses.fr: Mais, s''il ne t''écoute pas, prends avec toi une ou deux personnes, afin que toute l''affaire se règle sur la déclaration de deux ou de trois témoins.
verses.am: ባይሰማህ ግን፥ በሁለት ወይም በሦስት ምስክር አፍ ነገር ሁሉ እንዲጸና፥ ዳግመኛ አንድ ወይም ሁለት ከአንተ ጋር ውሰድ፤

verses.en: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
verses.fr: S''il refuse de les écouter, dis-le à l''Eglise; et s''il refuse aussi d''écouter l''Eglise, qu''il soit pour toi comme un païen et un publicain.
verses.am: እነርሱንም ባይሰማ፥ ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ንገራት፤ ደግሞም ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ባይሰማት፥ እንደ አረመኔና እንደ ቀራጭ ይሁንልህ።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, tout ce que vous lierez sur la terre sera lié dans le ciel, et tout ce que vous délierez sur la terre sera délié dans le ciel.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ በምድር የምታስሩት ሁሉ በሰማይ የታሰረ ይሆናል፥ በምድርም የምትፈቱት ሁሉ በሰማይ የተፈታ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.fr: Je vous dis encore que, si deux d''entre vous s''accordent sur la terre pour demander une chose quelconque, elle leur sera accordée par mon Père qui est dans les cieux.
verses.am: ደግሞ እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእናንተ ሁለቱ በምድር በማናቸውም በሚለምኑት ነገር ሁሉ ቢስማሙ በሰማያት ካለው ከአባቴ ዘንድ ይደረግላቸዋል።

verses.en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
verses.fr: Car là où deux ou trois sont assemblés en mon nom, je suis au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: ሁለት ወይም ሦስት በስሜ በሚሰበሰቡበት በዚያ በመካከላቸው እሆናለሁና።

verses.en: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
verses.fr: Alors Pierre s''approcha de lui, et dit: Seigneur, combien de fois pardonnerai-je à mon frère, lorsqu''il péchera contre moi? Sera-ce jusqu''à sept fois?
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ ወደ እርሱ ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወንድሜ ቢበድለኝ ስንት ጊዜ ልተውለት? እስከ ሰባት ጊዜን? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Je ne te dis pas jusqu''à sept fois, mais jusqu''à septante fois sept fois.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አለው። እስከ ሰባ ጊዜ ሰባት እንጂ እስከ ሰባት ጊዜ አልልህም።

verses.en: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, le royaume des cieux est semblable à un roi qui voulut faire rendre compte à ses serviteurs.
verses.am: ስለዚህ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ባሮቹን ሊቈጣጠር የወደደን ንጉሥ ትመስላለች።

verses.en: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
verses.fr: Quand il se mit à compter, on lui en amena un qui devait dix mille talents.
verses.am: መቈጣጠርም በጀመረ ጊዜ፥ እልፍ መክሊት ዕዳ ያለበትን አንድ ሰው ወደ እርሱ አመጡ።

verses.en: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
verses.fr: Comme il n''avait pas de quoi payer, son maître ordonna qu''il fût vendu, lui, sa femme, ses enfants, et tout ce qu''il avait, et que la dette fût acquittée.
verses.am: የሚከፍለውም ቢያጣ፥ እርሱና ሚስቱ ልጆቹም ያለውም ሁሉ እንዲሸጥና ዕዳው እንዲከፈል ጌታው አዘዘ።

verses.en: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
verses.fr: Le serviteur, se jetant à terre, se prosterna devant lui, et dit: Seigneur, aie patience envers moi, et je te paierai tout.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ባሪያው ወድቆ ሰገደለትና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ታገሠኝ፥ ሁሉንም እከፍልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
verses.fr: Emu de compassion, le maître de ce serviteur le laissa aller, et lui remit la dette.
verses.am: የዚያም ባሪያ ጌታ አዘነለትና ለቀቀው፥ ዕዳውንም ተወለት።

verses.en: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
verses.fr: Après qu''il fut sorti, ce serviteur rencontra un de ses compagnons qui lui devait cent deniers. Il le saisit et l''étranglait, en disant: Paie ce que tu me dois.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ያ ባሪያ ወጥቶ ከባልንጀሮቹ ከባሮቹ መቶ ዲናር ዕዳ ያለበትን አንዱን አገኘና። ዕዳህን ክፈለኝ ብሎ ያዘና አነቀው።

verses.en: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
verses.fr: Son compagnon, se jetant à terre, le suppliait, disant: Aie patience envers moi, et je te paierai.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ባልንጀራው ባሪያ ወድቆ። ታገሠኝ፥ ሁሉንም እከፍልሃለሁ ብሎ ለመነው።

verses.en: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
verses.fr: Mais l''autre ne voulut pas, et il alla le jeter en prison, jusqu''à ce qu''il eût payé ce qu''il devait.
verses.am: እርሱም አልወደደም፥ ግን ሄዶ ዕዳውን እስኪከፍል ድረስ በወኅኒ አኖረው።

verses.en: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
verses.fr: Ses compagnons, ayant vu ce qui était arrivé, furent profondément attristés, et ils allèrent raconter à leur maître tout ce qui s''était passé.
verses.am: ባልንጀሮቹ የሆኑ ባሮችም ያደረገውን አይተው እጅግ አዘኑ፥ መጥተውም የሆነውን ሁሉ ለጌታቸው ገለጡ።

verses.en: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
verses.fr: Alors le maître fit appeler ce serviteur, et lui dit: Méchant serviteur, je t''avais remis en entier ta dette, parce que tu m''en avais supplié;
verses.am: ከዚያ ወዲያ ጌታው ጠርቶ። አንተ ክፉ ባሪያ፥ ስለ ለመንኸኝ ያን ዕዳ ሁሉ ተውሁልህ፤

verses.en: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
verses.fr: ne devais-tu pas aussi avoir pitié de ton compagnon, comme j''ai eu pitié de toi?
verses.am: እኔ እንደ ማርሁህ ባልንጀራህ የሆነውን ያን ባሪያ ልትምረው ለአንተስ አይገባህምን? አለው።

verses.en: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
verses.fr: Et son maître, irrité, le livra aux bourreaux, jusqu''à ce qu''il eût payé tout ce qu''il devait.
verses.am: ጌታውም ተቈጣና ዕዳውን ሁሉ እስኪከፍለው ድረስ ለሚሣቅዩት አሳልፎ ሰጠው።

verses.en: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que mon Père céleste vous traitera, si chacun de vous ne pardonne à son frère de tout son coeur.
verses.am: ከእናንተ እያንዳንዱ ወንድሙን ከልቡ ይቅር ካላለ፥ እንዲሁ ደግሞ የሰማዩ አባቴ ያደርግባችኋል።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus eut achevé ces discours, il quitta la Galilée, et alla dans le territoire de la Judée, au delà du Jourdain.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን ነገር ከፈጸመ በኋላ፥ ከገሊላ ሄዶ ወደ ይሁዳ አውራጃ ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ማዶ መጣ።

verses.en: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
verses.fr: Une grande foule le suivit, et là il guérit les malades.
verses.am: ብዙ ሕዝብም ተከተሉት፥ በዚያም ፈወሳቸው።

verses.en: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
verses.fr: Les pharisiens l''abordèrent, et dirent, pour l''éprouver: Est-il permis à un homme de répudier sa femme pour un motif quelconque?
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና ሲፈትኑት። ሰው በሆነው ምክንያት ሁሉ ሚስቱን ሊፈታ ተፈቅዶለታልን? አሉት።

verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
verses.fr: Il répondit: N''avez-vous pas lu que le créateur, au commencement, fit l''homme et la femme
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ እንዲህ አለ። ፈጣሪ በመጀመሪያ ወንድና ሴት አደረጋቸው፥

verses.en: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
verses.fr: et qu''il dit: C''est pourquoi l''homme quittera son père et sa mère, et s''attachera à sa femme, et les deux deviendront une seule chair?
verses.am: አለም። ስለዚህ ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል፥ ከሚስቱም ጋር ይተባበራል፥ ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ የሚለውን ቃል አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.en: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
verses.fr: Ainsi ils ne sont plus deux, mais ils sont une seule chair. Que l''homme donc ne sépare pas ce que Dieu a joint.
verses.am: ስለዚህ አንድ ሥጋ ናቸው እንጂ ወደ ፊት ሁለት አይደሉም። እግዚአብሔር ያጣመረውን እንግዲህ ሰው አይለየው።

verses.en: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
verses.fr: Pourquoi donc, lui dirent-ils, Moïse a-t-il prescrit de donner à la femme une lettre de divorce et de la répudier?
verses.am: እነርሱም። እንኪያስ ሙሴ የፍችዋን ጽሕፈት ሰጥተው እንዲፈቱአት ስለ ምን አዘዘ? አሉት።

verses.en: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: C''est à cause de la dureté de votre coeur que Moïse vous a permis de répudier vos femmes; au commencement, il n''en était pas ainsi.
verses.am: እርሱም። ሙሴስ ስለ ልባችሁ ጥንካሬ ሚስቶቻችሁን ትፈቱ ዘንድ ፈቀደላችሁ፤ ከጥንት ግን እንዲህ አልነበረም።

verses.en: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
verses.fr: Mais je vous dis que celui qui répudie sa femme, sauf pour infidélité, et qui en épouse une autre, commet un adultère.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ያለ ዝሙት ምክንያት ሚስቱን ፈትቶ ሌላዪቱን የሚያገባ ሁሉ ያመነዝራል፥ የተፈታችውንም የሚያገባ ያመነዝራል አላቸው።

verses.en: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
verses.fr: Ses disciples lui dirent: Si telle est la condition de l''homme à l''égard de la femme, il n''est pas avantageux de se marier.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። የባልና የሚስት ሥርዓት እንዲህ ከሆነ መጋባት አይጠቅምም አሉት።

verses.en: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
verses.fr: Il leur répondit: Tous ne comprennent pas cette parole, mais seulement ceux à qui cela est donné.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ይህ ነገር ለተሰጣቸው ነው እንጂ ለሁሉ አይደለም፤

verses.en: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
verses.fr: Car il y a des eunuques qui le sont dès le ventre de leur mère; il y en a qui le sont devenus par les hommes; et il y en a qui se sont rendus tels eux-mêmes, à cause du royaume des cieux. Que celui qui peut comprendre comprenne.
verses.am: በእናት ማኅፀን ጃንደረቦች ሆነው የተወለዱ አሉ፥ ሰውም የሰለባቸው ጃንደረቦች አሉ፥ ስለ መንግሥተ ሰማያትም ራሳቸውን የሰለቡ ጃንደረቦች አሉ። ሊቀበለው የሚችል ይቀበለው አላቸው።

verses.en: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.fr: Alors on lui amena des petits enfants, afin qu''il leur imposât les mains et priât pour eux. Mais les disciples les repoussèrent.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ እጁን እንዲጭንባቸውና እንዲጸልይ ሕፃናትን ወደ እርሱ አመጡ፤ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ገሠጹአቸው።

verses.en: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.fr: Et Jésus dit: Laissez les petits enfants, et ne les empêchez pas de venir à moi; car le royaume des cieux est pour ceux qui leur ressemblent.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ኢየሱስ። ሕፃናትን ተዉአቸው፥ ወደ እኔም ይመጡ ዘንድ አትከልክሉአቸው፤ መንግሥተ ሰማያት እንደነዚህ ላሉ ናትና አለ፤

verses.en: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
verses.fr: Il leur imposa les mains, et il partit de là.
verses.am: እጁንም ጫነባቸውና ከዚያ ሄደ።

verses.en: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
verses.fr: Et voici, un homme s''approcha, et dit à Jésus: Maître, que dois-je faire de bon pour avoir la vie éternelle?
verses.am: እነሆም፥ አንድ ሰው ቀርቦ። መምህር ሆይ፥ የዘላለምን ሕይወት እንዳገኝ ምን መልካም ነገር ላድርግ? አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
verses.fr: Il lui répondit: Pourquoi m''interroges-tu sur ce qui est bon? Un seul est le bon. Si tu veux entrer dans la vie, observe les commandements.
verses.am: እርሱም። ስለ መልካም ነገር ለምን ትጠይቀኛለህ? መልካም የሆነ አንድ ነው፤ ወደ ሕይወት መግባት ብትወድ ግን ትእዛዛትን ጠብቅ አለው።

verses.en: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
verses.fr: Lesquels? lui dit-il. Et Jésus répondit: Tu ne tueras point; tu ne commettras point d''adultère; tu ne déroberas point; tu ne diras point de faux témoignage;
verses.am: እርሱም። የትኞችን? አለው። ኢየሱስም። አትግደል፥ አታመንዝር፥ አትስረቅ፥ በሐሰት አትመስክር፥

verses.en: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.fr: honore ton père et ta mère; et: tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même.
verses.am: አባትህንና እናትህን አክብር፥ ባልንጀራህንም እንደ ራስህ ውደድ አለው።

verses.en: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
verses.fr: Le jeune homme lui dit: J''ai observé toutes ces choses; que me manque-t-il encore?
verses.am: ጐበዙም። ይህንማ ሁሉ ከሕፃንነቴ ጀምሬ ጠብቄአለሁ፥ ደግሞስ የሚጐድለኝ ምንድር ነው? አለው።

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Si tu veux être parfait, va, vends ce que tu possèdes, donne-le aux pauvres, et tu auras un trésor dans le ciel. Puis viens, et suis-moi.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ፍጹም ልትሆን ብትወድ፥ ሂድና ያለህን ሸጠህ ለድሆች ስጥ፥ መዝገብም በሰማያት ታገኛለህ፥ መጥተህም ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
verses.fr: Après avoir entendu ces paroles, le jeune homme s''en alla tout triste; car il avait de grands biens.
verses.am: ጐበዙም ይህን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ብዙ ንብረት ነበረውና እያዘነ ሄደ።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.fr: Jésus dit à ses disciples: Je vous le dis en vérité, un riche entrera difficilement dans le royaume des cieux.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ለባለጠጋ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት መግባት ጭንቅ ነው።

verses.en: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis encore, il est plus facile à un chameau de passer par le trou d''une aiguille qu''à un riche d''entrer dans le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ዳግመኛም እላችኋለሁ፥ ባለጠጋ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከሚገባ ግመል በመርፌ ቀዳዳ ቢገባ ይቀላል አለ።

verses.en: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
verses.fr: Les disciples, ayant entendu cela, furent très étonnés, et dirent: Qui peut donc être sauvé?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሰምተው እጅግ ተገረሙና። እንኪያስ ማን ሊድን ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.en: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
verses.fr: Jésus les regarda, et leur dit: Aux hommes cela est impossible, mais à Dieu tout est possible.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እነርሱን ተመልክቶ። ይህ በሰው ዘንድ አይቻልም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ግን ሁሉ ይቻላል አላቸው።

verses.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
verses.fr: Pierre, prenant alors la parole, lui dit: Voici, nous avons tout quitté, et nous t''avons suivi; qu''en sera-t-il pour nous?
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ መልሶ። እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ፤ እንኪያስ ምን እናገኝ ይሆን? አለው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Je vous le dis en vérité, quand le Fils de l''homme, au renouvellement de toutes choses, sera assis sur le trône de sa gloire, vous qui m''avez suivi, vous serez de même assis sur douze trônes, et vous jugerez les douze tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እናንተስ የተከተላችሁኝ፥ በዳግመኛ ልደት የሰው ልጅ በክብሩ ዙፋን በሚቀመጥበት ጊዜ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በአሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገድ ስትፈርዱ በአሥራ ሁለት ዙፋን ትቀመጣላችሁ።

verses.en: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
verses.fr: Et quiconque aura quitté, à cause de mon nom, ses frères, ou ses soeurs, ou son père, ou sa mère, ou sa femme, ou ses enfants, ou ses terres, ou ses maisons, recevra le centuple, et héritera la vie éternelle.
verses.am: ስለ ስሜም ቤቶችን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም እኅቶችን ወይም አባትን ወይም እናትን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን ወይም እርሻን የተወ ሁሉ መቶ እጥፍ ይቀበላል የዘላለምንም ሕይወት ይወርሳል።

verses.en: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
verses.fr: Plusieurs des premiers seront les derniers, et plusieurs des derniers seront les premiers.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ብዙዎቹ ፊተኞች ኋለኞች፥ ኋለኞችም ፊተኞች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
verses.fr: Car le royaume des cieux est semblable à un maître de maison qui sortit dès le matin, afin de louer des ouvriers pour sa vigne.
verses.am: መንግሥተ ሰማያት ለወይኑ አትክልት ሠራተኞችን ሊቀጥር ማልዶ የወጣ ባለቤት ሰውን ትመስላለችና።

verses.en: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.fr: Il convint avec eux d''un denier par jour, et il les envoya à sa vigne.
verses.am: ሠራተኞችንም በቀን አንድ ዲናር ተስማምቶ ወደ ወይኑ አትክልት ሰደዳቸው።

verses.en: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
verses.fr: Il sortit vers la troisième heure, et il en vit d''autres qui étaient sur la place sans rien faire.
verses.am: በሦስት ሰዓትም ወጥቶ ሥራ የፈቱ ሌሎችን በአደባባይ ቆመው አየ፥

verses.en: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Allez aussi à ma vigne, et je vous donnerai ce qui sera raisonnable. Et ils y allèrent.
verses.am: እነዚያንም። እናንተ ደግሞ ወደ ወይኔ አትክልት ሂዱ የሚገባውንም እሰጣችኋለሁ አላቸው። እነርሱም ሄዱ።

verses.en: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.fr: Il sortit de nouveau vers la sixième heure et vers la neuvième, et il fit de même.
verses.am: ደግሞም በስድስትና በዘጠኝ ሰዓት ወጥቶ እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
verses.fr: Etant sorti vers la onzième heure, il en trouva d''autres qui étaient sur la place, et il leur dit: Pourquoi vous tenez-vous ici toute la journée sans rien faire?
verses.am: በአሥራ አንደኛውም ሰዓት ወጥቶ ሌሎችን ቆመው አገኘና። ሥራ ፈትታችሁ ቀኑን ሁሉ በዚህ ስለ ምን ትቆማላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: C''est que personne ne nous a loués. Allez aussi à ma vigne, leur dit-il.
verses.am: የሚቀጥረን ስለ አጣን ነው አሉት። እርሱም። እናንተ ደግሞ ወደ ወይኔ አትክልት ሂዱ የሚገባውንም ትቀበላላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
verses.fr: Quand le soir fut venu, le maître de la vigne dit à son intendant: Appelle les ouvriers, et paie-leur le salaire, en allant des derniers aux premiers.
verses.am: በመሸም ጊዜ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ አዛዡን። ሠራተኞችን ጥራና ከኋለኞች ጀምረህ እስከ ፊተኞች ድረስ ደመወዝ ስጣቸው አለው።

verses.en: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
verses.fr: Ceux de la onzième heure vinrent, et reçurent chacun un denier.
verses.am: በአሥራ አንደኛው ሰዓትም የገቡ መጥተው እያንዳንዳቸው አንድ ዲናር ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
verses.fr: Les premiers vinrent ensuite, croyant recevoir davantage; mais ils reçurent aussi chacun un denier.
verses.am: ፊተኞችም በመጡ ጊዜ አብዝተው የሚቀበሉ መስሎአቸው ነበር፤ እነርሱም ደግሞ እያንዳንዳቸው አንድ ዲናር ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
verses.fr: En le recevant, ils murmurèrent contre le maître de la maison,
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ ከእነርሱ ለአንዱ እንዲህ አለው። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ አልበደልሁህም በአንድ ዲናር አልተስማማኸኝምን?

verses.en: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
verses.fr: et dirent: Ces derniers n''ont travaillé qu''une heure, et tu les traites à l''égal de nous, qui avons supporté la fatigue du jour et la chaleur.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ ከእነርሱ ለአንዱ እንዲህ አለው። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ አልበደልሁህም በአንድ ዲናር አልተስማማኸኝምን?

verses.en: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
verses.fr: Il répondit à l''un d''eux: Mon ami, je ne te fais pas tort; n''es-tu pas convenu avec moi d''un denier?
verses.am: ድርሻህን ውሰድና ሂድ፤ እኔ ለዚህ ለኋለኛው እንደ አንተ ልሰጠው እወዳለሁ፤ በገንዘቤ የወደድሁትን አደርግ ዘንድ መብት የለኝምን?

verses.en: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
verses.fr: Prends ce qui te revient, et va-t''en. Je veux donner à ce dernier autant qu''à toi.
verses.am: ወይስ እኔ መልካም ስለ ሆንሁ ዓይንህ ምቀኛ ናትን?

verses.en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
verses.fr: Ne m''est-il pas permis de faire de mon bien ce que je veux? Ou vois-tu de mauvais oeil que je sois bon? -
verses.am: እንዲሁ ኋለኞች ፊተኞች፥ ፊተኞችም ኋለኞች ይሆናሉ፤ የተጠሩ ብዙዎች፥ የተመረጡ ግን ጥቂቶች ናቸውና።

verses.en: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
verses.fr: Ainsi les derniers seront les premiers, et les premiers seront les derniers.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሊወጣ ሳለ፥ በመንገድ አሥራ ሁለቱን ደቀ መዛሙርት ብቻቸውን ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦ።

verses.en: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
verses.fr: Pendant que Jésus montait à Jérusalem, il prit à part les douze disciples, et il leur dit en chemin:
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንወጣለን፥ የሰው ልጅም ለካህናት አለቆችና ለጻፎች ይሰጣል፤ የሞት ፍርድም ይፈርዱበታል፥

verses.en: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
verses.fr: Voici, nous montons à Jérusalem, et le Fils de l''homme sera livré aux principaux sacrificateurs et aux scribes. Ils le condamneront à mort,
verses.am: ሊዘባበቱበትም ሊገርፉትም ሊሰቅሉትም ለአሕዛብ አሳልፈው ይሰጡታል፥ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ይነሣል አላቸው።

verses.en: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.fr: et ils le livreront aux païens, pour qu''ils se moquent de lui, le battent de verges, et le crucifient; et le troisième jour il ressuscitera.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች እናት ከልጆችዋ ጋር እየሰገደችና አንድ ነገር እየለመነች ወደ እርሱ ቀረበች።

verses.en: Then came to him the mother of Zebedees children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
verses.fr: Alors la mère des fils de Zébédée s''approcha de Jésus avec ses fils, et se prosterna, pour lui faire une demande.
verses.am: እርሱም። ምን ትፈልጊያለሽ? አላት። እርስዋም። እነዚህ ሁለቱ ልጆቼ አንዱ በቀኝህ አንዱም በግራህ በመንግሥትህ እንዲቀመጡ እዘዝ አለችው።

verses.en: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
verses.fr: Il lui dit: Que veux-tu? Ordonne, lui dit-elle, que mes deux fils, que voici, soient assis, dans ton royaume, l''un à ta droite et l''autre à ta gauche.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን መልሶ። የምትለምኑትን አታውቁም። እኔ ልጠጣው ያለውን ጽዋ ልትጠጡ እኔም የምጠመቀውን ጥምቀት ልትጠመቁ ትችላላችሁን? አለ። እንችላለን አሉት።

verses.en: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
verses.fr: Jésus répondit: Vous ne savez ce que vous demandez. Pouvez-vous boire la coupe que je dois boire? Nous le pouvons, dirent-ils.
verses.am: እርሱም። ጽዋዬንስ ትጠጣላችሁ፤ በቀኝና በግራ መቀመጥ ግን ከአባቴ ዘንድ ለተዘጋጀላቸው ነው እንጂ እኔ የምሰጥ አይደለሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
verses.fr: Et il leur répondit: Il est vrai que vous boirez ma coupe; mais pour ce qui est d''être assis à ma droite et à ma gauche, cela ne dépend pas de moi, et ne sera donné qu''à ceux à qui mon Père l''a réservé.
verses.am: አሥሩም ሰምተው በሁለቱ ወንድማማች ተቈጡ።

verses.en: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
verses.fr: Les dix, ayant entendu cela, furent indignés contre les deux frères.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። የአሕዛብ አለቆች እንዲገዙአቸው ታላላቆቹም በላያቸው እንዲሠለጥኑ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
verses.fr: Jésus les appela, et dit: Vous savez que les chefs des nations les tyrannisent, et que les grands les asservissent.
verses.am: በእናንተስ እንዲህ አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ማንም ከእናንተ ታላቅ ሊሆን የሚወድ የእናንተ አገልጋይ ይሁን፥

verses.en: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
verses.fr: Il n''en sera pas de même au milieu de vous. Mais quiconque veut être grand parmi vous, qu''il soit votre serviteur;
verses.am: ከእናንተም ማንም ፊተኛ ሊሆን የሚወድ የእናንተ ባሪያ ይሁን፤

verses.en: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
verses.fr: et quiconque veut être le premier parmi vous, qu''il soit votre esclave.
verses.am: እንዲሁም የሰው ልጅ ሊያገለግል ነፍሱንም ለብዙዎች ቤዛ ሊሰጥ እንጂ እንዲያገለግሉት አልመጣም።

verses.en: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que le Fils de l''homme est venu, non pour être servi, mais pour servir et donner sa vie comme la rançon de plusieurs.
verses.am: ከኢያሪኮም ሲወጡ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils sortirent de Jéricho, une grande foule suivit Jésus.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ሁለት ዕውሮች በመንገድ ዳር ተቀምጠው፥ ኢየሱስ እንዲያልፍ በሰሙ ጊዜ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ማረን ብለው ጮኹ።

verses.en: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
verses.fr: Et voici, deux aveugles, assis au bord du chemin, entendirent que Jésus passait, et crièrent: Aie pitié de nous, Seigneur, Fils de David!
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ዝም እንዲሉ ገሠጹአቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን። ጌታ ሆይ፥ የዳዊት ልጅ፥ ማረን እያሉ አብዝተው ጮኹ።

verses.en: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
verses.fr: La foule les reprenait, pour les faire taire; mais ils crièrent plus fort: Aie pitié de nous, Seigneur, Fils de David!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ቆሞ ጠራቸውና። ምን ላደርግላችሁ ትወዳላችሁ? አለ።

verses.en: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
verses.fr: Jésus s''arrêta, les appela, et dit: Que voulez-vous que je vous fasse?
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ዓይኖቻችን ይከፈቱ ዘንድ አሉት።

verses.en: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Seigneur, que nos yeux s''ouvrent.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አዘነላቸውና ዓይኖቻቸውን ዳሰሰ፥ ወዲያውም አዩና ተከተሉት።

verses.en: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
verses.fr: Emu de compassion, Jésus toucha leurs yeux; et aussitôt ils recouvrèrent la vue, et le suivirent.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አዘነላቸውና ዓይኖቻቸውን ዳሰሰ፥ ወዲያውም አዩና ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils approchèrent de Jérusalem, et qu''ils furent arrivés à Bethphagé, vers la montagne des oliviers, Jésus envoya deux disciples,
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ቀርበው ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ወደ ቤተ ፋጌ ሲደርሱ፥ ያንጊዜ ኢየሱስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁለት ላከ፥

verses.en: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
verses.fr: en leur disant: Allez au village qui est devant vous; vous trouverez aussitôt une ânesse attachée, et un ânon avec elle; détachez-les, et amenez-les-moi.
verses.am: እንዲህም አላቸው። በፊታችሁ ወዳለችው መንደር ሂዱ፥ በዚያን ጊዜም የታሰረችን አህያ ውርንጫም ከእርስዋ ጋር ታገኛላችሁ፤ ፈትታችሁ አምጡልኝ።

verses.en: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un vous dit quelque chose, vous répondrez: Le Seigneur en a besoin. Et à l''instant il les laissera aller.
verses.am: ማንም አንዳች ቢላችሁ። ለጌታ ያስፈልጉታል በሉ፤ ወዲያውም ይሰዳቸዋል።

verses.en: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
verses.fr: Or, ceci arriva afin que s''accomplît ce qui avait été annoncé par le prophète:

verses.en: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.fr: Dites à la fille de Sion: Voici, ton roi vient à toi, Plein de douceur, et monté sur un âne, Sur un ânon, le petit d''une ânesse.
verses.am: ለጽዮን ልጅ። እነሆ፥ ንጉሥሽ የዋህ ሆኖ በአህያ ላይና በአህያይቱ ግልገል በውርንጫይቱ ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣል በሉአት ተብሎ በነቢይ የተነገረው ይፈጸም ዘንድ ይህ ሆነ።

verses.en: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
verses.fr: Les disciples allèrent, et firent ce que Jésus leur avait ordonné.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሄደው ኢየሱስ እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ፥

verses.en: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
verses.fr: Ils amenèrent l''ânesse et l''ânon, mirent sur eux leurs vêtements, et le firent asseoir dessus.
verses.am: አህያይቱንና ውርንጫዋንም አመጡለት፥ ልብሳቸውንም በእነርሱ ላይ ጫኑ፥ ተቀመጠባቸውም።

verses.en: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verses.fr: La plupart des gens de la foule étendirent leurs vêtements sur le chemin; d''autres coupèrent des branches d''arbres, et en jonchèrent la route.
verses.am: ከሕዝቡም እጅግ ብዙዎች ልብሳቸውን በመንገድ ላይ አነጠፉ፥ ሌሎችም ከዛፍ ጫፍ ጫፉን እየቈረጡ በመንገድ ላይ ያነጥፉ ነበር።

verses.en: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
verses.fr: Ceux qui précédaient et ceux qui suivaient Jésus criaient: Hosanna au Fils de David! Béni soit celui qui vient au nom du Seigneur! Hosanna dans les lieux très hauts!
verses.am: የሚቀድሙትም ሕዝብ የሚከተሉትም። ሆሣዕና ለዳዊት ልጅ በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ የተባረከ ነው፤ ሆሣዕና በአርያም እያሉ ይጮኹ ነበር።

verses.en: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il entra dans Jérusalem, toute la ville fut émue, et l''on disait: Qui est celui-ci?
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም በገባ ጊዜ መላው ከተማ። ይህ ማን ነው? ብሎ ተናወጠ።

verses.en: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
verses.fr: La foule répondait: C''est Jésus, le prophète, de Nazareth en Galilée.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም። ይህ ከገሊላ ናዝሬት የመጣ ነቢዩ ኢየሱስ ነው አሉ።

verses.en: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
verses.fr: Jésus entra dans le temple de Dieu. Il chassa tous ceux qui vendaient et qui achetaient dans le temple; il renversa les tables des changeurs, et les sièges des vendeurs de pigeons.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ መቅደስ ገባና በመቅደስ የሚሸጡትንና የሚገዙትን ሁሉ አወጣ፥ የገንዘብ ለዋጮችንም ገበታዎች የርግብ ሻጮችንም ወንበሮች ገለበጠና።

verses.en: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.fr: Et il leur dit: Il est écrit: Ma maison sera appelée une maison de prière. Mais vous, vous en faites une caverne de voleurs.
verses.am: ቤቴ የጸሎት ቤት ትባላለች ተብሎ ተጽፎአል፥ እናንተ ግን የወንበዶች ዋሻ አደረጋችኋት አላቸው።

verses.en: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
verses.fr: Des aveugles et des boiteux s''approchèrent de lui dans le temple. Et il les guérit.
verses.am: በመቅደስም ዕውሮችና አንካሶች ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና ፈወሳቸው።

verses.en: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were sore displeased,
verses.fr: Mais les principaux sacrificateurs et les scribes furent indignés, à la vue des choses merveilleuses qu''il avait faites, et des enfants qui criaient dans le temple: Hosanna au Fils de David!
verses.am: ነገር ግን የካህናት አለቆችና ጻፎች ያደረገውን ድንቃ ድንቅ በመቅደስም። ሆሣዕና ለዳዊት ልጅ እያሉ የሚጮኹትን ልጆች ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ተቈጥተው።

verses.en: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
verses.fr: Ils lui dirent: Entends-tu ce qu''ils disent? Oui, leur répondit Jésus. N''avez-vous jamais lu ces paroles: Tu as tiré des louanges de la bouche des enfants et de ceux qui sont à la mamelle?
verses.am: እነዚህ የሚሉትን አትሰማምን? አሉት። ኢየሱስም። እሰማለሁ፤ ከሕፃናትና ከሚጠቡት አፍ ምስጋናን ለራስህ አዘጋጀህ የሚለውን ቃል ከቶ አላነበባችሁምን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
verses.fr: Et, les ayant laissés, il sortit de la ville pour aller à Béthanie, où il passa la nuit.
verses.am: ትቶአቸውም ከከተማ ወደ ቢታንያ ወጣ በዚያም አደረ።

verses.en: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
verses.fr: Le matin, en retournant à la ville, il eut faim.
verses.am: በማለዳም ወደ ከተማ ሲመለስ ተራበ።

verses.en: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
verses.fr: Voyant un figuier sur le chemin, il s''en approcha; mais il n''y trouva que des feuilles, et il lui dit: Que jamais fruit ne naisse de toi! Et à l''instant le figuier sécha.
verses.am: በመንገድም አጠገብ በለስ አይቶ ወደ እርስዋ መጣ፤ ከቅጠልም ብቻ በቀር ምንም አላገኘባትምና። ለዘላለሙ ፍሬ አይገኝብሽ አላት። በለሲቱም ያንጊዜውን ደረቀች።

verses.en: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
verses.fr: Les disciples, qui virent cela, furent étonnés, et dirent: Comment ce figuier est-il devenu sec en un instant?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ይህን አይተው። በለሲቱ ያንጊዜውን እንዴት ደረቀች? ብለው ተደነቁ።

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Je vous le dis en vérité, si vous aviez de la foi et que vous ne doutiez point, non seulement vous feriez ce qui a été fait à ce figuier, mais quand vous diriez à cette montagne: Ote-toi de là et jette-toi dans la mer, cela se ferait.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እምነት ቢኖራችሁ ባትጠራጠሩም፥ በበለሲቱ እንደ ሆነባት ብቻ አታደርጉም፤ ነገር ግን ይህን ተራራ እንኳ። ተነቅለህ ወደ ባሕር ተወርወር ብትሉት ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
verses.fr: Tout ce que vous demanderez avec foi par la prière, vous le recevrez.
verses.am: አምናችሁም በጸሎት የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ ትቀበላላችሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
verses.fr: Jésus se rendit dans le temple, et, pendant qu''il enseignait, les principaux sacrificateurs et les anciens du peuple vinrent lui dire: Par quelle autorité fais-tu ces choses, et qui t''a donné cette autorité?
verses.am: ወደ መቅደስም ገብቶ ሲያስተምር የካህናት አለቆችና የሕዝብ ሽማግሎች ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡና። በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን ታደርጋለህ? ይህንስ ሥልጣን ማን ሰጠህ? አሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Je vous adresserai aussi une question; et, si vous m''y répondez, je vous dirai par quelle autorité je fais ces choses.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እኔ ደግሞ አንዲት ነገር እጠይቃችኋለሁ፤ እናንተም ያችን ብትነግሩኝ እኔ ደግሞ እነዚህን በምን ሥልጣን እንዳደርግ እነግራችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
verses.fr: Le baptême de Jean, d''où venait-il? du ciel, ou des hommes? Mais ils raisonnèrent ainsi entre eux; Si nous répondons: Du ciel, il nous dira: Pourquoi donc n''avez-vous pas cru en lui?
verses.am: የዮሐንስ ጥምቀት ከወዴት ነበረች? ከሰማይን ወይስ ከሰው? አላቸው። እነርሱም እርስ በርሳቸው ሲነጋገሩ። ከሰማይ ብንል። እንኪያስ ስለ ምን አላመናችሁበትም? ይለናል፤

verses.en: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
verses.fr: Et si nous répondons: Des hommes, nous avons à craindre la foule, car tous tiennent Jean pour un prophète.
verses.am: ከሰው ግን ብንል፥ ዮሐንስን ሁሉም እንደ ነቢይ ያዩታልና ሕዝቡን እንፈራለን አሉ።

verses.en: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.fr: Alors ils répondirent à Jésus: Nous ne savons. Et il leur dit à son tour: Moi non plus, je ne vous dirai pas par quelle autorité je fais ces choses.
verses.am: ለኢየሱስም መልሰው። አናውቅም አሉት። እርሱም ደግሞ። እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንዳደርግ አልነግራችሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
verses.fr: Que vous en semble? Un homme avait deux fils; et, s''adressant au premier, il dit: Mon enfant, va travailler aujourd''hui dans ma vigne.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ምን ይመስላችኋል? አንድ ሰው ሁለት ልጆች ነበሩት፤ ወደ አንደኛው ቀርቦ። ልጄ ሆይ፥ ዛሬ ሂድና በወይኔ አትክልት ሥራ አለው።

verses.en: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Je ne veux pas. Ensuite, il se repentit, et il alla.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። አልወድም አለ፤ ኋላ ግን ተጸጸተና ሄደ።

verses.en: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
verses.fr: S''adressant à l''autre, il dit la même chose. Et ce fils répondit: Je veux bien, seigneur. Et il n''alla pas.
verses.am: ወደ ሁለተኛውም ቀርቦ እንዲሁ አለው እርሱም መልሶ። እሺ ጌታዬ አለ፤ ነገር ግን አልሄደም።

verses.en: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
verses.fr: Lequel des deux a fait la volonté du père? Ils répondirent: Le premier. Et Jésus leur dit: Je vous le dis en vérité, les publicains et les prostituées vous devanceront dans le royaume de Dieu.
verses.am: ከሁለቱ የአባቱን ፈቃድ ያደረገ ማን ነው? ፊተኛው አሉት። ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አላቸው። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቀራጮችና ጋለሞቶች ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት በመግባት ይቀድሙአችኋል።

verses.en: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
verses.fr: Car Jean est venu à vous dans la voie de la justice, et vous n''avez pas cru en lui. Mais les publicains et les prostituées ont cru en lui; et vous, qui avez vu cela, vous ne vous êtes pas ensuite repentis pour croire en lui.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ በጽድቅ መንገድ መጥቶላችሁ ነበርና፥ አላመናችሁበትም፤ ቀራጮችና ጋለሞቶች ግን አመኑበት፤ እናንተም ይህን አይታችሁ ታምኑበት ዘንድ በኋላ ንስሐ አልገባችሁም።

verses.en: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
verses.fr: Ecoutez une autre parabole. Il y avait un homme, maître de maison, qui planta une vigne. Il l''entoura d''une haie, y creusa un pressoir, et bâtit une tour; puis il l''afferma à des vignerons, et quitta le pays.
