verses.am: ሌላ ምሳሌ ስሙ። የወይን አትክልት የተከለ ባለቤት ሰው ነበረ፤ ቅጥርም ቀጠረለት፥ መጥመቂያም ማሰለት፥ ግንብም ሠራና ለገበሬዎች አከራይቶ ወደ ሌላ አገር ሄደ።

verses.en: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
verses.fr: Lorsque le temps de la récolte fut arrivé, il envoya ses serviteurs vers les vignerons, pour recevoir le produit de sa vigne.
verses.am: የሚያፈራበትም ጊዜ ሲቀርብ፥ ፍሬውን ሊቀበሉ ባሮቹን ወደ ገበሬዎች ላከ።

verses.en: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
verses.fr: Les vignerons, s''étant saisis de ses serviteurs, battirent l''un, tuèrent l''autre, et lapidèrent le troisième.
verses.am: ገበሬዎቹም ባሮቹን ይዘው አንዱን ደበደቡት አንዱንም ገደሉት ሌላውንም ወገሩት።

verses.en: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
verses.fr: Il envoya encore d''autres serviteurs, en plus grand nombre que les premiers; et les vignerons les traitèrent de la même manière.
verses.am: ደግሞ ከፊተኞች የሚበዙ ሌሎች ባሮችን ላከ፥ እንዲሁም አደረጉባቸው።

verses.en: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.fr: Enfin, il envoya vers eux son fils, en disant: Ils auront du respect pour mon fils.
verses.am: በኋላ ግን። ልጄንስ ያፍሩታል ብሎ ልጁን ላከባቸው።

verses.en: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
verses.fr: Mais, quand les vignerons virent le fils, ils dirent entre eux: Voici l''héritier; venez, tuons-le, et emparons-nous de son héritage.
verses.am: ገበሬዎቹ ግን ልጁን ባዩ ጊዜ እርስ በርሳቸው። ወራሹ ይህ ነው፤ ኑ፥ እንግደለውና ርስቱን እናግኝ ተባባሉ።

verses.en: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
verses.fr: Et ils se saisirent de lui, le jetèrent hors de la vigne, et le tuèrent.
verses.am: ይዘውም ከወይኑ አትክልት አወጡና ገደሉት።

verses.en: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
verses.fr: Maintenant, lorsque le maître de la vigne viendra, que fera-t-il à ces vignerons?
verses.am: እንግዲህ የወይኑ አትክልት ጌታ በሚመጣ ጊዜ በእነዚህ ገበሬዎች ምን ያደርግባቸዋል?

verses.en: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
verses.fr: Ils lui répondirent: Il fera périr misérablement ces misérables, et il affermera la vigne à d''autres vignerons, qui lui en donneront le produit au temps de la récolte.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ክፉዎችን በክፉ ያጠፋቸዋል፥ የወይኑንም አትክልት ፍሬውን በየጊዜው ለሚያስረክቡ ለሌሎች ገበሬዎች ይሰጠዋል አሉት።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.fr: Jésus leur dit: N''avez-vous jamais lu dans les Ecritures: La pierre qu''ont rejetée ceux qui bâtissaient Est devenue la principale de l''angle; C''est du Seigneur que cela est venu, Et c''est un prodige à nos yeux?
verses.am: ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አላቸው። ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ፤ ይህም ከጌታ ዘንድ ሆነ፥ ለዓይኖቻችንም ድንቅ ነው የሚለውን ከቶ በመጽሐፍ አላነበባችሁምን?

verses.en: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, je vous le dis, le royaume de Dieu vous sera enlevé, et sera donné à une nation qui en rendra les fruits.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ከእናንተ ትወሰዳለች ፍሬዋንም ለሚያደርግ ሕዝብ ትሰጣለች።

verses.en: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.fr: Celui qui tombera sur cette pierre s''y brisera, et celui sur qui elle tombera sera écrasé.
verses.am: በዚህም ድንጋይ ላይ የሚወድቅ ይቀጠቀጣል፤ ድንጋዩ ግን የሚወድቅበትን ሁሉ ይፈጨዋል።

verses.en: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
verses.fr: Après avoir entendu ses paraboles, les principaux sacrificateurs et les pharisiens comprirent que c''était d''eux que Jésus parlait,
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ፈሪሳውያንም ምሳሌዎቹን ሰምተው ስለ እነርሱ እንደ ተናገረ አስተዋሉ፤

verses.en: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
verses.fr: et ils cherchaient à se saisir de lui; mais ils craignaient la foule, parce qu''elle le tenait pour un prophète.
verses.am: ሊይዙትም ሲፈልጉት ሳሉ ሕዝቡ እንደ ነቢይ ስላዩት ፈሩአቸው።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
verses.fr: Jésus, prenant la parole, leur parla de nouveau en paraboles, et il dit:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰ ደግሞም በምሳሌ ነገራቸው እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
verses.fr: Le royaume des cieux est semblable à un roi qui fit des noces pour son fils.
verses.am: መንግሥተ ሰማያት ለልጁ ሰርግ ያደረገ ንጉሥን ትመስላለች።

verses.en: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
verses.fr: Il envoya ses serviteurs appeler ceux qui étaient invités aux noces; mais ils ne voulurent pas venir.
verses.am: የታደሙትንም ወደ ሰርጉ ይጠሩ ዘንድ ባሮቹን ላከ ሊመጡም አልወደዱም።

verses.en: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
verses.fr: Il envoya encore d''autres serviteurs, en disant: Dites aux conviés: Voici, j''ai préparé mon festin; mes boeufs et mes bêtes grasses sont tués, tout est prêt, venez aux noces.
verses.am: ደግሞ ሌሎችን ባሮች ልኮ። የታደሙትን። እነሆ፥ ድግሴን አዘጋጀሁ፥ ኮርማዎቼና የሰቡት ከብቶቼ ታርደዋል፥ ሁሉም ተዘጋጅቶአል፤ ወደ ሰርጉ ኑ በሉአቸው አለ።

verses.en: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
verses.fr: Mais, sans s''inquiéter de l''invitation, ils s''en allèrent, celui-ci à son champ, celui-là à son trafic;
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ቸል ብለው አንዱ ወደ እርሻው፥ ሌላውም ወደ ንግዱ ሄደ፤

verses.en: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
verses.fr: et les autres se saisirent des serviteurs, les outragèrent et les tuèrent.
verses.am: የቀሩትም ባሮቹን ይዘው አንገላቱአቸው ገደሉአቸውም።

verses.en: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
verses.fr: Le roi fut irrité; il envoya ses troupes, fit périr ces meurtriers, et brûla leur ville.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ተቈጣ፥ ጭፍሮቹንም ልኮ እነዚያን ገዳዮች አጠፋ፤ ከተማቸውንም አቃጠለ።

verses.en: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
verses.fr: Alors il dit à ses serviteurs: Les noces sont prêtes; mais les conviés n''en étaient pas dignes.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ባሮቹን። ሰርጉስ ተዘጋጅቶአል፥ ነገር ግን የታደሙት የማይገባቸው ሆኑ፤

verses.en: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
verses.fr: Allez donc dans les carrefours, et appelez aux noces tous ceux que vous trouverez.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ወደ መንገድ መተላለፊያ ሄዳችሁ ያገኛችሁትን ሁሉ ወደ ሰርጉ ጥሩ አለ።

verses.en: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
verses.fr: Ces serviteurs allèrent dans les chemins, rassemblèrent tous ceux qu''ils trouvèrent, méchants et bons, et la salle des noces fut pleine de convives.
verses.am: እነዚያም ባሮች ወደ መንገድ ወጥተው ያገኙትን ሁሉ ክፉዎችንም በጎዎችንም ሰበሰቡ፤ የሰርጉንም ቤት ተቀማጮች ሞሉት።

verses.en: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
verses.fr: Le roi entra pour voir ceux qui étaient à table, et il aperçut là un homme qui n''avait pas revêtu un habit de noces.
verses.am: ንጉሡም የተቀመጡትን ለማየት በገባ ጊዜ በዚያ የሰርግ ልብስ ያለበሰ አንድ ሰው አየና። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥

verses.en: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
verses.fr: Il lui dit: Mon ami, comment es-tu entré ici sans avoir un habit de noces? Cet homme eut la bouche fermée.
verses.am: የሰርግ ልብስ ሳትለብስ እንዴት ወደዚህ ገባህ? አለው እርሱም ዝም አለ።

verses.en: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness, there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.fr: Alors le roi dit aux serviteurs: Liez-lui les pieds et les mains, et jetez-le dans les ténèbres du dehors, où il y aura des pleurs et des grincements de dents.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ንጉሡ አገልጋዮቹን። እጁንና እግሩን አስራችሁ በውጭ ወዳለው ጨለማ አውጡት፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል አለ።

verses.en: For many are called, but few are chosen.
verses.fr: Car il y a beaucoup d''appelés, mais peu d''élus.
verses.am: የተጠሩ ብዙዎች፥ የተመረጡ ግን ጥቂቶች ናቸውና።

verses.en: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
verses.fr: Alors les pharisiens allèrent se consulter sur les moyens de surprendre Jésus par ses propres paroles.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ፈሪሳውያን ሄዱና እንዴት አድርገው በነገር እንዲያጠምዱት ተማከሩ።

verses.en: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
verses.fr: Ils envoyèrent auprès de lui leurs disciples avec les hérodiens, qui dirent: Maître, nous savons que tu es vrai, et que tu enseignes la voie de Dieu selon la vérité, sans t''inquiéter de personne, car tu ne regardes pas à l''apparence des hommes.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርታቸውንም ከሄሮድስ ወገን ጋር ላኩበት፥ እነርሱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ እውነተኛ እንደ ሆንህ በእውነትም የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ እንድታስተምር እናውቃለን፥ ለማንምም አታደላም፥ የሰውን ፊት አትመለከትምና፤

verses.en: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
verses.fr: Dis-nous donc ce qu''il t''en semble: est-il permis, ou non, de payer le tribut à César?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን ይመስልሃል? ንገረን ለቄሣር ግብር መስጠት ተፈቅዶአልን ወይስ አልተፈቀደም? አሉት።

verses.en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
verses.fr: Jésus, connaissant leur méchanceté, répondit: Pourquoi me tentez-vous, hypocrites?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ክፋታቸውን አውቆ። እናንተ ግብዞች፥ ስለ ምን ትፈትኑኛላችሁ?

verses.en: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
verses.fr: Montrez-moi la monnaie avec laquelle on paie le tribut. Et ils lui présentèrent un denier.
verses.am: የግብሩን ብር አሳዩኝ አለ። እነርሱም ዲናር አመጡለት።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
verses.fr: Il leur demanda: De qui sont cette effigie et cette inscription?
verses.am: እርሱም። ይህች መልክ ጽሕፈቲቱስ የማን ናት? አላቸው።

verses.en: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
verses.fr: De César, lui répondirent-ils. Alors il leur dit: Rendez donc à César ce qui est à César, et à Dieu ce qui est à Dieu.
verses.am: የቄሣር ነው አሉት። በዚያን ጊዜ። እንኪያስ የቄሣርን ለቄሣር የእግዚአብሔርንም ለእግዚአብሔር አስረክቡ አላቸው።

verses.en: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
verses.fr: Etonnés de ce qu''ils entendaient, ils le quittèrent, et s''en allèrent.
verses.am: ይህንም ሰምተው ተደነቁ፥ ትተውትም ሄዱ።

verses.en: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
verses.fr: Le même jour, les sadducéens, qui disent qu''il n''y a point de résurrection, vinrent auprès de Jésus, et lui firent cette question:
verses.am: በዚያን ቀን። ትንሣኤ ሙታን የለም የሚሉ ሰዱቃውያን ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፥

verses.en: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.fr: Maître, Moïse a dit: Si quelqu''un meurt sans enfants, son frère épousera sa veuve, et suscitera une postérité à son frère.
verses.am: እንዲህም ብለው ጠየቁት። መምህር ሆይ፥ ሙሴ አንድ ሰው ልጅ ሳይወልድ ሲሞት ወንድሙ ሚስቱን አግብቶ ለወንድሙ ዘር ይተካ አለ።

verses.en: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
verses.fr: Or, il y avait parmi nous sept frères. Le premier se maria, et mourut; et, comme il n''avait pas d''enfants, il laissa sa femme à son frère.
verses.am: ሰባት ወንድማማች በእኛ ዘንድ ነበሩ፤ ፊተኛውም ሚስት አግብቶ ሞተ፥ ዘርም ስለሌለው ሚስቱን ለወንድሙ ተወለት፤

verses.en: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
verses.fr: Il en fut de même du second, puis du troisième, jusqu''au septième.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ደግሞ ሁለተኛው ሦስተኛውም፥ እስከ ሰባተኛው ድረስ።

verses.en: And last of all the woman died also.
verses.fr: Après eux tous, la femme mourut aussi.
verses.am: ከሁሉም በኋላ ሴቲቱ ሞተች።

verses.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
verses.fr: A la résurrection, duquel des sept sera-t-elle donc la femme? Car tous l''ont eue.
verses.am: ሁሉ አግብተዋታልና በትንሣኤ ቀንስ፥ ከሰባቱ ለማናቸው ሚስት ትሆናለች?

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Vous êtes dans l''erreur, parce que vous ne comprenez ni les Ecritures, ni la puissance de Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። መጻሕፍትንና የእግዚአብሔርን ኃይል አታውቁምና ትስታላችሁ።

verses.en: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
verses.fr: Car, à la résurrection, les hommes ne prendront point de femmes, ni les femmes de maris, mais ils seront comme les anges de Dieu dans le ciel.
verses.am: በትንሣኤስ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መላእክት በሰማይ ይሆናሉ እንጂ አያገቡም አይጋቡምም።

verses.en: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
verses.fr: Pour ce qui est de la résurrection des morts, n''avez-vous pas lu ce que Dieu vous a dit:
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ይህን ሰምተው በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ።

verses.en: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
verses.fr: Je suis le Dieu d''Abraham, le Dieu d''Isaac, et le Dieu de Jacob? Dieu n''est pas Dieu des morts, mais des vivants.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ይህን ሰምተው በትምህርቱ ተገረሙ።

verses.en: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
verses.fr: La foule, qui écoutait, fut frappée de l''enseignement de Jésus.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ሰዱቃውያንን ዝም እንዳሰኛቸው በሰሙ ጊዜ አብረው ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
verses.fr: Les pharisiens, ayant appris qu''il avait réduit au silence les sadducéens, se rassemblèrent,
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንድ ሕግ አዋቂ ሊፈትነው።

verses.en: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
verses.fr: et l''un d''eux, docteur de la loi, lui fit cette question, pour l''éprouver:
verses.am: መምህር ሆይ፥ ከሕግ ማናቸይቱ ትእዛዝ ታላቅ ናት? ብሎ ጠየቀው።

verses.en: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
verses.fr: Maître, quel est le plus grand commandement de la loi?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አለው። ጌታ አምላክህን በፍጹም ልብህ በፍጹም ነፍስህም በፍጹም አሳብህም ውደድ።

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Tu aimeras le Seigneur, ton Dieu, de tout ton coeur, de toute ton âme, et de toute ta pensée.
verses.am: ታላቂቱና ፊተኛይቱ ትእዛዝ ይህች ናት።

verses.en: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.fr: C''est le premier et le plus grand commandement.
verses.am: ሁለተኛይቱም ይህችን ትመስላለች፥ እርስዋም። ባልንጀራህን እንደ ነፍስህ ውደድ የምትለው ናት።

verses.en: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.fr: Et voici le second, qui lui est semblable: Tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même.
verses.am: በእነዚህ በሁለቱ ትእዛዛት ሕጉም ሁሉ ነቢያትም ተሰቅለዋል።

verses.en: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
verses.fr: De ces deux commandements dépendent toute la loi et les prophètes.
verses.am: ዳዊትስ ጌታ ብሎ ከጠራው፥ እንዴት ልጁ ይሆናል? አላቸው።

verses.en: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
verses.fr: Comme les pharisiens étaient assemblés, Jésus les interrogea,
verses.am: ዳዊትስ ጌታ ብሎ ከጠራው፥ እንዴት ልጁ ይሆናል? አላቸው።

verses.en: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.
verses.fr: en disant: Que pensez-vous du Christ? De qui est-il fils? Ils lui répondirent: De David.
verses.am: ዳዊትስ ጌታ ብሎ ከጠራው፥ እንዴት ልጁ ይሆናል? አላቸው።

verses.en: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
verses.fr: Et Jésus leur dit: Comment donc David, animé par l''Esprit, l''appelle-t-il Seigneur, lorsqu''il dit:
verses.am: አንድም ቃል ስንኳ ይመልስለት ዘንድ የተቻለው የለም፥ ከዚያ ቀንም ጀምሮ ወደ ፊት ማንም ሊጠይቀው አልደፈረም።

verses.en: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.fr: Le Seigneur a dit à mon Seigneur: Assieds-toi à ma droite, Jusqu''à ce que je fasse de tes ennemis ton marchepied?
verses.am: እርሱም። እንኪያስ ዳዊት። ጌታ ጌታዬን። ጠላቶችህን የእግርህ መረገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ አለው ሲል እንዴት በመንፈስ ጌታ ብሎ ይጠራዋል?

verses.en: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
verses.fr: Si donc David l''appelle Seigneur, comment est-il son fils?
verses.am: ዳዊትስ ጌታ ብሎ ከጠራው፥ እንዴት ልጁ ይሆናል? አላቸው።

verses.en: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
verses.fr: Nul ne put lui répondre un mot. Et, depuis ce jour, personne n''osa plus lui proposer des questions.
verses.am: አንድም ቃል ስንኳ ይመልስለት ዘንድ የተቻለው የለም፥ ከዚያ ቀንም ጀምሮ ወደ ፊት ማንም ሊጠይቀው አልደፈረም።

verses.en: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
verses.fr: Alors Jésus, parlant à la foule et à ses disciples,
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ለሕዝቡና ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንዲህ ብሎ ነገራቸው።

verses.en: Saying The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
verses.fr: dit: Les scribes et les pharisiens sont assis dans la chaire de Moïse.
verses.am: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን በሙሴ ወንበር ተቀምጠዋል።

verses.en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
verses.fr: Faites donc et observez tout ce qu''ils vous disent; mais n''agissez pas selon leurs oeuvres. Car ils disent, et ne font pas.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ያዘዙአችሁን ሁሉ አድርጉ ጠብቁትም፥ ነገር ግን እየተናገሩ አያደርጉትምና እንደ ሥራቸው አታድርጉ።

verses.en: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
verses.fr: Ils lient des fardeaux pesants, et les mettent sur les épaules des hommes, mais ils ne veulent pas les remuer du doigt.
verses.am: ከባድና አስቸጋሪ ሸክም ተብትበው በሰው ትከሻ ይጭናሉ፥ እነርሱ ግን በጣታቸው ስንኳ ሊነኩት አይወዱም።

verses.en: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
verses.fr: Ils font toutes leurs actions pour être vus des hommes. Ainsi, ils portent de larges phylactères, et ils ont de longues franges à leurs vêtements;
verses.am: ለሰውም እንዲታዩ ሥራቸውን ሁሉ ያደርጋሉ፤ ስለዚህ አሽንክታባቸውን ያሰፋሉ ዘርፉንም ያስረዝማሉ፥

verses.en: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
verses.fr: ils aiment la première place dans les festins, et les premiers sièges dans les synagogues;
verses.am: በምሳም የከበሬታ ስፍራ፥ በምኵራብም የከበሬታ ወንበር፥

verses.en: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
verses.fr: ils aiment à être salués dans les places publiques, et à être appelés par les hommes Rabbi, Rabbi.
verses.am: በገበያም ሰላምታና። መምህር ሆይ መምህር ሆይ ተብለው እንዲጠሩ ይወዳሉ።

verses.en: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
verses.fr: Mais vous, ne vous faites pas appeler Rabbi; car un seul est votre Maître, et vous êtes tous frères.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን። መምህር ተብላችሁ አትጠሩ፤ መምህራችሁ አንድ ስለ ሆነ እናንተም ሁላችሁ ወንድማማች ናችሁ።

verses.en: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
verses.fr: Et n''appelez personne sur la terre votre père; car un seul est votre Père, celui qui est dans les cieux.
verses.am: አባታችሁ አንዱ እርሱም የሰማዩ ነውና በምድር ላይ ማንንም። አባት ብላችሁ አትጥሩ።

verses.en: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
verses.fr: Ne vous faites pas appeler directeurs; car un seul est votre Directeur, le Christ.
verses.am: ሊቃችሁ አንድ እርሱም ክርስቶስ ነውና። ሊቃውንት ተብላችሁ አትጠሩ።

verses.en: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.fr: Le plus grand parmi vous sera votre serviteur.
verses.am: ከእናንተም የሚበልጠው አገልጋያችሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
verses.fr: Quiconque s''élèvera sera abaissé, et quiconque s''abaissera sera élevé.
verses.am: ራሱን ከፍ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ይዋረዳል፥ ራሱንም የሚያዋርድ ሁሉ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
verses.fr: Malheur à vous, scribes et pharisiens hypocrites! parce que vous fermez aux hommes le royaume des cieux; vous n''y entrez pas vous-mêmes, et vous n''y laissez pas entrer ceux qui veulent entrer.
verses.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ መንግሥተ ሰማያትን በሰው ፊት ስለምትዘጉ፥ ወዮላችሁ እናንተ አትገቡም የሚገቡትንም እንዳይገቡ ትከለክላላችሁ።

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
verses.fr: Malheur à vous, scribes et pharisiens hypocrites! parce que vous dévorez les maisons des veuves, et que vous faites pour l''apparence de longues prières; à cause de cela, vous serez jugés plus sévèrement.
verses.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ በጸሎት ርዝመት እያመካኛችሁ የመበለቶችን ቤት ስለምትበሉ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ ስለዚህ የባሰ ፍርድ ትቀበላላችሁ።

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
verses.fr: Malheur à vous, scribes et pharisiens hypocrites! parce que vous courez la mer et la terre pour faire un prosélyte; et, quand il l''est devenu, vous en faites un fils de la géhenne deux fois plus que vous.
verses.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ አንድ ሰው ልታሳምኑ በባሕርና በደረቅ ስለምትዞሩ፥ በሆነም ጊዜ ከእናንተ ይልቅ ሁለት እጥፍ የባሰ የገሃነም ልጅ ስለምታደርጉት፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.en: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
verses.fr: Malheur à vous, conducteurs aveugles! qui dites: Si quelqu''un jure par le temple, ce n''est rien; mais, si quelqu''un jure par l''or du temple, il est engagé.
verses.am: እናንተ። ማንም በቤተ መቅደስ የሚምል ምንም የለበትም፤ ማንም በቤተ መቅደስ ወርቅ የሚምል ግን በመሐላው ይያዛል የምትሉ፥ ዕውሮች መሪዎች፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
verses.fr: Insensés et aveugles! lequel est le plus grand, l''or, ou le temple qui sanctifie l''or?
verses.am: እናንተ ደንቆሮዎችና ዕውሮች፥ ማናቸው ይበልጣል? ወርቁ ነውን? ወይስ ወርቁን የቀደሰው ቤተ መቅደስ?

verses.en: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un, dites-vous encore, jure par l''autel, ce n''est rien; mais, si quelqu''un jure par l''offrande qui est sur l''autel, il est engagé.
verses.am: ደግማችሁም። ማንም በመሠዊያው የሚምል ምንም የለበትም፤ ማንም በላዩ ባለው መባ የሚምል ግን በመሐላው ይያዛል ትላላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
verses.fr: Aveugles! lequel est le plus grand, l''offrande, ou l''autel qui sanctifie l''offrande?
verses.am: እናንተ ደንቆሮዎችና ዕውሮች፥ ማናቸው ይበልጣል? መባው ነውን? ወይስ መባውን የሚቀድሰው መሠዊያው?

verses.en: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
verses.fr: Celui qui jure par l''autel jure par l''autel et par tout ce qui est dessus;
verses.am: እንግዲህ በመሠዊያው የሚምለው በእርሱና በእርሱ ላይ ባለው ሁሉ ይምላል፤

verses.en: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
verses.fr: celui qui jure par le temple jure par le temple et par celui qui l''habite;
verses.am: በቤተ መቅደስም የሚምለው በእርሱና በእርሱ በሚኖረው ይምላል፤

verses.en: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
verses.fr: et celui qui jure par le ciel jure par le trône de Dieu et par celui qui y est assis.
verses.am: በሰማይም የሚምለው በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋንና በእርሱ ላይ በተቀመጠው ይምላል።

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.fr: Malheur à vous, scribes et pharisiens hypocrites! parce que vous payez la dîme de la menthe, de l''aneth et du cumin, et que vous laissez ce qui est plus important dans la loi, la justice, la miséricorde et la fidélité: c''est là ce qu''il fallait pratiquer, sans négliger les autres choses.
verses.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ ከአዝሙድና ከእንስላል ከከሙንም አሥራት ስለምታወጡ፥ ፍርድንና ምሕረትን ታማኝነትንም፥ በሕግ ያለውን ዋና ነገር ስለምትተዉ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ ሌላውን ሳትተዉ ይህን ልታደርጉ ይገባችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
verses.fr: Conducteurs aveugles! qui coulez le moucheron, et qui avalez le chameau.
verses.am: እናንተ ዕውሮች መሪዎች፥ ትንኝን የምታጠሩ ግመልንም የምትውጡ።

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
verses.fr: Malheur à vous, scribes et pharisiens hypocrites! parce que vous nettoyez le dehors de la coupe et du plat, et qu''au dedans ils sont pleins de rapine et d''intempérance.
verses.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ በውስጡ ቅሚያና ስስት ሞልቶ ሳለ የጽዋውንና የወጭቱን ውጭ ስለምታጠሩ፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.en: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
verses.fr: Pharisien aveugle! nettoie premièrement l''intérieur de la coupe et du plat, afin que l''extérieur aussi devienne net.
verses.am: አንተ ዕውር ፈሪሳዊ፥ ውጭው ደግሞ ጥሩ እንዲሆን አስቀድመህ የጽዋውንና የወጭቱን ውስጡን አጥራ።

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
verses.fr: Malheur à vous, scribes et pharisiens hypocrites! parce que vous ressemblez à des sépulcres blanchis, qui paraissent beaux au dehors, et qui, au dedans, sont pleins d''ossements de morts et de toute espèce d''impuretés.
verses.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ በውጭ አምረው የሚታዩ በውስጡ ግን የሙታን አጥንት ርኩሰትም ሁሉ የተሞሉ በኖራ የተለሰኑ መቃብሮችን ስለምትመስሉ፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.en: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
verses.fr: Vous de même, au dehors, vous paraissez justes aux hommes, mais, au dedans, vous êtes pleins d''hypocrisie et d''iniquité.
verses.am: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ በውጭ ለሰው እንደ ጻድቃን ትታያላችሁ፥ በውስጣችሁ ግን ግብዝነትና ዓመፀኝነት ሞልቶባችኋል።

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
verses.fr: Malheur à vous, scribes et pharisiens hypocrites! parce que vous bâtissez les tombeaux des prophètes et ornez les sépulcres des justes,
verses.am: እናንተ ግብዞች ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያን፥ የነቢያትን መቃብር ስለምትሠሩ የጻድቃንንም መቃብር ስለምታስጌጡና።

verses.en: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
verses.fr: et que vous dites: Si nous avions vécu du temps de nos pères, nous ne nous serions pas joints à eux pour répandre le sang des prophètes.
verses.am: በአባቶቻችን ዘመን ኖረን በሆነስ በነቢያት ደም ባልተባበርናቸውም ነበር ስለምትሉ፥ ወዮላችሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
verses.fr: Vous témoignez ainsi contre vous-mêmes que vous êtes les fils de ceux qui ont tué les prophètes.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ የነቢያት ገዳዮች ልጆች እንደሆናችሁ በራሳችሁ ላይ ትመሰክራላችሁ።

verses.en: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
verses.fr: Comblez donc la mesure de vos pères.
verses.am: እናንተ ደግሞ የአባቶቻችሁን መስፈሪያ ሙሉ።

verses.en: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
verses.fr: Serpents, race de vipères! comment échapperez-vous au châtiment de la géhenne?
verses.am: እናንተ እባቦች፥ የእፉኝት ልጆች፥ ከገሃነም ፍርድ እንዴት ታመልጣላችሁ?

verses.en: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, voici, je vous envoie des prophètes, des sages et des scribes. Vous tuerez et crucifierez les uns, vous battrez de verges les autres dans vos synagogues, et vous les persécuterez de ville en ville,
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ ነቢያትንና ጥበበኞችን ጻፎችንም ወደ እናንተ እልካለሁ፤ ከእነርሱም ትገድላላችሁ ትሰቅሉማላችሁ፥ ከእነርሱም በምኵራባችሁ ትገርፋላችሁ ከከተማም ወደ ከተማ ታሳድዳላችሁ፤

verses.en: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
verses.fr: afin que retombe sur vous tout le sang innocent répandu sur la terre, depuis le sang d''Abel le juste jusqu''au sang de Zacharie, fils de Barachie, que vous avez tué entre le temple et l''autel.
verses.am: ከጻድቁ ከአቤል ደም ጀምሮ በቤተ መቅደስና በመሠዊያው መካከል እስከ ገደላችሁት እስከ በራክዩ ልጅ እስከ ዘካርያስ ደም ድረስ በምድር ላይ የፈሰሰው የጻድቅ ደም ሁሉ ይደርስባችሁ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, tout cela retombera sur cette génération.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ሁሉ በዚህ ትውልድ ላይ ይደርሳል።

verses.en: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.fr: Jérusalem, Jérusalem, qui tues les prophètes et qui lapides ceux qui te sont envoyés, combien de fois ai-je voulu rassembler tes enfants, comme une poule rassemble ses poussins sous ses ailes, et vous ne l''avez pas voulu!
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ነቢያትን የምትገድል ወደ እርስዋ የተላኩትንም የምትወግር፥ ዶሮ ጫጩቶችዋን ከክንፎችዋ በታች እንደምትሰበስብ ልጆችሽን እሰበስብ ዘንድ ስንት ጊዜ ወደድሁ! አልወደዳችሁምም።

verses.en: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
verses.fr: Voici, votre maison vous sera laissée déserte;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ቤታችሁ የተፈታ ሆኖ ይቀርላችኋል።

verses.en: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: car, je vous le dis, vous ne me verrez plus désormais, jusqu''à ce que vous disiez: Béni soit celui qui vient au nom du Seigneur!
verses.am: እላችኋለሁና፥ በጌታ ስም የሚመጣ የተባረከ ነው እስክትሉ ድረስ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አታዩኝም።

verses.en: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
verses.fr: Comme Jésus s''en allait, au sortir du temple, ses disciples s''approchèrent pour lui en faire remarquer les constructions.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ከመቅደስ ወጥቶ ሄደ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም የመቅደሱን ግንቦች ሊያሳዩት ቀረቡ።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.fr: Mais il leur dit: Voyez-vous tout cela? Je vous le dis en vérité, il ne restera pas ici pierre sur pierre qui ne soit renversée.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። ይህን ሁሉ ታያላችሁን? እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ድንጋይ በድንጋይ ላይ ሳይፈርስ በዚህ አይቀርም አላቸው።

verses.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
verses.fr: Il s''assit sur la montagne des oliviers. Et les disciples vinrent en particulier lui faire cette question: Dis-nous, quand cela arrivera-t-il, et quel sera le signe de ton avènement et de la fin du monde?
verses.am: እርሱም በደብረ ዘይት ተቀምጦ ሳለ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ለብቻቸው ወደ እርሱ ቀርበው። ንገረን፥ ይህ መቼ ይሆናል? የመምጣትህና የዓለም መጨረሻ ምልክቱስ ምንድር ነው? አሉት።

verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
verses.fr: Jésus leur répondit: Prenez garde que personne ne vous séduise.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አላቸው። ማንም እንዳያስታችሁ ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.fr: Car plusieurs viendront sous mon nom, disant: C''est moi qui suis le Christ. Et ils séduiront beaucoup de gens.
verses.am: ብዙዎች። እኔ ክርስቶስ ነኝ እያሉ በስሜ ይመጣሉና፤ ብዙዎችንም ያስታሉ።

verses.en: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
verses.fr: Vous entendrez parler de guerres et de bruits de guerres: gardez-vous d''être troublés, car il faut que ces choses arrivent. Mais ce ne sera pas encore la fin.
verses.am: ጦርንም የጦርንም ወሬ ትሰሙ ዘንድ አላችሁ፤ ይህ ሊሆን ግድ ነውና ተጠበቁ፥ አትደንግጡ፤ ዳሩ ግን መጨረሻው ገና ነው።

verses.en: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
verses.fr: Une nation s''élèvera contre une nation, et un royaume contre un royaume, et il y aura, en divers lieux, des famines et des tremblements de terre.
verses.am: ሕዝብ በሕዝብ ላይ መንግሥትም በመንግሥት ላይ ይነሣልና፥ ራብም ቸነፈርም የምድርም መናወጥ በልዩ ልዩ ስፍራ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
verses.fr: Tout cela ne sera que le commencement des douleurs.
verses.am: እነዚህም ሁሉ የምጥ ጣር መጀመሪያ ናቸው።

verses.en: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
verses.fr: Alors on vous livrera aux tourments, et l''on vous fera mourir; et vous serez haïs de toutes les nations, à cause de mon nom.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ለመከራ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል ይገድሉአችሁማል፥ ስለ ስሜም በአሕዛብ ሁሉ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.en: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
verses.fr: Alors aussi plusieurs succomberont, et ils se trahiront, se haïront les uns les autres.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ብዙዎች ይሰናከላሉ እርስ በርሳቸውም አሳልፈው ይሰጣጣሉ እርስ በርሳቸውም ይጣላሉ፤

verses.en: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
verses.fr: Plusieurs faux prophètes s''élèveront, et ils séduiront beaucoup de gens.
verses.am: ብዙ ሐሰተኞች ነቢያትም ይነሣሉ ብዙዎችንም ያስታሉ፤

verses.en: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
verses.fr: Et, parce que l''iniquité se sera accrue, la charité du plus grand nombre se refroidira.
verses.am: ከዓመፃም ብዛት የተነሣ የብዙ ሰዎች ፍቅር ትቀዘቅዛለች።

verses.en: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.fr: Mais celui qui persévérera jusqu''à la fin sera sauvé.
verses.am: እስከ መጨረሻ የሚጸና ግን እርሱ ይድናል።

verses.en: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
verses.fr: Cette bonne nouvelle du royaume sera prêchée dans le monde entier, pour servir de témoignage à toutes les nations. Alors viendra la fin.
verses.am: ለአሕዛብም ሁሉ ምስክር እንዲሆን ይህ የመንግሥት ወንጌል በዓለም ሁሉ ይሰበካል፥ በዚያን ጊዜም መጨረሻው ይመጣል።

verses.en: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, lorsque vous verrez l''abomination de la désolation, dont a parlé le prophète Daniel, établie en lieu saint, -que celui qui lit fasse attention! -
verses.am: እንግዲህ በነቢዩ በዳንኤል የተባለውን የጥፋትን ርኩሰት በተቀደሰችው ስፍራ ቆሞ ስታዩ፥ አንባቢው ያስተውል፥

verses.en: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
verses.fr: alors, que ceux qui seront en Judée fuient dans les montagnes;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በይሁዳ ያሉት ወደ ተራራዎች ይሽሹ፥

verses.en: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
verses.fr: que celui qui sera sur le toit ne descende pas pour prendre ce qui est dans sa maison;
verses.am: በሰገነትም ያለ በቤቱ ያለውን ሊወስድ አይውረድ፥

verses.en: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
verses.fr: et que celui qui sera dans les champs ne retourne pas en arrière pour prendre son manteau.
verses.am: በእርሻም ያለ ልብሱን ይወስድ ዘንድ ወደ ኋላው አይመለስ።

verses.en: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.fr: Malheur aux femmes qui seront enceintes et à celles qui allaiteront en ces jours-là!
verses.am: በዚያችም ወራት ለርጉዞችና ለሚያጠቡ ወዮላቸው።

verses.en: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
verses.fr: Priez pour que votre fuite n''arrive pas en hiver, ni un jour de sabbat.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሽሽታችሁ በክረምት ወይም በሰንበት እንዳይሆን ጸልዩ፤

verses.en: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
verses.fr: Car alors, la détresse sera si grande qu''il n''y en a point eu de pareille depuis le commencement du monde jusqu''à présent, et qu''il n''y en aura jamais.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ከዓለም መጀመሪያ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ያልሆነ እንግዲህም ከቶ የማይሆን ታላቅ መከራ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
verses.fr: Et, si ces jours n''étaient abrégés, personne ne serait sauvé; mais, à cause des élus, ces jours seront abrégés.
verses.am: እነዚያ ቀኖችስ ባያጥሩ ሥጋ የለበሰ ሁሉ ባልዳነም ነበር፤ ነገር ግን እነዚያ ቀኖች ስለ ተመረጡት ሰዎች ያጥራሉ።

verses.en: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un vous dit alors: Le Christ est ici, ou: Il est là, ne le croyez pas.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ማንም። እነሆ፥ ክርስቶስ ከዚህ አለ ወይም። ከዚያ አለ ቢላችሁ አትመኑ፤

verses.en: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
verses.fr: Car il s''élèvera de faux Christs et de faux prophètes; ils feront de grands prodiges et des miracles, au point de séduire, s''il était possible, même les élus.
verses.am: ሐሰተኞች ክርስቶሶችና ሐሰተኞች ነቢያት ይነሣሉና፥ ቢቻላቸውስ የተመረጡትን እንኳ እስኪያስቱ ድረስ ታላላቅ ምልክትና ድንቅ ያሳያሉ።

verses.en: Behold, I have told you before.
verses.fr: Voici, je vous l''ai annoncé d''avance.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አስቀድሜ ነገርኋችሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
verses.fr: Si donc on vous dit: Voici, il est dans le désert, n''y allez pas; voici, il est dans les chambres, ne le croyez pas.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። እነሆ፥ በበረሀ ነው ቢሉአችሁ፥ አትውጡ፤ እነሆ፥ በእልፍኝ ነው ቢሉአችሁ፥ አትመኑ፤

verses.en: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.fr: Car, comme l''éclair part de l''orient et se montre jusqu''en occident, ainsi sera l''avènement du Fils de l''homme.
verses.am: መብረቅ ከምሥራቅ ወጥቶ እስከ ምዕራብ እንደሚታይ፥ የሰው ልጅ መምጣት እንዲሁ ይሆናልና፤

verses.en: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.fr: En quelque lieu que soit le cadavre, là s''assembleront les aigles.
verses.am: በድን ወዳለበት በዚያ አሞራዎች ይሰበሰባሉ።

verses.en: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
verses.fr: Aussitôt après ces jours de détresse, le soleil s''obscurcira, la lune ne donnera plus sa lumière, les étoiles tomberont du ciel, et les puissances des cieux seront ébranlées.
verses.am: ከዚያች ወራትም መከራ በኋላ ወዲያው ፀሐይ ይጨልማል፥ ጨረቃም ብርሃንዋን አትሰጥም፥ ከዋክብትም ከሰማይ ይወድቃሉ፥

verses.en: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.fr: Alors le signe du Fils de l''homme paraîtra dans le ciel, toutes les tribus de la terre se lamenteront, et elles verront le Fils de l''homme venant sur les nuées du ciel avec puissance et une grande gloire.
verses.am: የሰማያትም ኃይላት ይናወጣሉ። በዚያን ጊዜም የሰው ልጅ ምልክት በሰማይ ይታያል፥ በዚያን ጊዜም የምድር ወገኖች ሁሉ ዋይ ዋይ ይላሉ፥ የሰው ልጅንም በኃይልና በብዙ ክብር በሰማይ ደመና ሲመጣ ያዩታል፤

verses.en: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.fr: Il enverra ses anges avec la trompette retentissante, et ils rassembleront ses élus des quatre vents, depuis une extrémité des cieux jusqu''à l''autre.
verses.am: መላእክቱንም ከታላቅ መለከት ድምፅ ጋር ይልካቸዋል፥ ከሰማያትም ዳርቻ እስከ ዳርቻው ከአራቱ ነፋሳት ለእርሱ የተመረጡትን ይሰበስባሉ።

verses.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
verses.fr: Instruisez-vous par une comparaison tirée du figuier. Dès que ses branches deviennent tendres, et que les feuilles poussent, vous connaissez que l''été est proche.
verses.am: ምሳሌውንም ከበለስ ተማሩ፤ ጫፍዋ ሲለሰልስ ቅጠልዋም ሲያቈጠቍጥ፥ ያን ጊዜ በጋ እንደ ቀረበ ታውቃላችሁ፤

verses.en: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
verses.fr: De même, quand vous verrez toutes ces choses, sachez que le Fils de l''homme est proche, à la porte.
verses.am: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ይህን ሁሉ ስታዩ በደጅ እንደ ቀረበ እወቁ።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, cette génération ne passera point, que tout cela n''arrive.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ሁሉ እስኪሆን ድረስ ይህ ትውልድ አያልፍም።

verses.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
verses.fr: Le ciel et la terre passeront, mais mes paroles ne passeront point.
verses.am: ሰማይና ምድር ያልፋሉ፥ ቃሌ ግን አያልፍም።

verses.en: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
verses.fr: Pour ce qui est du jour et de l''heure, personne ne le sait, ni les anges des cieux, ni le Fils, mais le Père seul.
verses.am: ስለዚያች ቀንና ስለዚያች ሰዓት ግን ከአባት ብቻ በቀር የሰማይ መላእክትም ቢሆኑ ልጅም ቢሆን የሚያውቅ የለም።

verses.en: But as the days of Noah were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.fr: Ce qui arriva du temps de Noé arrivera de même à l''avènement du Fils de l''homme.
verses.am: የኖኅ ዘመን እንደ ነበረ የሰው ልጅ መምጣት እንዲሁ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
verses.fr: Car, dans les jours qui précédèrent le déluge, les hommes mangeaient et buvaient, se mariaient et mariaient leurs enfants, jusqu''au jour où Noé entra dans l''arche;
verses.am: በዚያች ወራት ከጥፋት ውኃ በፊት፥ ኖኅ ወደ መርከብ እስከገባበት ቀን ድረስ፥ ሲበሉና ሲጠጡ ሲያገቡና ሲጋቡም እንደ ነበሩ፥

verses.en: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.fr: et ils ne se doutèrent de rien, jusqu''à ce que le déluge vînt et les emportât tous: il en sera de même à l''avènement du Fils de l''homme.
verses.am: የጥፋት ውኃም መጥቶ ሁሉን እስከ ወሰደ ድረስ እንዳላወቁ፥ የሰው ልጅ መምጣት ደግሞ እንዲሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.fr: Alors, de deux hommes qui seront dans un champ, l''un sera pris et l''autre laissé;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ሁለት ሰዎች በእርሻ ይሆናሉ፤ አንዱ ይወሰዳል አንዱም ይቀራል፤

verses.en: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.fr: de deux femmes qui moudront à la meule, l''une sera prise et l''autre laissée.
verses.am: ሁለት ሴቶች በወፍጮ ይፈጫሉ፤ አንዲቱ ትወሰዳለች አንዲቱም ትቀራለች።

verses.en: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
verses.fr: Veillez donc, puisque vous ne savez pas quel jour votre Seigneur viendra.
verses.am: ጌታችሁ በምን ሰዓት እንዲመጣ አታውቁምና እንግዲህ ንቁ።

verses.en: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
verses.fr: Sachez-le bien, si le maître de la maison savait à quelle veille de la nuit le voleur doit venir, il veillerait et ne laisserait pas percer sa maison.
verses.am: ያን ግን እወቁ፤ ባለቤት ከሌሊቱ በየትኛው ክፍል ሌባ እንዲመጣ ቢያውቅ ኖሮ፥ በነቃ ቤቱም ሊቈፈር ባልተወም ነበር።

verses.en: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, vous aussi, tenez-vous prêts, car le Fils de l''homme viendra à l''heure où vous n''y penserez pas.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እናንተ ደግሞ ተዘጋጅታችሁ ኑሩ፥ የሰው ልጅ በማታስቡበት ሰዓት ይመጣልና።

verses.en: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
verses.fr: Quel est donc le serviteur fidèle et prudent, que son maître a établi sur ses gens, pour leur donner la nourriture au temps convenable?
verses.am: እንኪያስ ምግባቸውን በጊዜው ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ጌታው በቤተ ሰዎች ላይ የሾመው ታማኝና ልባም ባሪያ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.fr: Heureux ce serviteur, que son maître, à son arrivée, trouvera faisant ainsi!
verses.am: ጌታው መጥቶ እንዲህ ሲያደርግ የሚያገኘው ያ ባሪያ ብፁዕ ነው፤

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, il l''établira sur tous ses biens.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ባለው ሁሉ ላይ ይሾመዋል።

verses.en: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
verses.fr: Mais, si c''est un méchant serviteur, qui dise en lui-même: Mon maître tarde à venir,
verses.am: ያ ክፉ ባሪያ ግን። ጌታዬ እስኪመጣ ይዘገያል ብሎ በልቡ ቢያስብ፥

verses.en: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
verses.fr: s''il se met à battre ses compagnons, s''il mange et boit avec les ivrognes,
verses.am: ባልንጀሮቹን ባሮች ሊመታ ቢጀምር ከሰካሮችም ጋር ቢበላና ቢጠጣ፥

verses.en: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
verses.fr: le maître de ce serviteur viendra le jour où il ne s''y attend pas et à l''heure qu''il ne connaît pas,
verses.am: የዚያ ባሪያ ጌታ ባልጠበቃት ቀን ባላወቃትም ሰዓት ይመጣል፥

verses.en: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.fr: il le mettra en pièces, et lui donnera sa part avec les hypocrites: c''est là qu''il y aura des pleurs et des grincements de dents.
verses.am: ከሁለትም ይሰነጥቀዋል፥ እድሉንም ከግብዞች ጋር ያደርግበታል፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
verses.fr: Alors le royaume des cieux sera semblable à dix vierges qui, ayant pris leurs lampes, allèrent à la rencontre de l''époux.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ መንግሥተ ሰማያት መብራታቸውን ይዘው ሙሽራውን ሊቀበሉ የወጡ አሥር ቆነጃጅትን ትመስላለች።

verses.en: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
verses.fr: Cinq d''entre elles étaient folles, et cinq sages.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አምስቱ ሰነፎች አምስቱም ልባሞች ነበሩ።

verses.en: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
verses.fr: Les folles, en prenant leurs lampes, ne prirent point d''huile avec elles;
verses.am: ሰነፎቹ መብራታቸውን ይዘው ከእነርሱ ጋር ዘይት አልያዙምና፤

verses.en: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.fr: mais les sages prirent, avec leurs lampes, de l''huile dans des vases.
verses.am: ልባሞቹ ግን ከመብራታቸው ጋር በማሰሮአቸው ዘይት ያዙ።

verses.en: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.fr: Comme l''époux tardait, toutes s''assoupirent et s''endormirent.
verses.am: ሙሽራውም በዘገየ ጊዜ ሁሉ እንቅልፍ እንቅልፍ አላቸውና ተኙ።

verses.en: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
verses.fr: Au milieu de la nuit, on cria: Voici l''époux, allez à sa rencontre!
verses.am: እኩል ሌሊትም ሲሆን። እነሆ፥ ሙሽራው ይመጣል፥ ትቀበሉት ዘንድ ውጡ የሚል ውካታ ሆነ።

verses.en: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.fr: Alors toutes ces vierges se réveillèrent, et préparèrent leurs lampes.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ እነዚያ ቆነጃጅት ሁሉ ተነሡና መብራታቸውን አዘጋጁ።

verses.en: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
verses.fr: Les folles dirent aux sages: Donnez-nous de votre huile, car nos lampes s''éteignent.
verses.am: ሰነፎቹም ልባሞቹን። መብራታችን ሊጠፋብን ነው፤ ከዘይታችሁ ስጡን አሉአቸው።

verses.en: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.fr: Les sages répondirent: Non; il n''y en aurait pas assez pour nous et pour vous; allez plutôt chez ceux qui en vendent, et achetez-en pour vous.
verses.am: ልባሞቹ ግን መልሰው። ምናልባት ለእኛና ለእናንተ ባይበቃስ፤ ይልቅስ ወደሚሸጡት ሄዳችሁ ለራሳችሁ ግዙ አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''elles allaient en acheter, l''époux arriva; celles qui étaient prêtes entrèrent avec lui dans la salle des noces, et la porte fut fermée.
verses.am: ሊገዙም በሄዱ ጊዜ ሙሽራው መጣ፥ ተዘጋጅተው የነበሩትም ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ሰርግ ገቡ፥ ደጁም ተዘጋ።

verses.en: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
verses.fr: Plus tard, les autres vierges vinrent, et dirent: Seigneur, Seigneur, ouvre-nous.
verses.am: በኋላም ደግሞ የቀሩቱ ቈነጃጅት መጡና። ጌታ ሆይ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ክፈትልን አሉ።

verses.en: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
verses.fr: Mais il répondit: Je vous le dis en vérité, je ne vous connais pas.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መልሶ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ አላውቃችሁም አለ።

verses.en: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
verses.fr: Veillez donc, puisque vous ne savez ni le jour, ni l''heure.
verses.am: ቀኒቱንና ሰዓቲቱን አታውቁምና እንግዲህ ንቁ።

verses.en: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
verses.fr: Il en sera comme d''un homme qui, partant pour un voyage, appela ses serviteurs, et leur remit ses biens.
verses.am: ወደ ሌላ አገር የሚሄድ ሰው ባሮቹን ጠርቶ ያለውን ገንዘብ እንደ ሰጣቸው እንዲሁ ይሆናልና፤

verses.en: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
verses.fr: Il donna cinq talents à l''un, deux à l''autre, et un au troisième, à chacun selon sa capacité, et il partit. Aussitôt
verses.am: ለእያንዳንዱ እንደ ዓቅሙ፥ ለአንዱ አምስት መክሊት ለአንዱ ሁለት ለአንዱም አንድ ሰጠና ወደ ሌላ አገር ወዲያው ሄደ።

verses.en: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
verses.fr: celui qui avait reçu les cinq talents s''en alla, les fit valoir, et il gagna cinq autres talents.
verses.am: አምስት መክሊትም የተቀበለው ሄዶ ነገደበት ሌላም አምስት አተረፈ፤

verses.en: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
verses.fr: De même, celui qui avait reçu les deux talents en gagna deux autres.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ሁለት የተቀበለው ሌላ ሁለት አተረፈ።

verses.en: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
verses.fr: Celui qui n''en avait reçu qu''un alla faire un creux dans la terre, et cacha l''argent de son maître.
verses.am: አንድ የተቀበለው ግን ሄዶ ምድርን ቈፈረና የጌታውን ገንዘብ ቀበረ።

verses.en: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
verses.fr: Longtemps après, le maître de ces serviteurs revint, et leur fit rendre compte.
verses.am: ከብዙ ዘመንም በኋላ የእነዚያ ባሮች ጌታ መጣና ተቆጣጠራቸው።

verses.en: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
verses.fr: Celui qui avait reçu les cinq talents s''approcha, en apportant cinq autres talents, et il dit: Seigneur, tu m''as remis cinq talents; voici, j''en ai gagné cinq autres.
verses.am: አምስት መክሊት የተቀበለውም ቀረበና ሌላ አምስት መክሊት አስረክቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አምስት መክሊት ሰጥተኸኝ ነበር፤ እነሆ፥ ሌላ አምስት መክሊት አተረፍሁበት አለ።

verses.en: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.fr: Son maître lui dit: C''est bien, bon et fidèle serviteur; tu as été fidèle en peu de chose, je te confierai beaucoup; entre dans la joie de ton maître.
verses.am: ጌታውም። መልካም፥ አንተ በጎ ታማኝም ባሪያ፤ በጥቂቱ ታምነሃል፥ በብዙ እሾምሃለሁ፤ ወደ ጌታህ ደስታ ግባ አለው።

verses.en: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
verses.fr: Celui qui avait reçu les deux talents s''approcha aussi, et il dit: Seigneur, tu m''as remis deux talents; voici, j''en ai gagné deux autres.
verses.am: ሁለት መክሊትም የተቀበለው ደግሞ ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ሁለት መክሊት ሰጥተኸኝ ነበር፤ እነሆ፥ ሌላ ሁለት መክሊት አተረፍሁበት አለ።

verses.en: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.fr: Son maître lui dit: C''est bien, bon et fidèle serviteur; tu as été fidèle en peu de chose, je te confierai beaucoup; entre dans la joie de ton maître.
verses.am: ጌታውም። መልካም፥ አንተ በጎ፥ ታማኝም ባሪያ፤ በጥቂቱ ታምነሃል፥ በብዙ እሾምሃለሁ፥ ወደ ጌታህ ደስታ ግባ አለው።

verses.en: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
verses.fr: Celui qui n''avait reçu qu''un talent s''approcha ensuite, et il dit: Seigneur, je savais que tu es un homme dur, qui moissonnes où tu n''as pas semé, et qui amasses où tu n''as pas vanné;
verses.am: አንድ መክሊትም የተቀበለው ደግሞ ቀርቦ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ካልዘራህባት የምታጭድ ካልበተንህባትም የምትሰበስብ ጨካኝ ሰው መሆንህን አውቃለሁ፤

verses.en: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
verses.fr: j''ai eu peur, et je suis allé cacher ton talent dans la terre; voici, prends ce qui est à toi.
verses.am: ፈራሁም ሄጄም መክሊትህን በምድር ቀበርሁት፤ እነሆ፥ መክሊትህ አለህ አለ።

verses.en: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
verses.fr: Son maître lui répondit: Serviteur méchant et paresseux, tu savais que je moissonne où je n''ai pas semé, et que j''amasse où je n''ai pas vanné;
verses.am: ጌታውም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። አንተ ክፉና ሃኬተኛ ባሪያ፥ ካልዘራሁባት እንዳጭድ ካልበተንሁባትም እንድሰበስብ ታውቃለህን?

verses.en: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
verses.fr: il te fallait donc remettre mon argent aux banquiers, et, à mon retour, j''aurais retiré ce qui est à moi avec un intérêt.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ገንዘቤን ለለዋጮች አደራ ልትሰጠው በተገባህ ነበር፥ እኔም መጥቼ ያለኝን ከትርፉ ጋር እወስደው ነበር።

verses.en: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
verses.fr: Otez-lui donc le talent, et donnez-le à celui qui a les dix talents.
verses.am: ስለዚህ መክሊቱን ውሰዱበት አሥር መክሊትም ላለው ስጡት፤

verses.en: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
verses.fr: Car on donnera à celui qui a, et il sera dans l''abondance, mais à celui qui n''a pas on ôtera même ce qu''il a.
verses.am: ላለው ሁሉ ይሰጠዋልና ይበዛለትማል፤ ከሌለው ግን ያው ያለው እንኳ ይወሰድበታል።

verses.en: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.fr: Et le serviteur inutile, jetez-le dans les ténèbres du dehors, où il y aura des pleurs et des grincements de dents.
verses.am: የማይጠቅመውንም ባሪያ በውጭ ወዳለው ጨለማ አውጡት፤ በዚያ ልቅሶና ጥርስ ማፋጨት ይሆናል።

verses.en: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
verses.fr: Lorsque le Fils de l''homme viendra dans sa gloire, avec tous les anges, il s''assiéra sur le trône de sa gloire.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ በክብሩ በሚመጣበት ጊዜ ከእርሱም ጋር ቅዱሳን መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ በክብሩ ዙፋን ይቀመጣል፤

verses.en: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
verses.fr: Toutes les nations seront assemblées devant lui. Il séparera les uns d''avec les autres, comme le berger sépare les brebis d''avec les boucs;
verses.am: አሕዛብም ሁሉ በፊቱ ይሰበሰባሉ፤ እረኛም በጎቹን ከፍየሎች እንደሚለይ እርስ በርሳቸው ይለያቸዋል፥

verses.en: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.fr: et il mettra les brebis à sa droite, et les boucs à sa gauche.
verses.am: በጎችን በቀኙ ፍየሎችንም በግራው ያቆማቸዋል።

verses.en: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
verses.fr: Alors le roi dira à ceux qui seront à sa droite: Venez, vous qui êtes bénis de mon Père; prenez possession du royaume qui vous a été préparé dès la fondation du monde.
verses.am: ንጉሡም በቀኙ ያሉትን እንዲህ ይላቸዋል። እናንተ የአባቴ ቡሩካን፥ ኑ፤ ዓለም ከተፈጠረበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ የተዘጋጀላችሁን መንግሥት ውረሱ።

verses.en: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
verses.fr: Car j''ai eu faim, et vous m''avez donné à manger; j''ai eu soif, et vous m''avez donné à boire; j''étais étranger, et vous m''avez recueilli;
verses.am: ተርቤ አብልታችሁኛልና፥ ተጠምቼ አጠጥታችሁኛልና፥ እንግዳ ሆኜ ተቀብላችሁኛልና፥ ታርዤ አልብሳችሁኛልና፥

verses.en: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
verses.fr: j''étais nu, et vous m''avez vêtu; j''étais malade, et vous m''avez visité; j''étais en prison, et vous êtes venus vers moi.
verses.am: ታምሜ ጠይቃችሁኛልና፥ ታስሬ ወደ እኔ መጥታችኋልና።

verses.en: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
verses.fr: Les justes lui répondront: Seigneur, quand t''avons-nous vu avoir faim, et t''avons-nous donné à manger; ou avoir soif, et t''avons-nous donné à boire?
verses.am: ጻድቃንም መልሰው ይሉታል። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ተርበህ አይተን መቼ አበላንህስ? ወይስ ተጠምተህ አይተን መቼ አጠጣንህ?

verses.en: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
verses.fr: Quand t''avons-nous vu étranger, et t''avons-nous recueilli; ou nu, et t''avons-nous vêtu?
verses.am: እንግዳ ሆነህስ አይተን መቼ ተቀበልንህ? ወይስ ታርዘህ አይተን መቼ አለበስንህ?

verses.en: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
verses.fr: Quand t''avons-nous vu malade, ou en prison, et sommes-nous allés vers toi?
verses.am: ወይስ ታመህ ወይስ ታስረህ አይተን መቼ ወደ አንተ መጣን?

verses.en: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
verses.fr: Et le roi leur répondra: Je vous le dis en vérité, toutes les fois que vous avez fait ces choses à l''un de ces plus petits de mes frères, c''est à moi que vous les avez faites.
verses.am: ንጉሡም መልሶ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሁሉ ከሚያንሱ ከእነዚህ ወንድሞቼ ለአንዱ እንኳ ስላደረጋችሁት ለእኔ አደረጋችሁት ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
verses.fr: Ensuite il dira à ceux qui seront à sa gauche: Retirez-vous de moi, maudits; allez dans le feu éternel qui a été préparé pour le diable et pour ses anges.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በግራው ያሉትን ደግሞ ይላቸዋል። እናንተ ርጉማን፥ ለሰይጣንና ለመላእክቱ ወደ ተዘጋጀ ወደ ዘላለም እሳት ከእኔ ሂዱ።

verses.en: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
verses.fr: Car j''ai eu faim, et vous ne m''avez pas donné à manger; j''ai eu soif, et vous ne m''avez pas donné à boire;
verses.am: ተርቤ አላበላችሁኝምና፥ ተጠምቼ አላጠጣችሁኝምና፥ እንግዳ ሆኜ አልተቀበላችሁኝምና፥

verses.en: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
verses.fr: j''étais étranger, et vous ne m''avez pas recueilli; j''étais nu, et vous ne m''avez pas vêtu; j''étais malade et en prison, et vous ne m''avez pas visité.
verses.am: ታርዤ አላለበሳችሁኝምና፥ ታምሜ ታስሬም አልጠየቃችሁኝምና።

verses.en: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
verses.fr: Ils répondront aussi: Seigneur, quand t''avons-nous vu ayant faim, ou ayant soif, ou étranger, ou nu, ou malade, ou en prison, et ne t''avons-nous pas assisté?
verses.am: እነርሱ ደግሞ ይመልሱና። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ተርበህ ወይስ ተጠምተህ ወይስ እንግዳ ሆነህ ወይስ ታርዘህ ወይስ ታመህ ወይስ ታስረህ መቼ አይተን አላገለገልንህም? ይሉታል።

verses.en: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
verses.fr: Et il leur répondra: Je vous le dis en vérité, toutes les fois que vous n''avez pas fait ces choses à l''un de ces plus petits, c''est à moi que vous ne les avez pas faites.
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሁሉ ከሚያንሱ ከእነዚህ ለአንዱ ስላላደረጋችሁት ለእኔ ደግሞ አላደረጋችሁትም ብሎ ይመልስላቸዋል።

verses.en: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
verses.fr: Et ceux-ci iront au châtiment éternel, mais les justes à la vie éternelle.
verses.am: እነዚያም ወደ ዘላለም ቅጣት፥ ጻድቃን ግን ወደ ዘላለም ሕይወት ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
verses.fr: Lorsque Jésus eut achevé tous ces discours, il dit à ses disciples:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እነዚህን ቃሎች ሁሉ በፈጸመ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
verses.fr: Vous savez que la Pâque a lieu dans deux jours, et que le Fils de l''homme sera livré pour être crucifié.
verses.am: ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ። ከሁለት ቀን በኋላ ፋሲካ እንዲሆን ታውቃላችሁ፥ የሰው ልጅም ሊሰቀል አልፎ ይሰጣል አለ።

verses.en: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
verses.fr: Alors les principaux sacrificateurs et les anciens du peuple se réunirent dans la cour du souverain sacrificateur, appelé Caïphe;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የካህናት አለቆች የሕዝብም ሽማግሎች ቀያፋ በሚባለው በሊቀ ካህናቱ ግቢ ተሰበሰቡ፥

verses.en: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
verses.fr: et ils délibérèrent sur les moyens d''arrêter Jésus par ruse, et de le faire mourir.
verses.am: ኢየሱስንም በተንኰል ሊያስይዙት ሊገድሉትም ተማከሩ፤

verses.en: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
verses.fr: Mais ils dirent: Que ce ne soit pas pendant la fête, afin qu''il n''y ait pas de tumulte parmi le peuple.
verses.am: ነገር ግን። በሕዝቡ ዘንድ ሁከት እንዳይነሣ በበዓል አይሁን አሉ።

verses.en: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
verses.fr: Comme Jésus était à Béthanie, dans la maison de Simon le lépreux,
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በቢታንያ በለምጻሙ በስምዖን ቤት ሳለ፥

verses.en: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
verses.fr: une femme s''approcha de lui, tenant un vase d''albâtre, qui renfermait un parfum de grand prix; et, pendant qu''il était à table, elle répandit le parfum sur sa tête.
verses.am: አንዲት ሴት ዋጋው እጅግ የበዛ ሽቱ የሞላው የአልባስጥሮስ ብልቃጥ ይዛ ወደ እርሱ ቀረበች በማዕድም ተቀምጦ ሳለ በራሱ ላይ አፈሰሰችው።

verses.en: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
verses.fr: Les disciples, voyant cela, s''indignèrent, et dirent: A quoi bon cette perte?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ይህን አይተው ተቈጡና። ይህ ጥፋት ለምንድር ነው?

verses.en: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
verses.fr: On aurait pu vendre ce parfum très cher, et en donner le prix aux pauvres.
verses.am: ይህ በብዙ ዋጋ ተሽጦ ለድሆች ሊሰጥ ይቻል ነበርና አሉ።

verses.en: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
verses.fr: Jésus, s''en étant aperçu, leur dit: Pourquoi faites-vous de la peine à cette femme? Elle a fait une bonne action à mon égard;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ይህን አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። መልካም ሥራ ሠርታልኛለችና ሴቲቱንስ ስለ ምን ታደክሙአታላችሁ?

verses.en: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.fr: car vous avez toujours des pauvres avec vous, mais vous ne m''avez pas toujours.
verses.am: ድሆች ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር ይኖራሉና፥ እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር አልኖርም፤

verses.en: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
verses.fr: En répandant ce parfum sur mon corps, elle l''a fait pour ma sépulture.
verses.am: እርስዋ ይህን ሽቱ በሰውነቴ ላይ አፍስሳ ለመቃብሬ አደረገች።

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis en vérité, partout où cette bonne nouvelle sera prêchée, dans le monde entier, on racontera aussi en mémoire de cette femme ce qu''elle a fait.
verses.am: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ይህ ወንጌል በዓለም ሁሉ በማናቸውም ስፍራ በሚሰበክበት እርስዋ ያደረገችው ደግሞ ለእርስዋ መታሰቢያ እንዲሆን ይነገራል።

verses.en: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
verses.fr: Alors l''un des douze, appelé Judas Iscariot, alla vers les principaux sacrificateurs,
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የአስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ የሚባለው ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ወደ ካህናት አለቆች ሄዶ።

verses.en: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
verses.fr: et dit: Que voulez-vous me donner, et je vous le livrerai? Et ils lui payèrent trente pièces d''argent.
verses.am: ምን ልትሰጡኝ ትወዳላችሁ እኔም አሳልፌ እሰጣችኋለሁ? እነርሱም ሠላሳ ብር መዘኑለት።

verses.en: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
verses.fr: Depuis ce moment, il cherchait une occasion favorable pour livrer Jésus.
verses.am: ከዚያችም ሰዓት ጀምሮ አሳልፎ ሊሰጠው ምቹ ጊዜ ይሻ ነበር።

verses.en: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
verses.fr: Le premier jour des pains sans levain, les disciples s''adressèrent à Jésus, pour lui dire: Où veux-tu que nous te préparions le repas de la Pâque?
verses.am: በቂጣው በዓል በመጀመሪያ ቀን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀርበው። ፋሲካን ትበላ ዘንድ ወዴት ልናሰናዳልህ ትወዳለህ አሉት።

verses.en: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Allez à la ville chez un tel, et vous lui direz: Le maître dit: Mon temps est proche; je ferai chez toi la Pâque avec mes disciples.
verses.am: እርሱም። ወደ ከተማ ከእገሌ ዘንድ ሄዳችሁ። መምህር። ጊዜዬ ቀርቦአል፤ ከደቀ መዛሙርቴ ጋር ከአንተ ዘንድ ፋሲካን አደርጋለሁ ይላል በሉት አለ።

verses.en: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
verses.fr: Les disciples firent ce que Jésus leur avait ordonné, et ils préparèrent la Pâque.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ኢየሱስ እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ ፋሲካንም አሰናዱ።

verses.en: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
verses.fr: Le soir étant venu, il se mit à table avec les douze.
verses.am: በመሸም ጊዜ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር በማዕድ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils mangeaient, il dit: Je vous le dis en vérité, l''un de vous me livrera.
verses.am: ሲበሉም። እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእናንተ አንዱ እኔን አሳልፎ ይሰጣል አለ።

verses.en: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
verses.fr: Ils furent profondément attristés, et chacun se mit à lui dire: Est-ce moi, Seigneur?
verses.am: እጅግም አዝነው እያንዳንዱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እኔ እሆንን? ይሉት ጀመር።

verses.en: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Celui qui a mis avec moi la main dans le plat, c''est celui qui me livrera.
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። ከእኔ ጋር እጁን በወጭቱ ያጠለቀ፥ እኔን አሳልፎ የሚሰጥ እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
verses.fr: Le Fils de l''homme s''en va, selon ce qui est écrit de lui. Mais malheur à l''homme par qui le Fils de l''homme est livré! Mieux vaudrait pour cet homme qu''il ne fût pas né.
verses.am: የሰው ልጅስ ስለ እርሱ እንደ ተጻፈ ይሄዳል፥ ነገር ግን የሰው ልጅ አልፎ ለሚሰጥበት ለዚያ ሰው ወዮለት፤ ያ ሰው ባልተወለደ ይሻለው ነበር አለ።

verses.en: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
verses.fr: Judas, qui le livrait, prit la parole et dit: Est-ce moi, Rabbi? Jésus lui répondit: Tu l''as dit.
verses.am: አሳልፎ የሚሰጠው ይሁዳም መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ እኔ እሆንን? አለ፤ አንተ አልህ አለው።

verses.en: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''ils mangeaient, Jésus prit du pain; et, après avoir rendu grâces, il le rompit, et le donna aux disciples, en disant: Prenez, mangez, ceci est mon corps.
verses.am: ሲበሉም ኢየሱስ እንጀራን አንሥቶ ባረከ ቈርሶም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠና። እንካችሁ፥ ብሉ ይህ ሥጋዬ ነው አለ።

verses.en: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
verses.fr: Il prit ensuite une coupe; et, après avoir rendu grâces, il la leur donna, en disant: Buvez-en tous;
verses.am: ጽዋንም አንሥቶ አመስግኖም ሰጣቸው እንዲህም አለ። ሁላችሁ ከእርሱ ጠጡ፤

verses.en: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
verses.fr: car ceci est mon sang, le sang de l''alliance, qui est répandu pour plusieurs, pour la rémission des péchés.
verses.am: ስለ ብዙዎች ለኃጢአት ይቅርታ የሚፈስ የአዲስ ኪዳን ደሜ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
verses.fr: Je vous le dis, je ne boirai plus désormais de ce fruit de la vigne, jusqu''au jour où j''en boirai du nouveau avec vous dans le royaume de mon Père.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በአባቴ መንግሥት ከእናንተ ጋር ከዚህ ከወይን ፍሬ አዲሱን እስከምጠጣበት እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ ከዛሬ ጀምሬ አልጠጣውም።

verses.en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.fr: Après avoir chanté les cantiques, ils se rendirent à la montagne des oliviers.
verses.am: መዝሙርም ከዘመሩ በኋላ ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ወጡ።

verses.en: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
verses.fr: Alors Jésus leur dit: Je serai pour vous tous, cette nuit, une occasion de chute; car il est écrit: Je frapperai le berger, et les brebis du troupeau seront dispersées.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። በዚች ሌሊት ሁላችሁ በእኔ ትሰናከላላችሁ፤ እረኛውን እመታለሁ የመንጋውም በጎች ይበተናሉ የሚል ተጽፎአልና፤

verses.en: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.fr: Mais, après que je serai ressuscité, je vous précèderai en Galilée.
verses.am: ከተነሣሁ በኋላ ግን ወደ ገሊላ እቀድማችኋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
verses.fr: Pierre, prenant la parole, lui dit: Quand tu serais pour tous une occasion de chute, tu ne le seras jamais pour moi.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም መልሶ። ሁሉም በአንተ ቢሰናከሉ እኔ ከቶ አልሰናከልም አለው።

verses.en: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Je te le dis en vérité, cette nuit même, avant que le coq chante, tu me renieras trois fois.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ። እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ በዚች ሌሊት ዶሮ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ አለው።

verses.en: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
verses.fr: Pierre lui répondit: Quand il me faudrait mourir avec toi, je ne te renierai pas. Et tous les disciples dirent la même chose.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ። ከአንተ ጋር መሞት እንኳ የሚያስፈልገኝ ቢሆን፥ ከቶ አልክድህም አለው። ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁሉ ደግሞ እንደዚሁ አሉ።

verses.en: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
verses.fr: Là-dessus, Jésus alla avec eux dans un lieu appelé Gethsémané, et il dit aux disciples: Asseyez-vous ici, pendant que je m''éloignerai pour prier.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ከእነርሱ ጋር ጌቴሴማኒ ወደምትባል ስፍራ መጣ ደቀ መዛሙርቱንም። ወዲያ ሄጄ ስጸልይ ሳለ በዚህ ተቀመጡ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
verses.fr: Il prit avec lui Pierre et les deux fils de Zébédée, et il commença à éprouver de la tristesse et des angoisses.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስንም ሁለቱንም የዘብዴዎስን ልጆች ወስዶ ሊያዝን ሊተክዝም ጀመር።

verses.en: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
verses.fr: Il leur dit alors: Mon âme est triste jusqu''à la mort; restez ici, et veillez avec moi.
verses.am: ነፍሴ እስከ ሞት ድረስ እጅግ አዘነች፤ በዚህ ቆዩ ከእኔም ጋር ትጉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
verses.fr: Puis, ayant fait quelques pas en avant, il se jeta sur sa face, et pria ainsi: Mon Père, s''il est possible, que cette coupe s''éloigne de moi! Toutefois, non pas ce que je veux, mais ce que tu veux.
verses.am: ጥቂትም ወደ ፊት እልፍ ብሎ በፊቱ ወደቀና ሲጸልይ። አባቴ፥ ቢቻልስ፥ ይህች ጽዋ ከእኔ ትለፍ፤ ነገር ግን አንተ እንደምትወድ ይሁን እንጂ እኔ እንደምወድ አይሁን አለ።

verses.en: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
verses.fr: Et il vint vers les disciples, qu''il trouva endormis, et il dit à Pierre: Vous n''avez donc pu veiller une heure avec moi!
verses.am: ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም መጣ፤ ተኝተውም አገኛቸውና ጴጥሮስን። እንዲሁም ከእኔ ጋር አንዲት ሰዓት እንኳ ልትተጉ አልቻላችሁምን?

verses.en: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
verses.fr: Veillez et priez, afin que vous ne tombiez pas dans la tentation; l''esprit est bien disposé, mais la chair est faible.
verses.am: ወደ ፈተና እንዳትገቡ ትጉና ጸልዩ፤ መንፈስስ ተዘጋጅታለች ሥጋ ግን ደካማ ነው አለው።

verses.en: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
verses.fr: Il s''éloigna une seconde fois, et pria ainsi: Mon Père, s''il n''est pas possible que cette coupe s''éloigne sans que je la boive, que ta volonté soit faite!
verses.am: ደግሞ ሁለተኛ ሄዶ ጸለየና። አባቴ፥ ይህች ጽዋ ሳልጠጣት ታልፍ ዘንድ የማይቻል እንደ ሆነ፥ ፈቃድህ ትሁን አለ።

verses.en: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
verses.fr: Il revint, et les trouva encore endormis; car leurs yeux étaient appesantis.
verses.am: ደግሞም መጥቶ ዓይኖቻቸው በእንቅልፍ ከብደው ነበርና ተኝተው አገኛቸው።

verses.en: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
verses.fr: Il les quitta, et, s''éloignant, il pria pour la troisième fois, répétant les mêmes paroles.
verses.am: ደግሞም ትቶአቸው ሄደ፥ ሦስተኛም ያንኑ ቃል ደግሞ ጸለየ።

verses.en: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.fr: Puis il alla vers ses disciples, et leur dit: Vous dormez maintenant, et vous vous reposez! Voici, l''heure est proche, et le Fils de l''homme est livré aux mains des pécheurs.
verses.am: ከዚያ ወዲያ ወደ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጥቶ። እንግዲህስ ተኙ ዕረፉም፤ እነሆ፥ ሰዓቲቱ ቀርባለች የሰው ልጅም በኃጢአተኞች እጅ አልፎ ይሰጣል።

verses.en: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
verses.fr: Levez-vous, allons; voici, celui qui me livre s''approche.
verses.am: ተነሡ፥ እንሂድ፤ እነሆ፥ አሳልፎ የሚሰጠኝ ቀርቦአል አላቸው።

verses.en: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.fr: Comme il parlait encore, voici, Judas, l''un des douze, arriva, et avec lui une foule nombreuse armée d''épées et de bâtons, envoyée par les principaux sacrificateurs et par les anciens du peuple.
verses.am: ይህንም ገና ሲናገር፥ እነሆ፥ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ ይሁዳ መጣ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ብዙ ሕዝብ ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዘው ከካህናት አለቆችና ከሕዝቡ ሽማግሎች ዘንድ መጡ።

verses.en: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
verses.fr: Celui qui le livrait leur avait donné ce signe: Celui que je baiserai, c''est lui; saisissez-le.
verses.am: አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውም። የምስመው እርሱ ነው፤ ያዙት ብሎ ምልክት ሰጥቶአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
verses.fr: Aussitôt, s''approchant de Jésus, il dit: Salut, Rabbi! Et il le baisa.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ወደ ኢየሱስ ቀረበና። መምህር ሆይ፥ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን ብሎ ሳመው።

verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus and took him.
verses.fr: Jésus lui dit: Mon ami, ce que tu es venu faire, fais-le. Alors ces gens s''avancèrent, mirent la main sur Jésus, et le saisirent.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ለምን ነገር መጣህ? አለው። በዚያን ጊዜ ቀረቡ እጃቸውንም በኢየሱስ ላይ ጭነው ያዙት።

verses.en: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
verses.fr: Et voici, un de ceux qui étaient avec Jésus étendit la main, et tira son épée; il frappa le serviteur du souverain sacrificateur, et lui emporta l''oreille.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከኢየሱስ ጋር ከነበሩት አንዱ እጁን ዘርግቶ ሰይፉን መዘዘና የሊቀ ካህናቱን ባሪያ መትቶ ጆሮውን ቈረጠው።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
verses.fr: Alors Jésus lui dit: Remets ton épée à sa place; car tous ceux qui prendront l''épée périront par l''épée.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አለው። ሰይፍ የሚያነሡ ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይጠፋሉና ሰይፍህን ወደ ስፍራው መልስ።

verses.en: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.fr: Penses-tu que je ne puisse pas invoquer mon Père, qui me donnerait à l''instant plus de douze légions d''anges?
verses.am: ወይስ አባቴን እንድለምን እርሱም አሁን ከአሥራ ሁለት ጭፍሮች የሚበዙ መላእክት እንዲሰድልኝ የማይቻል ይመስልሃልን?

verses.en: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
verses.fr: Comment donc s''accompliraient les Ecritures, d''après lesquelles il doit en être ainsi?
verses.am: እንዲህ ከሆነስ። እንደዚህ ሊሆን ይገባል የሚሉ መጻሕፍት እንዴት ይፈጸማሉ?

verses.en: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
verses.fr: En ce moment, Jésus dit à la foule: Vous êtes venus, comme après un brigand, avec des épées et des bâtons, pour vous emparer de moi. J''étais tous les jours assis parmi vous, enseignant dans le temple, et vous ne m''avez pas saisi.
verses.am: በዚያን ሰዓት ኢየሱስ ለሕዝቡ። ወንበዴን እንደምትይዙ ሰይፍና ጐመድ ይዛችሁ ልትይዙኝ ወጣችሁን? በመቅደስ ዕለት ዕለት እያስተማርሁ ከእናንተ ጋር ስቀመጥ ሳለሁ አልያዛችሁኝም።

verses.en: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
verses.fr: Mais tout cela est arrivé afin que les écrits des prophètes fussent accomplis. Alors tous les disciples l''abandonnèrent, et prirent la fuite.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህ ሁሉ የሆነ የነቢያት መጻሕፍት ይፈጸሙ ዘንድ ነው አለ። በዚያን ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሁሉ ትተውት ሸሹ።

verses.en: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
verses.fr: Ceux qui avaient saisi Jésus l''emmenèrent chez le souverain sacrificateur Caïphe, où les scribes et les anciens étaient assemblés.
verses.am: ኢየሱስን የያዙትም ጻፎችና ሽማግሎች ወደ ተከማቹበት ወደ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ወደ ቀያፋ ወሰዱት።

verses.en: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
verses.fr: Pierre le suivit de loin jusqu''à la cour du souverain sacrificateur, y entra, et s''assit avec les serviteurs, pour voir comment cela finirait.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስ ግን እስከ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ግቢ ድረስ ሩቅ ሆኖ ተከተለው፥ የነገሩንም ፍጻሜ ያይ ዘንድ ወደ ውስጥ ገብቶ ከሎሌዎቹ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs et tout le sanhédrin cherchaient quelque faux témoignage contre Jésus, suffisant pour le faire mourir.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ሽማግሎች ሸንጐውም ሁሉ እንዲገድሉት በኢየሱስ ላይ የሐሰት ምስክር ይፈልጉ ነበር፥ አላገኙም፤

verses.en: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
verses.fr: Mais ils n''en trouvèrent point, quoique plusieurs faux témoins se fussent présentés. Enfin, il en vint deux,
verses.am: ብዙም የሐሰት ምስክሮች ምንም ቢቀርቡ አላገኙም።

verses.en: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
