verses.fr: qui dirent: Celui-ci a dit: Je puis détruire le temple de Dieu, et le rebâtir en trois jours.
verses.am: በኋላም ሁለት ቀርበው። ይህ ሰው። የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ መቅደስ አፍርሼ በሦስት ቀን ልሠራው እችላለሁ ብሎአል አሉ።

verses.en: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
verses.fr: Le souverain sacrificateur se leva, et lui dit: Ne réponds-tu rien? Qu''est-ce que ces hommes déposent contre toi?
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናቱም ተነሥቶ። እነዚህ ለሚመሰክሩብህ አንድ ስንኳ አትመልስምን? አለው።

verses.en: But Jesus held his peace, And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
verses.fr: Jésus garda le silence. Et le souverain sacrificateur, prenant la parole, lui dit: Je t''adjure, par le Dieu vivant, de nous dire si tu es le Christ, le Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ዝም አለ። ሊቀ ካህናቱም። አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ክርስቶስ የሆንህ እንደ ሆነ እንድትነግረን በሕያው እግዚአብሔር አምልሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.fr: Jésus lui répondit: Tu l''as dit. De plus, je vous le déclare, vous verrez désormais le Fils de l''homme assis à la droite de la puissance de Dieu, et venant sur les nuées du ciel.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። አንተ አልህ ነገር ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ የሰው ልጅ በኃይል ቀኝ ሲቀመጥ በሰማይም ደመና ሲመጣ ታያላችሁ አለው።

verses.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
verses.fr: Alors le souverain sacrificateur déchira ses vêtements, disant: Il a blasphémé! Qu''avons-nous encore besoin de témoins? Voici, vous venez d''entendre son blasphème.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ሊቀ ካህናቱ ልብሱን ቀዶ። ተሳድቦአል እንግዲህ ወዲህ ምስክሮች ስለ ምን ያስፈልገናል? እነሆ፥ ስድቡን አሁን ሰምታችኋል፤ ምን ይመስላችኋል? አለ።

verses.en: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
verses.fr: Que vous en semble? Ils répondirent: Il mérite la mort.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ሞት ይገባዋል ብለው መለሱ።

verses.en: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
verses.fr: Là-dessus, ils lui crachèrent au visage, et lui donnèrent des coups de poing et des soufflets
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በፊቱ ተፉበት፤ ጐሰሙትም፥ ሌሎችም በጥፊ መትተው። ክርስቶስ ሆይ፥ በጥፊ የመታህ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
verses.fr: en disant: Christ, prophétise; dis-nous qui t''a frappé.
verses.am: ትንቢት ተናገርልን አሉ።

verses.en: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
verses.fr: Cependant, Pierre était assis dehors dans la cour. Une servante s''approcha de lui, et dit: Toi aussi, tu étais avec Jésus le Galiléen.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም ከቤት ውጭ በአጥሩ ግቢ ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ አንዲት ገረድም ወደ እርሱ ቀርባ። አንተ ደግሞ ከገሊላው ከኢየሱስ ጋር ነበርህ አለችው።

verses.en: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
verses.fr: Mais il le nia devant tous, disant: Je ne sais ce que tu veux dire.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። የምትዪውን አላውቀውም ብሎ በሁሉ ፊት ካደ።

verses.en: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
verses.fr: Comme il se dirigeait vers la porte, une autre servante le vit, et dit à ceux qui se trouvaient là; Celui-ci était aussi avec Jésus de Nazareth.
verses.am: ወደ በሩም ሲወጣ ሌላይቱ አየችውና በዚያ ላሉት። ይህ ደግሞ ከናዝሬቱ ከኢየሱስ ጋር ነበረ አለች።

verses.en: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
verses.fr: Il le nia de nouveau, avec serment: Je ne connais pas cet homme.
verses.am: ዳግመኛም ሲምል። ሰውየውን አላውቀውም ብሎ ካደ።

verses.en: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
verses.fr: Peu après, ceux qui étaient là, s''étant approchés, dirent à Pierre: Certainement tu es aussi de ces gens-là, car ton langage te fait reconnaître.
verses.am: ጥቂትም ቈይተው በዚያ ቆመው የነበሩ ቀርበው ጴጥሮስን። አነጋገርህ ይገልጥሃልና በእውነት አንተ ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ወገን ነህ አሉት።

verses.en: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
verses.fr: Alors il se mit à faire des imprécations et à jurer: Je ne connais pas cet homme. Aussitôt le coq chanta.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ። ሰውየውን አላውቀውም ብሎ ሊራገምና ሊምል ጀመረ። ወዲያውም ዶሮ ጮኸ።

verses.en: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.fr: Et Pierre se souvint de la parole que Jésus avait dite: Avant que le coq chante, tu me renieras trois fois. Et étant sorti, il pleura amèrement.
verses.am: ጴጥሮስም። ዶሮ ሳይጮኽ ሦስት ጊዜ ትክደኛለህ ያለው የኢየሱስ ቃል ትዝ አለው፤ ወደ ውጭም ወጥቶ መራራ ልቅሶ አለቀሰ።

verses.en: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
verses.fr: Dès que le matin fut venu, tous les principaux sacrificateurs et les anciens du peuple tinrent conseil contre Jésus, pour le faire mourir.
verses.am: ሲነጋም የካህናት አለቆችና የሕዝቡ ሽማግሎች ሁሉ ሊገድሉት በኢየሱስ ላይ ተማከሩ፤

verses.en: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
verses.fr: Après l''avoir lié, ils l''emmenèrent, et le livrèrent à Ponce Pilate, le gouverneur.
verses.am: አስረውም ወሰዱት፥ ለገዢው ለጴንጤናዊው ጲላጦስም አሳልፈው ሰጡት።

verses.en: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.fr: Alors Judas, qui l''avait livré, voyant qu''il était condamné, se repentit, et rapporta les trente pièces d''argent aux principaux sacrificateurs et aux anciens,
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አሳልፎ የሰጠው ይሁዳ እንደ ተፈረደበት አይቶ ተጸጸተ፥ ሠላሳውንም ብር ለካህናት አለቆችና ለሽማግሎች መልሶ።

verses.en: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
verses.fr: en disant: J''ai péché, en livrant le sang innocent. Ils répondirent: Que nous importe? Cela te regarde.
verses.am: ንጹሕ ደም አሳልፌ በመስጠቴ በድያለሁ አለ። እነርሱ ግን። እኛስ ምን አግዶን? አንተው ተጠንቀቅ አሉ።

verses.en: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
verses.fr: Judas jeta les pièces d''argent dans le temple, se retira, et alla se pendre.
verses.am: ብሩንም በቤተ መቅደስ ጥሎ ሄደና ታንቆ ሞተ።

verses.en: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs les ramassèrent, et dirent: Il n''est pas permis de les mettre dans le trésor sacré, puisque c''est le prix du sang.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችም ብሩን አንሥተው። የደም ዋጋ ነውና ወደ መባ ልንጨምረው አልተፈቀደም አሉ።

verses.en: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
verses.fr: Et, après en avoir délibéré, ils achetèrent avec cet argent le champ du potier, pour la sépulture des étrangers.
verses.am: ተማክረውም የሸክላ ሠሪውን መሬት ለእንግዶች መቃብር ገዙበት።

verses.en: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi ce champ a été appelé champ du sang, jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ያ መሬት እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የደም መሬት ተባለ።

verses.en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
verses.fr: Alors s''accomplit ce qui avait été annoncé par Jérémie, le prophète: Ils ont pris les trente pièces d''argent, la valeur de celui qui a été estimé, qu''on a estimé de la part des enfants d''Israël;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በነቢዩ በኤርምያስ የተባለው። ከእስራኤል ልጆችም አንዳንዶቹ የገመቱትን፥ የተገመተውን ዋጋ ሠላሳ ብር ያዙ፥

verses.en: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
verses.fr: et ils les ont données pour le champ du potier, comme le Seigneur me l''avait ordonné.
verses.am: ጌታም እንዳዘዘኝ ስለ ሸክላ ሠሪ መሬት ሰጡት። የሚል ተፈጸመ።

verses.en: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
verses.fr: Jésus comparut devant le gouverneur. Le gouverneur l''interrogea, en ces termes: Es-tu le roi des Juifs? Jésus lui répondit: Tu le dis.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም በገዢው ፊት ቆመ፤ ገዢውም። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ አንተ ነህን? ብሎ ጠየቀው፤ ኢየሱስም። አንተ አልህ አለው።

verses.en: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.fr: Mais il ne répondit rien aux accusations des principaux sacrificateurs et des anciens.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችም ሽማግሎችም ሲከሱት ምንም አልመለሰም።

verses.en: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
verses.fr: Alors Pilate lui dit: N''entends-tu pas de combien de choses ils t''accusent?
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ጲላጦስ። ስንት ያህል እንዲመሰክሩብህ አትሰማምን? አለው።

verses.en: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
verses.fr: Et Jésus ne lui donna de réponse sur aucune parole, ce qui étonna beaucoup le gouverneur.
verses.am: ገዢውም እጅግ እስኪደነቅ ድረስ አንዲት ቃል ስንኳ አልመለሰለትም።

verses.en: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
verses.fr: A chaque fête, le gouverneur avait coutume de relâcher un prisonnier, celui que demandait la foule.
verses.am: በዚያም በዓል ሕዝቡ የወደዱትን አንድ እስረኛ ሊፈታላቸው ለገዢው ልማድ ነበረው።

verses.en: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
verses.fr: Ils avaient alors un prisonnier fameux, nommé Barabbas.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም በርባን የሚባል በጣም የታወቀ እስረኛ ነበራቸው።

verses.en: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
verses.fr: Comme ils étaient assemblés, Pilate leur dit: Lequel voulez-vous que je vous relâche, Barabbas, ou Jésus, qu''on appelle Christ?
verses.am: እንግዲህ እነርሱ ተሰብስበው ሳሉ ጲላጦስ። በርባንን ወይስ ክርስቶስ የተባለውን ኢየሱስን ማንኛውን ልፈታላችሁ ትወዳላችሁ? አላቸው፤

verses.en: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
verses.fr: Car il savait que c''était par envie qu''ils avaient livré Jésus.
verses.am: በቅንዓት አሳልፈው እንደ ሰጡት ያውቅ ነበርና።

verses.en: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''il était assis sur le tribunal, sa femme lui fit dire: Qu''il n''y ait rien entre toi et ce juste; car aujourd''hui j''ai beaucoup souffert en songe à cause de lui.
verses.am: እርሱም በፍርድ ወንበር ተቀምጦ ሳለ ሚስቱ። ስለ እርሱ ዛሬ በሕልም እጅግ መከራ ተቀብያለሁና በዚያ ጻድቅ ሰው ምንም አታድርግ ብላ ላከችበት።

verses.en: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs et les anciens persuadèrent à la foule de demander Barabbas, et de faire périr Jésus.
verses.am: የካህናት አለቆችና ሽማግሎች ግን በርባንን እንዲለምኑ ኢየሱስን ግን እንዲያጠፉ ሕዝቡን አባበሉ።

verses.en: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
verses.fr: Le gouverneur prenant la parole, leur dit: Lequel des deux voulez-vous que je vous relâche? Ils répondirent: Barabbas.
verses.am: ገዢውም መልሶ። ከሁለቱ ማንኛውን ልፈታላችሁ ትወዳላችሁ? አላቸው፤ እነርሱም። በርባንን አሉ።

verses.en: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
verses.fr: Pilate leur dit: Que ferai-je donc de Jésus, qu''on appelle Christ? Tous répondirent: Qu''il soit crucifié!
verses.am: ጲላጦስ። ክርስቶስ የተባለውን ኢየሱስን እንግዲህ ምን ላድርገው? አላቸው፤ ሁሉም። ይሰቀል አሉ።

verses.en: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
verses.fr: Le gouverneur dit: Mais quel mal a-t-il fait? Et ils crièrent encore plus fort: Qu''il soit crucifié!
verses.am: ገዢውም። ምን ነው? ያደረገው ክፋት ምንድር ነው? አለ፤ እነርሱ ግን። ይሰቀል እያሉ ጩኸት አበዙ።

verses.en: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
verses.fr: Pilate, voyant qu''il ne gagnait rien, mais que le tumulte augmentait, prit de l''eau, se lava les mains en présence de la foule, et dit: Je suis innocent du sang de ce juste. Cela vous regarde.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም ሁከት እንዲጀመር እንጂ አንዳች እንዳይረባ ባየ ጊዜ፥ ውኃ አንሥቶ። እኔ ከዚህ ጻድቅ ሰው ደም ንጹሕ ነኝ፤ እናንተ ተጠንቀቁ ሲል በሕዝቡ ፊት እጁን ታጠበ።

verses.en: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
verses.fr: Et tout le peuple répondit: Que son sang retombe sur nous et sur nos enfants!
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ መልሰው። ደሙ በእኛና በልጆቻችን ላይ ይሁን አሉ።

verses.en: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
verses.fr: Alors Pilate leur relâcha Barabbas; et, après avoir fait battre de verges Jésus, il le livra pour être crucifié.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በርባንን ፈታላቸው፥ ኢየሱስን ግን ገርፎ ሊሰቀል አሳልፎ ሰጠ።

verses.en: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
verses.fr: Les soldats du gouverneur conduisirent Jésus dans le prétoire, et ils assemblèrent autour de lui toute la cohorte.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የገዢው ወታደሮች ኢየሱስን ወደ ገዢው ግቢ ውስጥ ወሰዱት ጭፍራውንም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አከማቹ።

verses.en: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
verses.fr: Ils lui ôtèrent ses vêtements, et le couvrirent d''un manteau écarlate.
verses.am: ልብሱንም ገፈው ቀይ ልብስ አለበሱት፥

verses.en: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
verses.fr: Ils tressèrent une couronne d''épines, qu''ils posèrent sur sa tête, et ils lui mirent un roseau dans la main droite; puis, s''agenouillant devant lui, ils le raillaient, en disant: Salut, roi des Juifs!
verses.am: ከእሾህም አክሊል ጎንጉነው በራሱ ላይ፥ በቀኝ እጁም መቃ አኖሩ፥ በፊቱም ተንበርክከው። የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ሰላም ለአንተ ይሁን እያሉ ዘበቱበት፤

verses.en: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
verses.fr: Et ils crachaient contre lui, prenaient le roseau, et frappaient sur sa tête.
verses.am: ተፉበትም መቃውንም ይዘው ራሱን መቱት።

verses.en: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
verses.fr: Après s''être ainsi moqués de lui, ils lui ôtèrent le manteau, lui remirent ses vêtements, et l''emmenèrent pour le crucifier.
verses.am: ከዘበቱበትም በኋላ ቀዩን ልብስ ገፈፉት፥ ልብሱንም አለበሱት ሊሰቅሉትም ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils sortirent, ils rencontrèrent un homme de Cyrène, appelé Simon, et ils le forcèrent à porter la croix de Jésus.
verses.am: ሲወጡም ስምዖን የተባለው የቀሬናን ሰው አገኙ፤ እርሱንም መስቀሉን ይሸከም ዘንድ አስገደዱት።

verses.en: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
verses.fr: Arrivés au lieu nommé Golgotha, ce qui signifie lieu du crâne,
verses.am: ትርጓሜው የራስ ቅል ስፍራ ወደሚሆን ጎልጎታ ወደሚባለው ስፍራ በደረሱ ጊዜም፥

verses.en: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
verses.fr: ils lui donnèrent à boire du vin mêlé de fiel; mais, quand il l''eut goûté, il ne voulut pas boire.
verses.am: በሐሞት የተደባለቀ የወይን ጠጅ ሊጠጣ አቀረቡለት፤ ቀምሶም ሊጠጣው አልወደደም።

verses.en: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
verses.fr: Après l''avoir crucifié, ils se partagèrent ses vêtements, en tirant au sort, afin que s''accomplît ce qui avait été annoncé par le prophète: Ils se sont partagé mes vêtements, et ils ont tiré au sort ma tunique.
verses.am: ከሰቀሉትም በኋላ ልብሱን ዕጣ ጥለው ተካፈሉ፥

verses.en: And sitting down they watched him there;
verses.fr: Puis ils s''assirent, et le gardèrent.
verses.am: በዚያም ተቀምጠው ይጠብቁት ነበር።

verses.en: And set up over his head his accusation written, This Is Jesus The King Of The Jews.
verses.fr: Pour indiquer le sujet de sa condamnation, on écrivit au-dessus de sa tête: Celui-ci est Jésus, le roi des Juifs.
verses.am: ይህ ኢየሱስ የአይሁድ ንጉሥ ነው የሚል የክሱን ጽሕፈት ከራሱ በላይ አኖሩ።

verses.en: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
verses.fr: Avec lui furent crucifiés deux brigands, l''un à sa droite, et l''autre à sa gauche.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ሁለት ወንበዶች አንዱ በቀኝ አንዱም በግራ ከእርሱ ጋር ተሰቀሉ።

verses.en: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
verses.fr: Les passants l''injuriaient, et secouaient la tête,
verses.am: የሚያልፉትም ራሳቸውን እየነቀነቁ ይሰድቡት ነበርና።

verses.en: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
verses.fr: en disant: Toi qui détruis le temple, et qui le rebâtis en trois jours, sauve-toi toi-même! Si tu es le Fils de Dieu, descends de la croix!
verses.am: ቤተ መቅደስን የምታፈርስ በሦስት ቀንም የምትሠራው፥ ራስህን አድን፤ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅስ ከሆንህ ከመስቀል ውረድ አሉት።

verses.en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
verses.fr: Les principaux sacrificateurs, avec les scribes et les anciens, se moquaient aussi de lui, et disaient:
verses.am: እንዲሁም ደግሞ የካህናት አለቆች ከጻፎችና ከሽማግሎች ጋር እየዘበቱበት እንዲህ አሉ።

verses.en: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
verses.fr: Il a sauvé les autres, et il ne peut se sauver lui-même! S''il est roi d''Israël, qu''il descende de la croix, et nous croirons en lui.
verses.am: ሌሎችን አዳነ፥ ራሱን ሊያድን አይችልም፤ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከሆነ፥ አሁን ከመስቀል ይውረድ እኛም እናምንበታለን።

verses.en: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
verses.fr: Il s''est confié en Dieu; que Dieu le délivre maintenant, s''il l''aime. Car il a dit: Je suis Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ታምኖአል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነኝ ብሎአልና ከወደደውስ አሁን ያድነው።

verses.en: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
verses.fr: Les brigands, crucifiés avec lui, l''insultaient de la même manière.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ጋር የተሰቀሉት ወንበዶች ደግሞ ያንኑ እያሉ ይነቅፉት ነበር።

verses.en: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
verses.fr: Depuis la sixième heure jusqu''à la neuvième, il y eut des ténèbres sur toute la terre.
verses.am: ከስድስት ሰዓትም ጀምሮ እስከ ዘጠኝ ሰዓት ድረስ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ጨለማ ሆነ።

verses.en: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
verses.fr: Et vers la neuvième heure, Jésus s''écria d''une voix forte: Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? c''est-à-dire: Mon Dieu, mon Dieu, pourquoi m''as-tu abandonné?
verses.am: በዘጠኝ ሰዓትም ኢየሱስ። ኤሎሄ ኤሎሄ ላማ ሰበቅታኒ? ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኸ። ይህም። አምላኬ አምላኬ፥ ስለ ምን ተውኸኝ? ማለት ነው።

verses.en: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
verses.fr: Quelques-uns de ceux qui étaient là, l''ayant entendu, dirent: Il appelle Elie.
verses.am: በዚያም ከቆሙት ሰዎች ሰምተው። ይህስ ኤልያስን ይጠራል አሉ።

verses.en: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
verses.fr: Et aussitôt l''un d''eux courut prendre une éponge, qu''il remplit de vinaigre, et, l''ayant fixée à un roseau, il lui donna à boire.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ከእነርሱ አንዱ ሮጠ፤ ሰፍነግም ይዞ ሆምጣጤ ሞላበት፥ በመቃም አድርጎ አጠጣው።

verses.en: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
verses.fr: Mais les autres disaient: Laisse, voyons si Elie viendra le sauver.
verses.am: ሌሎቹ ግን። ተው፥ ኤልያስ መጥቶ ያድነው እንደ ሆነ እንይ አሉ።

verses.en: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
verses.fr: Jésus poussa de nouveau un grand cri, et rendit l''esprit.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሁለተኛ በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮኾ ነፍሱን ተወ።

verses.en: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
verses.fr: Et voici, le voile du temple se déchira en deux, depuis le haut jusqu''en bas, la terre trembla, les rochers se fendirent,
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የቤተ መቅደስ መጋረጃ ከላይ እስከ ታች ከሁለት ተቀደደ፥ ምድርም ተናወጠች፥ ዓለቶችም ተሰነጠቁ፤

verses.en: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
verses.fr: les sépulcres s''ouvrirent, et plusieurs corps des saints qui étaient morts ressuscitèrent.
verses.am: መቃብሮችም ተከፈቱ፥ ተኝተው ከነበሩትም ከቅዱሳን ብዙ ሥጋዎች ተነሡ፤

verses.en: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
verses.fr: Etant sortis des sépulcres, après la résurrection de Jésus, ils entrèrent dans la ville sainte, et apparurent à un grand nombre de personnes.
verses.am: ከትንሣኤውም በኋላ ከመቃብሮች ወጥተው ወደ ቅድስት ከተማ ገቡና ለብዙዎች ታዩ።

verses.en: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
verses.fr: Le centenier et ceux qui étaient avec lui pour garder Jésus, ayant vu le tremblement de terre et ce qui venait d''arriver, furent saisis d''une grande frayeur, et dirent: Assurément, cet homme était Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: የመቶ አለቃም ከእርሱም ጋር ኢየሱስን የሚጠብቁ መናወጡንና የሆነውን ነገር አይተው። ይህ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነበረ ብለው እጅግ ፈሩ።

verses.en: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
verses.fr: Il y avait là plusieurs femmes qui regardaient de loin; qui avaient accompagné Jésus depuis la Galilée, pour le servir.
verses.am: ኢየሱስን እያገለገሉ ከገሊላ የተከተሉት ብዙ ሴቶች በሩቅ ሆነው ሲመለከቱ በዚያ ነበሩ፤

verses.en: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedees children.
verses.fr: Parmi elles étaient Marie de Magdala, Marie, mère de Jacques et de Joseph, et la mère des fils de Zébédée.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም መግደላዊት ማርያምና የያዕቆብና የዮሳ እናት ማርያም የዘብዴዎስም የልጆቹ እናት ነበሩ።

verses.en: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
verses.fr: Le soir étant venu, arriva un homme riche d''Arimathée, nommé Joseph, lequel était aussi disciple de Jésus.
verses.am: በመሸም ጊዜ ዮሴፍ የተባለው ባለ ጠጋ ሰው ከአርማትያስ መጣ፥ እርሱም ደግሞ የኢየሱስ ደቀ መዝሙር ነበረ፤

verses.en: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
verses.fr: Il se rendit vers Pilate, et demanda le corps de Jésus. Et Pilate ordonna de le remettre.
verses.am: ይኸውም ወደ ጲላጦስ ቀርቦ የኢየሱስን ሥጋ ለመነው።

verses.en: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
verses.fr: Joseph prit le corps, l''enveloppa d''un linceul blanc,
verses.am: ጲላጦስም እንዲሰጡት አዘዘ። ዮሴፍም ሥጋውን ይዞ በንጹሕ በፍታ ከፈነው፥

verses.en: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
verses.fr: et le déposa dans un sépulcre neuf, qu''il s''était fait tailler dans le roc. Puis il roula une grande pierre à l''entrée du sépulcre, et il s''en alla.
verses.am: ከዓለት በወቀረው በአዲሱ መቃብርም አኖረው፥ በመቃብሩም ደጃፍ ታላቅ ድንጋይ አንከባሎ ሄደ።

verses.en: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
verses.fr: Marie de Magdala et l''autre Marie étaient là, assises vis-à-vis du sépulcre.
verses.am: መግደላዊት ማርያምም ሁለተኛይቱም ማርያም በመቃብሩ አንጻር ተቀምጠው በዚያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
verses.fr: Le lendemain, qui était le jour après la préparation, les principaux sacrificateurs et les pharisiens allèrent ensemble auprès de Pilate,
verses.am: በማግሥቱም ከመዘጋጀት በኋላ በሚሆነው ቀን፥ የካህናት አለቆችና ፈሪሳውያን ወደ ጲላጦስ ተሰበሰቡና።

verses.en: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
verses.fr: et dirent: Seigneur, nous nous souvenons que cet imposteur a dit, quand il vivait encore: Après trois jours je ressusciterai.
verses.am: ጌታ ሆይ፥ ያ አሳች በሕይወቱ ገና ሳለ። ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ እነሣለሁ እንዳለ ትዝ አለን።

verses.en: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
verses.fr: Ordonne donc que le sépulcre soit gardé jusqu''au troisième jour, afin que ses disciples ne viennent pas dérober le corps, et dire au peuple: Il est ressuscité des morts. Cette dernière imposture serait pire que la première.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጥተው በሌሊት እንዳይሰርቁት ለሕዝቡም። ከሙታን ተነሣ እንዳይሉ፥ የኋለኛይቱ ስሕተት ከፊተኛይቱ ይልቅ የከፋች ትሆናለችና መቃብሩ እስከ ሦስተኛ ቀን ድረስ እንዲጠበቅ እዘዝ አሉት።

verses.en: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
verses.fr: Pilate leur dit: Vous avez une garde; allez, gardez-le comme vous l''entendrez.
verses.am: ጲላጦስም። ጠባቆች አሉአችሁ፤ ሄዳችሁ እንዳወቃችሁ አስጠብቁ አላቸው።

verses.en: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
verses.fr: Ils s''en allèrent, et s''assurèrent du sépulcre au moyen de la garde, après avoir scellé la pierre.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሄደው ከጠባቆች ጋር ድንጋዩን አትመው መቃብሩን አስጠበቁ።

verses.en: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
verses.fr: Après le sabbat, à l''aube du premier jour de la semaine, Marie de Magdala et l''autre Marie allèrent voir le sépulcre.
verses.am: በሰንበትም መጨረሻ መጀመሪያው ቀን ሲነጋ መግደላዊት ማርያምና ሁለተኛይቱ ማርያም መቃብሩን ሊያዩ መጡ።

verses.en: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
verses.fr: Et voici, il y eut un grand tremblement de terre; car un ange du Seigneur descendit du ciel, vint rouler la pierre, et s''assit dessus.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የጌታ መልአክ ከሰማይ ስለ ወረደ ታላቅ የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ፤ ቀርቦም ድንጋዩን አንከባሎ በላዩ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
verses.fr: Son aspect était comme l''éclair, et son vêtement blanc comme la neige.
verses.am: መልኩም እንደ መብረቅ ልብሱም እንደ በረዶ ነጭ ነበረ።

verses.en: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
verses.fr: Les gardes tremblèrent de peur, et devinrent comme morts.
verses.am: ጠባቆቹም እርሱን ከመፍራት የተነሣ ተናወጡ እንደ ሞቱም ሆኑ።

verses.en: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
verses.fr: Mais l''ange prit la parole, et dit aux femmes: Pour vous, ne craignez pas; car je sais que vous cherchez Jésus qui a été crucifié.
verses.am: መልአኩም መልሶ ሴቶቹን አላቸው። እናንተስ አትፍሩ የተሰቀለውን ኢየሱስን እንድትሹ አውቃለሁና፤

verses.en: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
verses.fr: Il n''est point ici; il est ressuscité, comme il l''avait dit. Venez, voyez le lieu où il était couché,
verses.am: እንደ ተናገረ ተነሥቶአልና በዚህ የለም፤ የተኛበትን ስፍራ ኑና እዩ።

verses.en: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
verses.fr: et allez promptement dire à ses disciples qu''il est ressuscité des morts. Et voici, il vous précède en Galilée: c''est là que vous le verrez. Voici, je vous l''ai dit.
verses.am: ፈጥናችሁም ሂዱና። ከሙታን ተነሣ፥ እነሆም፥ ወደ ገሊላ ይቀድማችኋል በዚያም ታዩታላችሁ ብላችሁ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ንገሩአቸው።

verses.en: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
verses.fr: Elles s''éloignèrent promptement du sépulcre, avec crainte et avec une grande joie, et elles coururent porter la nouvelle aux disciples.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ነገርኋችሁ። በፍርሃትና በታላቅ ደስታም ፈጥነው ከመቃብር ሄዱ፥ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሊያወሩ ሮጡ።

verses.en: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
verses.fr: Et voici, Jésus vint à leur rencontre, et dit: Je vous salue. Elles s''approchèrent pour saisir ses pieds, et elles se prosternèrent devant lui.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ኢየሱስ አገኛቸውና። ደስ ይበላችሁ አላቸው። እነርሱም ቀርበው እግሩን ይዘው ሰገዱለት።

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
verses.fr: Alors Jésus leur dit: Ne craignez pas; allez dire à mes frères de se rendre en Galilée: c''est là qu''ils me verront.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ። አትፍሩ፤ ሄዳችሁ ወደ ገሊላ እንዲሄዱ ለወንድሞቼ ተናገሩ፥ በዚያም ያዩኛል አላቸው።

verses.en: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
verses.fr: Pendant qu''elles étaient en chemin, quelques hommes de la garde entrèrent dans la ville, et annoncèrent aux principaux sacrificateurs tout ce qui était arrivé.
verses.am: ሲሄዱም ሳሉ እነሆ፥ ከጠባቆቹ አንዳንድ ወደ ከተማ መጥተው የሆነውን ሁሉ ለካህናት አለቆች አወሩ።

verses.en: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
verses.fr: Ceux-ci, après s''être assemblés avec les anciens et avoir tenu conseil, donnèrent aux soldats une forte somme d''argent,
verses.am: ከሽማግሎች ጋርም ተሰብስበው ተማከሩና ለጭፍሮች ብዙ ገንዘብ ሰጥተዋቸው።

verses.en: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
verses.fr: en disant: Dites: Ses disciples sont venus de nuit le dérober, pendant que nous dormions.
verses.am: እኛ ተኝተን ሳለን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በሌሊት መጥተው ሰረቁት በሉ።

verses.en: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
verses.fr: Et si le gouverneur l''apprend, nous l''apaiserons, et nous vous tirerons de peine.
verses.am: ይህም በገዢው ዘንድ የተሰማ እንደ ሆነ፥ እኛ እናስረዳዋለን እናንተም ያለ ሥጋት እንድትሆኑ እናደርጋለን አሉአቸው።

verses.en: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
verses.fr: Les soldats prirent l''argent, et suivirent les instructions qui leur furent données. Et ce bruit s''est répandu parmi les Juifs, jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: እነርሱም ገንዘቡን ተቀብለው እንደ አስተማሩአቸው አደረጉ። ይህም ነገር በአይሁድ ዘንድ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ሲወራ ይኖራል።

verses.en: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
verses.fr: Les onze disciples allèrent en Galilée, sur la montagne que Jésus leur avait désignée.
verses.am: አሥራ አንዱ ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን ኢየሱስ ወዳዘዛቸው ተራራ ወደ ገሊላ ሄዱ፥

verses.en: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
verses.fr: Quand ils le virent, ils se prosternèrent devant lui. Mais quelques-uns eurent des doutes.
verses.am: ባዩትም ጊዜ ሰገዱለት፤ የተጠራጠሩ ግን ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
verses.fr: Jésus, s''étant approché, leur parla ainsi: Tout pouvoir m''a été donné dans le ciel et sur la terre.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ቀረበና እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው። ሥልጣን ሁሉ በሰማይና በምድር ተሰጠኝ።

verses.en: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
verses.fr: Allez, faites de toutes les nations des disciples, les baptisant au nom du Père, du Fils et du Saint-Esprit,

verses.en: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
verses.fr: et enseignez-leur à observer tout ce que je vous ai prescrit. Et voici, je suis avec vous tous les jours, jusqu''à la fin du monde.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሂዱና አሕዛብን ሁሉ በአብ በወልድና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ስም እያጠመቃችኋቸው፥ ያዘዝኋችሁንም ሁሉ እንዲጠብቁ እያስተማራችኋቸው ደቀ መዛሙርት አድርጓቸው፤ እነሆም እኔ እስከ ዓለም ፍጻሜ ድረስ ሁልጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር ነኝ።
